NEV_AccumPacket.source:
import NEV_AccumulateComplete
import NEV_PushDomains
import NEV_BasisCallDomains
import NEV_WeightDomains
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_AccumPacket
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NEV_AccumulateCarriers
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody

/-- Input-only packet domain. In particular, no successful child, basis,
row traversal, field result, or complete accumulation result is assumed. -/
structure Domain (p : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Prepared) (a : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Accumulator)
    (value : RawE) (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights) : Prop where
 width : a.weights.val.length=64
 weightsCanonical : NEV_WeightDomains.Canonical a.weights
 global : a.next.val<22
 localActive : b.terms.val<22
 valueCanonical : NBO_TailDomain.WideCanonical (toE value)
 rhsCanonical : NBO_TailDomain.WideCanonical (toE a.rhs)
 powerCanonical : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical (toQ a.power)
 rhoCanonical : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical (toQ p.rho)
 progress : S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress b.terms.val 0 (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW (toWeights b))

theorem raw_length (p : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Prepared) (a : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Accumulator)
    (value : RawE) (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights) (domain : Domain p a value b) :
    b.raw.val.length=64 := domain.progress.2.1

/-- Complete modeled Result/state/ordered-effect relation. This ghost state
is external to the returned owned vectors; their actual native mutable frame
is checked separately by the native cut/callee certificates. -/
theorem result_state_effects {S Event : Type} (state : S) (base : Ops)
    (p : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Prepared) (a : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Accumulator)
    (node : U32) (value : RawE) (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights)
    (domain : Domain p a value b) :
    (do let out ← NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node p a node value b
        ok (NEV_TailModel.toPair out,state,([] : List Event))) =
      (do
        let out ← AspisR1Stage2.verifier.accumulateWithOps
            (NBO_AccumulateAssociation.reference (NEV_TailModel.fields base))
            (toPrepared p) (toAccumulator a) node (toE value) (toWeights b)
        ok (out,state,([] : List Event))) := by
  have same := NEV_AccumulateComplete.reference base p a node value b domain.width
    (raw_length p a value b domain) domain.global domain.valueCanonical domain.rhsCanonical
    domain.powerCanonical domain.rhoCanonical
  have lifted := congrArg (fun result : Result (verifier.Accumulator × verifier.BatchedWeights) =>
    do let out ← result;ok (out,state,([] : List Event))) same
  simpa only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok] using lifted

/-- Any residual base dictionary fields are unreachable by this actual
function. The chosen concrete field/row/basis callbacks determine the result. -/
theorem no_base_dependency (first second : Ops)
    (p : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Prepared) (a : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Accumulator)
    (node : U32) (value : RawE) (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights)
    (domain : Domain p a value b) :
    AspisR1Stage2.verifier.accumulateWithOps
      (NBO_AccumulateAssociation.reference (NEV_TailModel.fields first))
      (toPrepared p) (toAccumulator a) node (toE value) (toWeights b) =
    AspisR1Stage2.verifier.accumulateWithOps
      (NBO_AccumulateAssociation.reference (NEV_TailModel.fields second))
      (toPrepared p) (toAccumulator a) node (toE value) (toWeights b) := by
  exact (NEV_AccumulateComplete.reference first p a node value b domain.width
    (raw_length p a value b domain) domain.global domain.valueCanonical domain.rhsCanonical
    domain.powerCanonical domain.rhoCanonical).symm.trans
    (NEV_AccumulateComplete.reference second p a node value b domain.width
      (raw_length p a value b domain) domain.global domain.valueCanonical domain.rhsCanonical
      domain.powerCanonical domain.rhoCanonical)
#print axioms raw_length
#print axioms result_state_effects
#print axioms no_base_dependency
end NEV_AccumPacket
end

NEV_AccumulateComplete.source:
import NEV_AccumulatePrefix
import NEV_TailModel
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_AccumulateComplete
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NEV_AccumulateCarriers
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody

theorem reference_split (base : Ops) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (node : U32) (value : NBF_RowInstall.E) (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) :
    AspisR1Stage2.verifier.accumulateWithOps (NBO_AccumulateAssociation.reference (NEV_TailModel.fields base))
      p a node value b =
      (do let middle ← NBO_AccumulateAssociation.prefixRun (NEV_TailModel.fields base) a node b
          NEV_TailModel.tail p a value middle) := by
  unfold AspisR1Stage2.verifier.accumulateWithOps NBO_AccumulateAssociation.reference
    NBO_AccumulateAssociation.prefixRun NEV_TailModel.tail
  simp only [NBO_AccumulateAssociation.sourceOps,NBF_Accumulate.install,
    NBF_RowInstall.install,NBF_BasisInstall.install,NEV_TailModel.fields,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]

/-- Complete actual emitted function to the retained adopted accumulation,
with a concrete field dictionary proved in NEV_PrimitiveBindings. Every full
record field and Result tag is retained. There is no successful-run premise. -/
theorem reference (base : Ops) (p : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Prepared) (a : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Accumulator)
    (node : U32) (value : RawE) (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights)
    (width : a.weights.val.length=64) (raw : b.raw.val.length=64) (global : a.next.val<22)
    (hv : NBO_TailDomain.WideCanonical (toE value))
    (hr : NBO_TailDomain.WideCanonical (toE a.rhs))
    (hp : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical (toQ a.power))
    (hq : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical (toQ p.rho)) :
    (do let out ← NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node p a node value b
        ok (NEV_TailModel.toPair out)) =
      AspisR1Stage2.verifier.accumulateWithOps (NBO_AccumulateAssociation.reference (NEV_TailModel.fields base))
        (toPrepared p) (toAccumulator a) node (toE value) (toWeights b) := by
  rw [NEV_AccumulateTail.source_cut,reference_split]
  rw [← NEV_AccumulatePrefix.association (NEV_TailModel.fields base) a node b width raw global]
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]
  have continuations :
      (fun middle : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights =>
        do let out ← NEV_AccumulateTail.tail p a value middle;ok (NEV_TailModel.toPair out)) =
      (fun middle : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights =>
        NEV_TailModel.tail (toPrepared p) (toAccumulator a) (toE value) (toWeights middle)) := by
    funext middle
    exact NEV_TailModel.association p a value middle hv hr hp hq
  exact congrArg (fun next : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights →
      Result (verifier.Accumulator × verifier.BatchedWeights) =>
    do let middle ← NEV_AccumulateTail.rows a node b;next middle) continuations

/-- The already-proved NEI independent-counter theorem supplies the exact
native checked/wrapping join, including TX2's distinct local term counter. -/
theorem native (base : Ops) (p : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Prepared) (a : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Accumulator)
    (node : U32) (value : RawE) (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights)
    (width : a.weights.val.length=64) (raw : b.raw.val.length=64)
    (global : a.next.val<22) (localActive : b.terms.val<22)
    (hv : NBO_TailDomain.WideCanonical (toE value))
    (hr : NBO_TailDomain.WideCanonical (toE a.rhs))
    (hp : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical (toQ a.power))
    (hq : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical (toQ p.rho)) :
    (do let out ← NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node p a node value b
        ok (NEV_TailModel.toPair out)) =
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node
        (NBO_AccumulateAssociation.sourceOps (NEV_TailModel.fields base))
        (toPrepared p) (toAccumulator a) node (toE value) (toWeights b) := by
  have mappedWidth : (toAccumulator a).weights.val.length=64 := by
    simpa only [toAccumulator,mapVec,List.length_map] using width
  exact (reference base p a node value b width raw global hv hr hp hq).trans
    (NEI_AccumIndependentCounters.independent_counters (NEV_TailModel.fields base)
      (toPrepared p) (toAccumulator a) node (toE value) (toWeights b)
      mappedWidth raw global localActive).symm
#print axioms reference_split
#print axioms reference
#print axioms native
end NEV_AccumulateComplete
end

NEV_AccumulatePrefix.source:
import NEV_RowLoop
import NEV_BasisProducer
import NEV_AccumulateTail
import NEI_AccumIndependentCounters
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_AccumulatePrefix
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NEV_AccumulateCarriers
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody

theorem installs_commute (ops : Ops) :
    NBF_BasisInstall.install (NBF_RowInstall.install ops)=NBF_Accumulate.install ops := rfl

/-- Exact prefix including initialization, six-level basis production and all
64 rows. No successful prefix output is supplied as a hypothesis. -/
theorem association (ops : Ops) (a : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Accumulator) (node : U32)
    (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights) (width : a.weights.val.length=64)
    (raw : b.raw.val.length=64) (global : a.next.val<22) :
    (do let out ← NEV_AccumulateTail.rows a node b;ok (toWeights out)) =
      NBO_AccumulateAssociation.prefixRun ops (toAccumulator a) node (toWeights b) := by
  have rawWidth : alloc.vec.Vec.len a.weights=64#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq width
  have modelWidth : alloc.vec.Vec.len (toAccumulator a).weights=64#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    change (mapVec toQ a.weights).val.length=64
    simpa only [mapVec,List.length_map] using width
  have source : NEV_AccumulateTail.rows a node b=
      (do let basis ← NEV_BasisProducer.source node
          NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
            {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} a.weights a.power a.next b 64#usize basis) := by
    unfold NEV_AccumulateTail.rows NEV_BasisProducer.source
    rw [rawWidth]
    simp only [NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.ZERO,
      NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.ONE,bind_tc_ok,bind_assoc_eq]
  have target : NBO_AccumulateAssociation.prefixRun ops (toAccumulator a) node (toWeights b)=
      (do let basis ← NBF_BasisDomain.source (NBF_RowInstall.install ops) node
          verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
            {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} (mapVec toQ a.weights) (toQ a.power)
            a.next (toWeights b) 64#usize basis) := by
    unfold NBO_AccumulateAssociation.prefixRun NBF_BasisDomain.source
    rw [modelWidth]
    rw [installs_commute]
    rfl
  rw [source,target]
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq]
  rw [NEV_BasisProducer.association (NBF_RowInstall.install ops) node]
  have continuation :
      (fun basis : Array U32 256#usize =>
        do let out ← NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
             {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} a.weights a.power a.next b 64#usize basis
           ok (toWeights out)) =
      (fun basis : Array U32 256#usize =>
        verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (NBF_Accumulate.install ops)
          {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} (mapVec toQ a.weights) (toQ a.power)
          a.next (toWeights b) 64#usize basis) := by
    funext basis
    exact NEV_RowLoop.association (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops)
      a.weights a.power a.next basis 64 {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} b
      width raw rfl rfl global
  exact congrArg (fun continuation : Array U32 256#usize → Result AspisR1Stage2.verifier.BatchedWeights =>
    do let basis ← NBF_BasisDomain.source (NBF_RowInstall.install ops) node
       continuation basis) continuation
#print axioms installs_commute
#print axioms association
end NEV_AccumulatePrefix
end

NEV_RowLoop.source:
import NEV_RowStep
import Port3_NativeRowFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_RowLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow NEV_AccumulateCarriers
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
/-- Only control-flow/carrier transport is new. The imported push bridge and
its existing row arithmetic/phase induction are reused unchanged. -/
theorem association (ops : Ops) (v : alloc.vec.Vec RawQ) (power : RawQ) (next : Usize)
    (basis : Array U32 256#usize) (fuel : Nat) (iter : NEV_RowStep.Iter)
    (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights) (width : v.val.length=64)
    (raw : b.raw.val.length=64) (finish : iter.end=64#usize)
    (span : iter.start.val+fuel=64) (global : next.val<22) :
    (do let out ← NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
          iter v power next b 64#usize basis
        ok (toWeights out)) =
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (NBF_RowInstall.install ops)
        iter (mapVec toQ v) (toQ power) next (toWeights b) 64#usize basis := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter b with
  | zero =>
    have halt : iter.end.val≤ iter.start.val := by rw [finish];change 64≤ iter.start.val;omega
    obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,run,ho,hi⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_none_spec
        (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
        (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x y;rfl) iter halt)
    subst o
    unfold NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def,Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    dsimp only
    simp [NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body,
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body,run]
  | succ k ih =>
    have inside : iter.start.val<64 := by omega
    have mapped := NEV_RowStep.active ops v power next basis iter b width finish inside global
    unfold NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def,Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    dsimp only
    cases bodyRun : NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body
        v power next 64#usize basis iter b with
    | fail error =>
      have modelRun : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body (NBF_RowInstall.install ops)
          (mapVec toQ v) (toQ power) next 64#usize basis iter (toWeights b)=fail error := by
        simpa only [bodyRun,bind_tc_fail] using mapped.symm
      simp only [modelRun,bind_tc_fail]
    | div =>
      have modelRun : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body (NBF_RowInstall.install ops)
          (mapVec toQ v) (toQ power) next 64#usize basis iter (toWeights b)=div := by
        simpa only [bodyRun,bind_tc_div] using mapped.symm
      simp only [modelRun,bind_tc_div]
    | ok flow =>
      have modelRun : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body (NBF_RowInstall.install ops)
          (mapVec toQ v) (toQ power) next 64#usize basis iter (toWeights b)=ok (NEV_RowStep.mapFlow flow) := by
        simpa only [bodyRun,bind_tc_ok] using mapped.symm
      obtain ⟨iter1,after,shape,counter,endpoint,length,terms⟩ :=
        Port3_NativeRowFrame.body_fields (NBF_RowInstall.install ops)
          (mapVec toQ v) (toQ power) next 64#usize basis iter (toWeights b)
          (by rw [finish];exact inside)
          (by rw [finish];change 64≤b.raw.val.length;omega)
          (NEV_RowStep.mapFlow flow) modelRun
      cases flow with
      | done final => cases shape
      | cont pair =>
        rcases pair with ⟨cursor,result⟩
        have same : (cursor,toWeights result)=(iter1,after) := ControlFlow.cont.inj shape
        have cursors : cursor=iter1 := congrArg Prod.fst same
        have carriers : toWeights result=after := congrArg Prod.snd same
        rw [← cursors] at counter endpoint
        rw [← carriers] at length
        have size : result.raw.val.length=64 := by
          change result.raw.val.length=b.raw.val.length at length
          exact length.trans raw
        simp only [modelRun,NEV_RowStep.mapFlow,bind_tc_ok]
        exact ih cursor result size (endpoint.trans finish) (by omega)
#print axioms association
end NEV_RowLoop
end

NEV_RowStep.source:
import NEV_PushUse
import NEV_BorrowMaps
import NEV_CtorResults
import NBF_BasisInstall
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_RowStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow NEV_AccumulateCarriers
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
abbrev Iter := core.ops.range.Range Usize
abbrev RawFlow := ControlFlow (Iter × NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights) NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights
abbrev Flow := ControlFlow (Iter × AspisR1Stage2.verifier.BatchedWeights) AspisR1Stage2.verifier.BatchedWeights

def mapFlow : RawFlow → Flow
 | .cont (iter,b) => .cont (iter,toWeights b)
 | .done b => .done (toWeights b)

/-- One actual row iteration, preserving complete Result and returned BW.
Diagnostic conversions execute in the source, are total on all raw words,
and feed the deployed no-op trace; no diagnostic value is an observable. -/
theorem active (ops : Ops) (v : alloc.vec.Vec RawQ) (power : RawQ) (next : Usize)
    (basis : Array U32 256#usize) (iter : Iter) (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights)
    (width : v.val.length=64) (finish : iter.end=64#usize)
    (inside : iter.start.val<64) (global : next.val<22) :
    (do let out ← NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body
          v power next 64#usize basis iter b
        ok (mapFlow out)) =
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body (NBF_RowInstall.install ops)
        (mapVec toQ v) (toQ power) next 64#usize basis iter (toWeights b) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,run,ho,hs,he⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_some_spec
      (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
      (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x;rfl) (by intro x y;rfl)
      iter (by rw [finish];exact inside))
  subst o
  obtain ⟨word,basisRead,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.index_usize_spec basis iter.start (by change iter.start.val<basis.val.length;rw [basis.property];change iter.start.val<256;omega))
  obtain ⟨q,read,mappedRead⟩ := NEV_BorrowMaps.weight_read ops v iter.start (by omega)
  have mappedRead' : core.slice.index.Slice.index
      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice NBF_RowInstall.Q)
      (mapVec toQ v).deref iter.start=ok (toQ q) := mappedRead
  have multiplication := NBF_BasisInstall.checked_mul next 64#usize
    (by change next.val*64≤4096;omega)
  have productValue := Port3_Wrapping.wrap_mul_value next 64#usize
    (by change next.val*64≤4096;omega)
  have offset := Port3_Wrapping.checked_add (Usize.wrapping_mul next 64#usize) iter.start
    (by rw [productValue];change next.val*64+iter.start.val≤4096;omega)
  have use := NEV_PushUse.association b iter.start power word
  have lifted := congrArg (fun result : Result AspisR1Stage2.verifier.BatchedWeights =>
    do let out ← result;ok (cont (iter1,out) : Flow)) use
  simpa [NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body,
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body,NBF_RowInstall.install,
    run,NEV_AccumulateRaw.basis_at,basisRead,read,mappedRead',
    multiplication,offset,lift,NEV_CtorResults.qm,NEV_CtorResults.m31,
    NEV_AccumulateRaw.trace.value,bind_assoc_eq,mapFlow] using lifted

theorem stop (ops : Ops) (v : alloc.vec.Vec RawQ) (power : RawQ) (next width : Usize)
    (basis : Array U32 256#usize) (iter : Iter) (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights)
    (halt : iter.end.val≤ iter.start.val) :
    (do let out ← NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body
          v power next width basis iter b
        ok (mapFlow out)) =
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body (NBF_RowInstall.install ops)
        (mapVec toQ v) (toQ power) next width basis iter (toWeights b) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,run,ho,hi⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_none_spec
      (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
      (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x y;rfl) iter halt)
  subst o
  simp only [NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body,
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body,run,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl
#print axioms active
#print axioms stop
end NEV_RowStep
end

NEV_PushUse.source:
import NEV_AccumulateCallees
import NEI_PushRawAssociation
import Port3_NativeRowFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_PushUse
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NEV_AccumulateCarriers

def fromNEG (b : NEG_PushActual.BatchedWeights) : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.BatchedWeights :=
 ⟨b.raw,b.terms⟩

/-- Reuse the CLOSED NEI/NEG push association on the SAME carrier and inputs.
Only nominal record conversions compose here, preserving every Result tag.
The bounded row-domain obligation remains separately caller-established. -/
theorem association (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights) (index : Usize)
    (power : RawQ) (basis : U32) :
    (do let out ← NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights.push b index power basis
        ok (toWeights out)) =
      AspisR1.Port3_NativeRowFrame.push (toWeights b) index (toQ power) basis := by
  have base := NEI_PushRawAssociation.push
    (⟨b.raw,b.terms⟩ : NEI_PushRaw.BatchedWeights) index
    (NEV_AccumulateRaw.NEV_Bindings.toPushQ power) basis
  rw [NEG_PushAssociation.source] at base
  have lifted := congrArg (fun result : Result NEG_PushActual.BatchedWeights =>
    do let out ← result;ok (fromNEG out)) base
  simpa only [NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights.push,toWeights,fromNEG,
    NEI_PushRawAssociation.toBW,NEI_PushRawAssociation.toPower,
    NEV_AccumulateRaw.NEV_Bindings.toPushQ,toQ,
    AspisR1.Port3_NativeRowFrame.push,AspisR1.Port3_RowsInstall.toBW,
    AspisR1.Port3_RowsInstall.fromBW,AspisR1.Port3_RowsInstall.toK,
    NEG_RowAssociation.toOld,Port26ROW.toK,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok] using lifted
#print axioms association
end NEV_PushUse
end

NEV_AccumulateCallees.source:
import NEV_AccumulateRaw.FunsExternal
import NEV_AccumulateCarriers
import NEV_CodeFieldBridge
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_AccumulateCallees

NP6_StdModel.source:
import ClaimsUnrolledFinish

/-! Safe owned-reference std interpretation. The reserve result is the existing
allocator outcome, not an assumption of successful Claims. This module proves
value content laws only; P6 must connect shipped unsafe construction to this
reference before any native ledger row can be removed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.NP6_StdModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev ReserveError := AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.alloc.collections.TryReserveError
abbrev Reservation := core.result.Result Unit ReserveError

def calls (reservation : Reservation) : ClaimsUnrolledFinish.StdCalls where
  reserve := fun _ before _ => ok (reservation,before)
  intoBox := fun _ before => ok before.deref

theorem reserve_contents (reservation : Reservation) {T : Type} (A : Type)
    (before : alloc.vec.Vec T) (n : Usize) (result : Reservation)
    (after : alloc.vec.Vec T)
    (returned : (calls reservation).reserve A before n = ok (result,after)) :
    after = before ∧ result = reservation := by
  cases returned
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

theorem box_contents (reservation : Reservation) {T : Type} (A : Type)
    (before : alloc.vec.Vec T) (after : Slice T)
    (returned : (calls reservation).intoBox A before = ok after) :
    after.val = before.val := by
  cases returned
  rfl

theorem returning_nonvacuity {T : Type} (A : Type) (before : alloc.vec.Vec T)
    (n : Usize) :
    (calls (.Ok ())).reserve A before n = ok (.Ok (),before) ∧
    (calls (.Ok ())).intoBox A before = ok before.deref := ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

theorem error_contents (error : ReserveError) {T : Type} (A : Type)
    (before : alloc.vec.Vec T) (n : Usize) :
    (calls (.Err error)).reserve A before n = ok (.Err error,before) := rfl

#print axioms reserve_contents
#print axioms box_contents
#print axioms returning_nonvacuity
#print axioms error_contents
end AspisR1.NP6_StdModel
end

import ClaimsUnrolledParentRows
import S1ExtractedRoundChildrenV1
import S1SemanticFinishBoundsV1

/-! Install the complete emitted finite Claims VALUE interpretation in the
actual S1 finish consumer. Source getters and the existing full indexed decoder
are fixed. Native reserve/box ownership/error/cleanup/effect correspondence and
candidate adoption remain open; this file does not assert them as std trust.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.ClaimsUnrolledFinish
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev ParentQM := AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev MainQM := AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev ParentError := AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.Error
abbrev MainError := AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Error
abbrev MainPrefix := AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Prefix
abbrev MainRecord := AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord
abbrev MainClaims := Array (Array MainQM 29#usize) 3#usize

/-- Two unresolved operational placeholders in this VALUE interpretation.
No successful allocation, zero content, frame or Claims postcondition occurs
in this dictionary. Their actual-runtime instance is NOT proved here. The
explicit mapError/boxArray value models ALSO retain their native std,
ownership/error/abort/cleanup/effect correspondence obligations. -/
structure StdCalls where
  reserve : {T : Type} → (A : Type) → alloc.vec.Vec T → Usize →
    Result ((core.result.Result Unit AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.alloc.collections.TryReserveError) × alloc.vec.Vec T)
  intoBox : {T : Type} → (A : Type) → alloc.vec.Vec T → Result (Slice T)

def fromMainError : MainError → ParentError
  | .Allocation  => .Allocation
  | .RowOrder a b => .RowOrder a b
  | .InvalidRow  => .InvalidRow
  | .Tag row => .Tag row
  | .Length row => .Length row
  | .NonCanonical row offset => .NonCanonical row offset
  | .Boundary round => .Boundary round
  | .Terminal  => .Terminal
  | .EqualCirclePoints  => .EqualCirclePoints
  | .TrailingBytes  => .TrailingBytes
  | .Public  => .Public

def toMainError : ParentError → MainError
  | .Allocation  => .Allocation
  | .RowOrder a b => .RowOrder a b
  | .InvalidRow  => .InvalidRow
  | .Tag row => .Tag row
  | .Length row => .Length row
  | .NonCanonical row offset => .NonCanonical row offset
  | .Boundary round => .Boundary round
  | .Terminal  => .Terminal
  | .EqualCirclePoints  => .EqualCirclePoints
  | .TrailingBytes  => .TrailingBytes
  | .Public  => .Public

def fromMainQM (q : MainQM) : ParentQM := ⟨⟨q.c0.a,q.c0.b⟩,⟨q.c1.a,q.c1.b⟩⟩
def toMainQM (q : ParentQM) : MainQM := ⟨⟨q.c0.a,q.c0.b⟩,⟨q.c1.a,q.c1.b⟩⟩
def fromMainArray {n : Usize} (a : Array MainQM n) : Array ParentQM n :=
  ⟨a.val.map fromMainQM,by simpa using a.property⟩
def toMainArray {n : Usize} (a : Array ParentQM n) : Array MainQM n :=
  ⟨a.val.map toMainQM,by simpa using a.property⟩
def fromMainPrefix (p : MainPrefix) : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.Prefix :=
  ⟨p.c1_root,p.records⟩
def toMainPrefix (p : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.Prefix) : MainPrefix :=
  ⟨p.c1_root,p.records⟩
def toMainRecord (r : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord) : MainRecord :=
  ⟨r.row,r.framed⟩

def sourceRecord (p : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.Prefix) (row : U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord ParentError) :=
  match AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record (toMainPrefix p) row with
  | .ok (.Ok r) => .ok (.Ok ⟨r.row,r.framed⟩)
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (fromMainError e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

/-- Actual complete indexed decode_k body already selected by S1, including
all errors and ambient fail/div. No chosen decoder outcome is a parameter. -/
def sourceDecode (n : Usize) (r : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord)
    (offset : Usize) : Result (core.result.Result (Array ParentQM n) ParentError) :=
  match AspisS1ExtractedRoundChildren.decodeMain n (toMainRecord r) offset with
  | .ok (.Ok a) => .ok (.Ok (fromMainArray a))
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (fromMainError e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

def external (std : StdCalls) : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.External :=
  {reserve := std.reserve, intoBox := std.intoBox,
   validated := sourceRecord, decode := sourceDecode}

def toMainStatus :
    Result (core.result.Result AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.Claims ParentError) →
      Result (core.result.Result MainClaims MainError)
  | .ok (.Ok a) => .ok (.Ok ⟨a.val.map toMainArray,by simpa using a.property⟩)
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (toMainError e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

def claims (std : StdCalls) (pre : MainPrefix) : Result (core.result.Result MainClaims MainError) :=
  toMainStatus (AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.candidate_claims.claims (external std) (fromMainPrefix pre))

def reference (std : StdCalls) (pre : MainPrefix) : Result (core.result.Result MainClaims MainError) :=
  toMainStatus (AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.claimsReference (external std) (fromMainPrefix pre))

/-- Complete parent refinement with actual source getter/decoder installed.
No assertion about native allocation/cleanup or candidate adoption is added. -/
theorem claims_value (std : StdCalls) (pre : MainPrefix) :
    claims std pre = reference std pre :=
  congrArg toMainStatus (AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.claims_value (external std) (fromMainPrefix pre))

def install (std : StdCalls) (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries := {B with claims := claims std}

/-- Actual whole-finish success supplies this SAME Claims execution. No
separate accepted Claims equation, initialized storage or chosen rows premise.
All other finish children, native/std/refinement and release gates remain. -/
theorem finish_claims
    (std : StdCalls) (R : AspisR1PublicPreparation.RoundModel.Boundaries)
    (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries)
    {H : Type} (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : AspisR1PublicPreparation.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (pre : MainPrefix) (before : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H)
    (challenges : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Challenges)
    (obs : Option (AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (accepted : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.finish R (install std B)
      D pub pre before challenges obs = ok (.Ok out)) :
    reference std pre = ok (.Ok out.claims) := by
  obtain ⟨running,t25,record25,record26,z0,t26,z1,t27,
      rounds,challenge,state,transcript,called,rest⟩ :=
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.S1SemanticFinishBounds.finish_success R (install std B)
      D pub pre before challenges obs out accepted
  change claims std pre = ok (.Ok out.claims) at called
  rw [claims_value] at called
  exact called

#print axioms claims_value
#print axioms finish_claims
end AspisR1.ClaimsUnrolledFinish
end

import ExtractedSemanticRoundsModel

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisS1ExtractedRoundChildren
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev MainQM := AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.QM31

abbrev MainRecord := AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord

def recordToDecoder (r : MainRecord) : DecodeRecord := ⟨r.row, r.framed⟩

def decoderQMToMain (q : DecodeQM) : MainQM :=
  ⟨⟨q.c0.a, q.c0.b⟩, ⟨q.c1.a, q.c1.b⟩⟩

def decoderArrayToMain {n : Usize} (a : Array DecodeQM n) : Array MainQM n :=
  ⟨a.val.map decoderQMToMain, by simpa using a.property⟩

def decoderErrorToMain : DecodeError → MainError
  | .Allocation => .Allocation
  | .RowOrder a b => .RowOrder a b
  | .InvalidRow => .InvalidRow
  | .Tag row => .Tag row
  | .Length row => .Length row
  | .NonCanonical row offset => .NonCanonical row offset
  | .Boundary round => .Boundary round
  | .Terminal => .Terminal
  | .EqualCirclePoints => .EqualCirclePoints
  | .TrailingBytes => .TrailingBytes
  | .Public => .Public

def decoderResultToMain (n : Usize) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Array DecodeQM n) DecodeError) →
      Result (core.result.Result (Array MainQM n) MainError)
  | .ok (.Ok a) => .ok (.Ok (decoderArrayToMain a))
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (decoderErrorToMain e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

/-- A nominal adapter around the pinned actual indexed decode_k body. -/
def decodeMain (n : Usize) (r : MainRecord) (offset : Usize) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Array MainQM n) MainError) :=
  decoderResultToMain n
    (AspisR1DecodeKFullV10.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.decode_k n (recordToDecoder r) offset)


def mainToGen (q : MainQM) : GenQM :=
  ⟨⟨q.c0.a, q.c0.b⟩, ⟨q.c1.a, q.c1.b⟩⟩

def genToMain (q : GenQM) : MainQM :=
  ⟨⟨q.c0.a, q.c0.b⟩, ⟨q.c1.a, q.c1.b⟩⟩

def mainArrayToGen (xs : Array MainQM 28#usize) : Array GenQM 28#usize :=
  ⟨xs.val.map mainToGen, by simpa using xs.property⟩

def mainAlphaArrayToGen (xs : Array MainQM 10#usize) : Array GenQM 10#usize :=
  ⟨xs.val.map mainToGen, by simpa using xs.property⟩

def genResultToMain : Result GenQM → Result MainQM
  | .ok q => .ok (genToMain q)
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

def generatedMainBoundary (coefficients : Array MainQM 28#usize) : Result MainQM :=
  genResultToMain (AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.r1_semantic.semantic_boundary_entry
    (mainArrayToGen coefficients))

def generatedMainValue (coefficients : Array MainQM 28#usize)
    (alpha : Array MainQM 10#usize) (round : Usize) : Result MainQM :=
  genResultToMain (AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.r1_semantic.semantic_value_entry
    (mainArrayToGen coefficients) (mainAlphaArrayToGen alpha) round)

def generatedRoundBoundaries
    (decodeMain : (N : Usize) → AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord → Usize →
      Result (core.result.Result (Array MainQM N) AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Error)) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.RoundModel.Boundaries :=
  { decode := decodeMain
    boundary := generatedMainBoundary
    value := generatedMainValue }


/-- Full concrete extracted children. No child function remains a parameter.
Native fold control and parser/Rust/Std/abort interpretation retain their own
source pins and obligations; this definition does not assert that transport. -/
def children : AspisR1PublicPreparation.RoundModel.Boundaries :=
  generatedRoundBoundaries decodeMain

theorem decode_exact (n : Usize) (r : MainRecord) (offset : Usize) :
    children.decode n r offset = decoderResultToMain n
      (AspisR1DecodeKFullV10.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.decode_k n (recordToDecoder r) offset) := rfl

theorem boundary_exact (p : Array MainQM 28#usize) :
    children.boundary p = genResultToMain
      (AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.r1_semantic.semantic_boundary_entry (mainArrayToGen p)) := rfl

theorem value_exact (p : Array MainQM 28#usize) (a : Array MainQM 10#usize) (round : Usize) :
    children.value p a round = genResultToMain
      (AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.r1_semantic.semantic_value_entry
        (mainArrayToGen p) (mainAlphaArrayToGen a) round) := rfl

theorem coordinates_roundtrip (q : MainQM) : genToMain (mainToGen q) = q := by
  cases q with
  | mk c0 c1 => cases c0; cases c1; rfl

theorem preserve_failure (e : Error) :
    genResultToMain (.fail e) = .fail e := rfl

theorem preserve_divergence : genResultToMain .div = .div := rfl

#print axioms boundary_exact

import S1SemanticFinishModelV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.S1SemanticFinishBounds

private theorem bind_success {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k : α → Result β) (v : β)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok v) :
    ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h
private theorem pair_success {α β γ : Type} (m : Result (α × β))
    (k : α → β → Result γ) (v : γ)
    (h : (do let (a,b) ← m; k a b) = ok v) :
    ∃ a b, m = ok (a,b) ∧ k a b = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok p => cases p with | mk a b => exact ⟨a,b,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

/-- Actual complete finish success reaches its fixed actual rounds and both
source circle steps; returned alpha/challenges/state/transcript are those same
values. No rounds/circle/terminal child-success premise is assumed. -/
theorem finish_success (R : RoundModel.Boundaries) (B : FinishModel.Boundaries)
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public) (pre : r1_wire.Prefix)
    (before : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H) (challenges : r1_wire.Challenges)
    (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (out : r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (h : FinishModel.finish R B D pub pre before challenges obs = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ running t25 record25 record26 z0 t26 z1 t27,
      RoundModel.rounds R D pre before = ok (.Ok (running,out.alpha,t25)) ∧
      out.challenges = challenges ∧ out.state_before_z0 = t25.state ∧ out.transcript = t27 ∧
      B.claims pre = ok (.Ok out.claims) ∧
      r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record pre 25#u8 = ok (.Ok record25) ∧
      R.decode 29#usize record25 87#usize = ok (.Ok out.extra) ∧
      FinishModel.circle_validated B D t25 record25 = ok (.Ok z0,t26) ∧
      r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record pre 26#u8 = ok (.Ok record26) ∧
      R.decode 29#usize record26 0#usize = ok (.Ok out.before_z1) ∧
      FinishModel.circle_validated B D t26 record26 = ok (.Ok z1,t27) ∧
      out.z = Array.make 2#usize [z0,z1] := by
  unfold FinishModel.finish at h
  obtain ⟨roundsResult, hrounds, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  cases roundsResult with
  | Err e =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
    cases h
  | Ok val =>
    rcases val with ⟨running,alpha,t25⟩
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok,VerifyPrefix.mark] at h
    obtain ⟨claimsResult,hclaims,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    cases claimsResult with
    | Err e =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
        core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
      cases h
    | Ok claims =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨terminalResult,hterminal,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
      cases terminalResult with
      | Err e =>
        simp only [core.result.Result.map_err,FinishModel.closureFn11,FinishModel.closureFn10,
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
          core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
        cases h
      | Ok terminal =>
        simp only [core.result.Result.map_err,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
          bind_tc_ok,VerifyPrefix.mark] at h
        obtain ⟨mask16,hm16,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨mask10,hm10,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨claim0,hc0,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨claim27,hc27,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨mask,hm,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨record25Result,hr25,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        cases record25Result with
        | Err e =>
          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
            core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
          cases h
        | Ok record25 =>
          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
          obtain ⟨extraResult,hextra,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
          cases extraResult with
          | Err e =>
            simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
              core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
              core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
            cases h
          | Ok extra =>
            simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
            obtain ⟨etaTerminal,het,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨masked,hmasked,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨extra28,he28,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨maskedTerminal,hmt,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨different,hdiff,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            cases different with
            | true => cases h
            | false =>
              simp only [VerifyPrefix.mark,r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.impl.state,
                core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
              obtain ⟨circle0Result,t26,hz0,h⟩ := pair_success _ _ _ h
              cases circle0Result with
              | Err e =>
                simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                  core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                  core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                cases h
              | Ok z0 =>
                simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
                obtain ⟨record26Result,hr26,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                cases record26Result with
                | Err e =>
                  simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                    core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                  cases h
                | Ok record26 =>
                  simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
                  obtain ⟨beforeZ1Result,hbeforeZ1,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                  cases beforeZ1Result with
                  | Err e =>
                    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                      core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                    cases h
                  | Ok beforeZ1 =>
                    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
                    obtain ⟨circle1Result,t27,hz1,h⟩ := pair_success _ _ _ h
                    cases circle1Result with
                    | Err e =>
                      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                        core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                      cases h
                    | Ok z1 =>
                      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok,VerifyPrefix.mark] at h
                      obtain ⟨equal,hequal,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                      cases equal with
                      | true => cases h
                      | false =>
                        obtain ⟨rootResult,hroot,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                        cases rootResult with
                        | Err e =>
                          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                            core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                          cases h
                        | Ok rootPayload =>
                          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
                          obtain ⟨copied,hcopy,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                          obtain ⟨root2,hroot2,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                          have he := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj h)
                          cases he
                          exact ⟨running,t25,record25,record26,z0,t26,z1,t27,
                            hrounds,rfl,rfl,rfl,hclaims,hr25,hextra,hz0,hr26,hbeforeZ1,hz1,rfl⟩

#print axioms finish_success
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.S1SemanticFinishBounds

  fromFn : {T F : Type} → (N : Usize) → core.ops.function.FnMut F Usize T → F → Result (Array T N)
  mask : Array aspis_core.field.QM31 16#usize → Array aspis_core.field.QM31 10#usize →
    aspis_core.field.QM31 → Array aspis_core.field.QM31 10#usize → Result aspis_core.field.QM31
  add : aspis_core.field.QM31 → aspis_core.field.QM31 → Result aspis_core.field.QM31

def FinishModel.payload
  (self : r1_wire.Prefix) (row : Std.U8) :
  Result (core.result.Result (Slice Std.U8) r1_wire.Error)
  := do
  let r ← r1_wire.Prefix.record self row
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let s ←
      core.slice.index.Slice.index
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8) val
        { start := 5#usize }
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok s)
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      (Slice Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame r1_wire.Error) residual

def
  FinishModel.pointEq
  (self : aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint)
  (other : aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let b ← aspis_core.field.QM31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqQM31.eq self.x other.x
  if b
  then aspis_core.field.QM31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqQM31.eq self.y other.y

def FinishModel.circle_validated (B : FinishModel.Boundaries)
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
  (self : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H) (record1 : r1_wire.ValidatedRecord) :
  Result ((core.result.Result aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint
    r1_wire.Error) × (r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H))
  := do
  let row ← r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.impl.row record1
  match row with
  | 25#uscalar =>
    let s ← r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.impl.framed record1
    let (r, self1) ←
      r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated aspis_coreDigest32Inst
        self 25#u8 s
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let scp ← B.circle val FinishModel.CircleRow.First
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok scp, self1)
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      let r1 ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint (core.convert.FromSame
          r1_wire.Error) residual
      ok (r1, self1)
  | 26#uscalar =>
    let s ← r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.impl.framed record1
    let (r, self1) ←
      r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated aspis_coreDigest32Inst
        self 26#u8 s
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let scp ← B.circle val FinishModel.CircleRow.Second
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok scp, self1)
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      let r1 ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint (core.convert.FromSame
          r1_wire.Error) residual
      ok (r1, self1)
  | _ => ok (core.result.Result.Err r1_wire.Error.InvalidRow, self)

def
  FinishModel.closureFn2
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)

  FinishModel.closureFn3
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)

  Result aspis_core.field.QM31

    FinishModel.closureFn2

  aspis_core.field.QM31 := {

  FinishModel.closureFn10

def
  FinishModel.closureFn11
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H) :

  aspis_core.state_only_prefix.r0.Error r1_wire.Error := {
  call_once :=

def FinishModel.finish (R : RoundModel.Boundaries) (B : FinishModel.Boundaries)
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
  (public1 : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
  (prefix1 : r1_wire.Prefix) (transcript : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H)
  (challenges : r1_wire.Challenges)
  (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) :
  Result (core.result.Result (r1_semantic.Verified H) r1_wire.Error)
  := do
  let r ←
    RoundModel.rounds R aspis_coreDigest32Inst prefix1 transcript
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let (running, alpha, transcript1) := val
    VerifyPrefix.mark obs 2#u8
    let r1 ← B.claims prefix1
    let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
    match cf1 with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val1 =>
      let r2 ←
        B.terminal public1
          val1 alpha challenges
      let r3 ←
        core.result.Result.map_err
          (FinishModel.closureFn11
          aspis_coreDigest32Inst) r2 ()
      let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
      match cf2 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val2 =>
        VerifyPrefix.mark obs 3#u8
        let a ←
          B.fromFn 16#usize
            (FinishModel.closureFn9
            aspis_coreDigest32Inst) val1
        let a1 ←
          B.fromFn 10#usize
            (FinishModel.closureFn5
            aspis_coreDigest32Inst) val1
        let a2 ← Array.index_usize val1 0#usize
        let q ← Array.index_usize a2 27#usize
        let mask ←
          B.mask a a1 q
            alpha
        let r4 ← r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record prefix1 25#u8
        let cf3 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r4
        match cf3 with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue vr =>
          let r5 ← R.decode 29#usize vr 87#usize
          let cf4 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r5
          match cf4 with
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val3 =>
            let q1 ← B.mul challenges.eta val2
            let q2 ← B.add mask q1
            let q3 ← Array.index_usize val3 28#usize
            let masked_terminal ← B.add q2 q3
            let b ←
              core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default
                aspis_core.field.QM31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqQM31 running
                masked_terminal
            if b
            then ok (core.result.Result.Err r1_wire.Error.Terminal)
            else
              VerifyPrefix.mark obs 4#u8
              let state_before_z0 ←
                r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.impl.state aspis_coreDigest32Inst
                  transcript1
              let cf5 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r4
              match cf5 with
              | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue vr1 =>
                let (r6, transcript2) ←
                  FinishModel.circle_validated B
                    aspis_coreDigest32Inst transcript1 vr1

        (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame r1_wire.Error) residual

import NEV_AccumulateRaw.Types
import NBF_RowInstall
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_AccumulateCarriers
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev RawQ := NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev RawE := NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
abbrev Q := NBF_RowInstall.Q
abbrev E := NBF_RowInstall.E

def toQ (x : RawQ) : Q := ⟨⟨x.c0.a,x.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c1.a,x.c1.b⟩⟩
def fromQ (x : Q) : RawQ := ⟨⟨x.c0.a,x.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c1.a,x.c1.b⟩⟩
def toE (x : RawE) : E := ⟨toQ x.c0,toQ x.c1⟩
def fromE (x : E) : RawE := ⟨fromQ x.c0,fromQ x.c1⟩
def mapArray {A B : Type} {n : Usize} (f : A → B) (a : Array A n) : Array B n :=
 ⟨a.val.map f,by simpa only [List.length_map] using a.property⟩
def mapVec {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (a : alloc.vec.Vec A) : alloc.vec.Vec B :=
 ⟨a.val.map f,by simpa only [List.length_map] using a.property⟩

def toVariant (v : NEV_AccumulateRaw.transport.Variant) : AspisR1Stage2.transport.Variant :=
 match v with | .S1 => .S1 | .S2 => .S2 | .D => .D
def fromVariant (v : AspisR1Stage2.transport.Variant) : NEV_AccumulateRaw.transport.Variant :=
 match v with | .S1 => .S1 | .S2 => .S2 | .D => .D

def toPoint (p : NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint) : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint :=
 ⟨toQ p.x,toQ p.y⟩
def fromPoint (p : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint) : NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint :=
 ⟨fromQ p.x,fromQ p.y⟩

def toPrepared (p : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Prepared) : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Prepared :=
 ⟨toVariant p.variant,p.roots,toE p.gamma,toE p.kappa,mapArray toE p.alpha,
 toQ p.rho,p.queries,mapArray toQ p.semantic_alpha,mapArray toPoint p.z,toE p.claim,p.state⟩
def fromPrepared (p : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Prepared) : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Prepared :=
 ⟨fromVariant p.variant,p.roots,fromE p.gamma,fromE p.kappa,mapArray fromE p.alpha,
 fromQ p.rho,p.queries,mapArray fromQ p.semantic_alpha,mapArray fromPoint p.z,fromE p.claim,p.state⟩

def toAccumulator (a : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Accumulator) : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Accumulator :=
 ⟨mapVec toQ a.weights,toE a.rhs,toQ a.power,a.next⟩
def fromAccumulator (a : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Accumulator) : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Accumulator :=
 ⟨mapVec fromQ a.weights,fromE a.rhs,fromQ a.power,a.next⟩
def toWeights (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights) : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.BatchedWeights :=
 ⟨b.raw,b.terms⟩
def fromWeights (b : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.BatchedWeights) : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights :=
 ⟨b.raw,b.terms⟩

theorem q_roundtrip (x : RawQ) : fromQ (toQ x)=x := by cases x;rfl
theorem q_reverse (x : Q) : toQ (fromQ x)=x := by cases x;rfl
theorem e_roundtrip (x : RawE) : fromE (toE x)=x := by cases x;rfl
theorem e_reverse (x : E) : toE (fromE x)=x := by cases x;rfl
theorem weights_roundtrip (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights) : fromWeights (toWeights b)=b := by cases b;rfl
theorem weights_reverse (b : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.BatchedWeights) : toWeights (fromWeights b)=b := by cases b;rfl

/-- These are lossless maps of all fields, including fields not inspected by
this helper. No prepared-state projection is used as the output carrier. -/
theorem array_inverse {A B : Type} {n : Usize} (f : A → B) (g : B → A)
    (inverse : ∀ a,g (f a)=a) (a : Array A n) : mapArray g (mapArray f a)=a := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (a.val.map f).map g=a.val
  have law : ∀ values : List A,(values.map f).map g=values := by
    intro values
    induction values with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons head tail ih => simp only [_root_.List.map_cons,inverse,ih]
  exact law a.val
theorem vector_inverse {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (g : B → A)
    (inverse : ∀ a,g (f a)=a) (a : alloc.vec.Vec A) : mapVec g (mapVec f a)=a := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (a.val.map f).map g=a.val
  have law : ∀ values : List A,(values.map f).map g=values := by
    intro values
    induction values with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons head tail ih => simp only [_root_.List.map_cons,inverse,ih]
  exact law a.val
theorem point_roundtrip (p : NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint) :
    fromPoint (toPoint p)=p := by cases p;rfl
theorem point_reverse (p : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint) :
    toPoint (fromPoint p)=p := by cases p;rfl
theorem prepared_roundtrip (p : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Prepared) : fromPrepared (toPrepared p)=p := by
  cases p with
  | mk variant roots gamma kappa alpha rho queries semantic_alpha z claim state =>
    cases variant <;>
      simp only [toPrepared,fromPrepared,toVariant,fromVariant,e_roundtrip,q_roundtrip,
        array_inverse toE fromE e_roundtrip,array_inverse toQ fromQ q_roundtrip,
        array_inverse toPoint fromPoint point_roundtrip]
theorem prepared_reverse (p : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Prepared) : toPrepared (fromPrepared p)=p := by
  cases p with
  | mk variant roots gamma kappa alpha rho queries semantic_alpha z claim state =>
    cases variant <;>
      simp only [toPrepared,fromPrepared,toVariant,fromVariant,e_reverse,q_reverse,
        array_inverse fromE toE e_reverse,array_inverse fromQ toQ q_reverse,
        array_inverse fromPoint toPoint point_reverse]
theorem accumulator_roundtrip (a : NEV_AccumulateRaw.Accumulator) : fromAccumulator (toAccumulator a)=a := by
  cases a
  simp only [toAccumulator,fromAccumulator,e_roundtrip,q_roundtrip,
    vector_inverse toQ fromQ q_roundtrip]
theorem accumulator_reverse (a : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Accumulator) : toAccumulator (fromAccumulator a)=a := by
  cases a
  simp only [toAccumulator,fromAccumulator,e_reverse,q_reverse,
    vector_inverse fromQ toQ q_reverse]
#print axioms array_inverse
#print axioms vector_inverse
#print axioms point_roundtrip
#print axioms point_reverse
#print axioms prepared_roundtrip
#print axioms prepared_reverse
#print axioms accumulator_roundtrip
#print axioms accumulator_reverse

#print axioms q_roundtrip
#print axioms q_reverse
#print axioms e_roundtrip
#print axioms e_reverse
#print axioms weights_roundtrip
#print axioms weights_reverse
end NEV_AccumulateCarriers
end

import NBF_LoopFrame
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBF_RowInstall
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
abbrev Q := aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev E := Stage2E
def zeroQ : Q := ⟨⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩,⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩⟩
def embedQ (q : Q) : E := ⟨q,zeroQ⟩
def embedM (m : U32) : E := ⟨⟨⟨m,0#u32⟩,⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩⟩,zeroQ⟩
/-- Explicit direct cohort row callbacks. Native embedding correspondence is
checked separately on canonical inputs; no arbitrary callback is hidden. -/
def install (ops : Ops) : Ops :=
 {ops with
  op1:=fun q=>ok (embedQ q)
  op10:=fun m=>ok (embedM m)
  op12:=fun s j=>core.slice.index.Slice.index
    (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Q) s j
  op13:=fun basis j=>Array.index_usize basis j
  op14:=Port3_NativeRowFrame.push
  op15:=fun _ _ _=>ok ()}

theorem body (ops : Ops) (v : alloc.vec.Vec Q) (q : Q) (next : Usize)
 (basis : Array U32 256#usize) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize)
 (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (x : Fin 4 → U64)
 (width : iter.end.val=64) (active : iter.start.val<64)
 (v64 : v.val.length=64)
 (inv : NBB_Sweep.Inv b.terms.val iter.start.val b.raw)
 (read : b.raw.val[iter.start.val]?=some (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.makeRow x))
 (hq : ∀ k, (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb (Port3_RowsInstall.toK q) k).val<2^31-1)
 (hb : ∀ j : Usize, j.val<64 → ∀ m, Array.index_usize basis j=ok m → m.val<2^31-1) :
 ∃ iter1 row,
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body (install ops)
   v q next 64#usize basis iter b=
   ok (cont (iter1,{b with raw:=b.raw.set iter.start row})) ∧
 iter1.start.val=iter.start.val+1 ∧ iter1.end=iter.end ∧
 NBB_Sweep.Inv b.terms.val (iter.start.val+1) (b.raw.set iter.start row) := by
 obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,hr,ho,hs,he⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_some_spec
    (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
    (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x;rfl) (by intro x y;rfl)
    iter (by omega))
 subst o
 obtain ⟨m,hm,hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (Array.index_usize_spec basis iter.start (by change iter.start.val < basis.val.length;rw [basis.property];change iter.start.val<256;omega))
 obtain ⟨y,hpush,hinv,frame⟩ := NBF_Read.push (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b)
   iter.start (Port3_RowsInstall.toK q) m x inv read hq (hb iter.start active m hm)
 have push : Port3_NativeRowFrame.push b iter.start q m=
   ok {b with raw:=b.raw.set iter.start (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.makeRow y)} := by
   simp only [Port3_NativeRowFrame.push,hpush,bind_tc_ok]
   rfl
 obtain ⟨word,hw,hword⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec v iter.start (by change iter.start.val<v.val.length;omega))
 have hw' : core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Q)
   v.deref iter.start=ok word := hw
 refine ⟨iter1,S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.makeRow y,?_,hs,he,hinv⟩
 simp [verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body,hr,install,hm,push,hw',lift]

end NBF_RowInstall

import NBF_RowContext
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBF_LoopFrame
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2
open Port3_NativeQueryBody
theorem append {start count n : Nat} {before mid after : NBF_Frame.Raw}
 (prior : NBF_Frame.Writes start count before mid)
 (following : NBF_Frame.Writes (start+count) n mid after) :
 NBF_Frame.Writes start (count+n) before after := by
 induction following with
 | nil => simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using prior
 | @step c first last p index row cursor inside ih =>
   have cursor1 : index.val=start+(count+c) := by omega
   simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using
     NBF_Frame.Writes.step (ih prior) index row cursor1 inside

/-- Actual emitted row traversal constructs the linked setter trace. No
complete vector frame or preselected output is a hypothesis. -/
theorem writes (ops : Ops) (v : alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.QM31)
 (q : aspis_core.field.QM31) (next width : Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
 (fuel : Nat) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (b out : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (span : iter.start.val+fuel=iter.end.val) (bound : iter.end.val≤b.raw.val.length)
 (accepted : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (Port3_NativeRowFrame.install ops)
   iter v q next b width basis=ok out) :
 NBF_Frame.Writes iter.start.val fuel b.raw out.raw ∧ out.terms=b.terms := by
 induction fuel generalizing iter b with
 | zero =>
   unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 at accepted
   rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def] at accepted
   simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at accepted
   have halt := Port3_NativeRowLoop.stopped (Port3_NativeRowFrame.install ops)
     v q next width basis iter b (by omega)
   simp only [halt,bind_tc_ok] at accepted
   cases Result.ok.inj accepted
   exact ⟨.nil _ _,rfl⟩
 | succ n ih =>
   unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 at accepted
   rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def] at accepted
   simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at accepted
   generalize step : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body
     (Port3_NativeRowFrame.install ops) v q next width basis iter b = r at accepted
   cases r with
   | fail e => cases accepted
   | div => cases accepted
   | ok cf =>
     obtain ⟨iter1,row,same,hs,he⟩ := NBF_RowContext.body_write
       ops v q next width basis iter b (by omega) bound cf step
     subst cf
     change verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (Port3_NativeRowFrame.install ops)
       iter1 v q next {b with raw:=b.raw.set iter.start row} width basis=ok out at accepted
     have bound1 : iter1.end.val≤(b.raw.set iter.start row).val.length := by
       change iter1.end.val ≤ (b.raw.val.set iter.start.val row).length
       rw [List.length_set,he];exact bound
     obtain ⟨tail,terms⟩ := ih iter1 {b with raw:=b.raw.set iter.start row}
       (by rw [he];omega) bound1 accepted
     refine ⟨?_,terms⟩
     -- Prepend the first setter to the recursively constructed suffix.
     have first : NBF_Frame.Writes iter.start.val 1 b.raw
       (b.raw.set iter.start row) :=
       .step (.nil _ _) iter.start row (by omega) (by omega)
     have tail1 : NBF_Frame.Writes (iter.start.val+1) n
       (b.raw.set iter.start row) out.raw := by simpa only [hs] using tail
     simpa only [Nat.add_comm 1 n] using append first tail1

/-- All rows outside the actual emitted traversal window retain their original
contents, including arbitrary suffixes. Length and terms are also unchanged. -/
theorem frame (ops : Ops) (v : alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.QM31)
 (q : aspis_core.field.QM31) (next width : Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
 (fuel : Nat) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (b out : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (span : iter.start.val+fuel=iter.end.val) (bound : iter.end.val≤b.raw.val.length)
 (accepted : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (Port3_NativeRowFrame.install ops)
   iter v q next b width basis=ok out) :
 out.raw.val.length=b.raw.val.length ∧ out.terms=b.terms ∧
 ∀ j, j < iter.start.val ∨ iter.end.val≤j → out.raw.val[j]?=b.raw.val[j]? := by
 obtain ⟨trace,terms⟩ := writes ops v q next width basis fuel iter b out span bound accepted
 exact ⟨NBF_Frame.length trace,terms,fun j outside =>
   NBF_Frame.outside trace j (by omega)⟩
#print axioms append
#print axioms writes
#print axioms frame
end NBF_LoopFrame

import NBF_Read
import Port3_NativeRowLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBF_RowContext
open AspisR1Stage2
open AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryBody
open AspisR1
/-- Successful actual owned push is exactly one setter at the reached index.
The setter is derived by inverting its concrete continuation. -/
theorem push_write (b out : verifier.BatchedWeights) (j : Usize)
 (q : aspis_core.field.QM31) (m : U32) (inRange : j.val<b.raw.val.length)
 (run : Port3_NativeRowFrame.push b j q m=ok out) :
 ∃ row : NBF_Frame.Row, out={b with raw:=b.raw.set j row} := by
 unfold Port3_NativeRowFrame.push at run
 obtain ⟨mid,hpush,finish⟩ := AspisR1.Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ run
 unfold S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned at hpush
 obtain ⟨old,hread,hpush⟩ := AspisR1.Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ hpush
 obtain ⟨flag,hflag,hpush⟩ := AspisR1.Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ hpush
 obtain ⟨row,hrow,hpush⟩ := AspisR1.Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ hpush
 obtain ⟨⟨borrowed,back⟩,hborrow,hpush⟩ := AspisR1.Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ hpush
 obtain ⟨⟨borrowed1,back1⟩,hmut,_,hback⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_usize_spec b.raw j inRange)
 have eq : (borrowed,back)=(borrowed1,back1) := by
   have same : alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice NBF_Frame.Row)
     b.raw j=ok (borrowed1,back1) := by
       rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_slice_index];exact hmut
   exact Result.ok.inj (hborrow.symm.trans same)
 cases eq
 cases Result.ok.inj hpush
 cases Result.ok.inj finish
 exact ⟨row,by simp only [AspisR1.Port3_RowsInstall.toBW,
   AspisR1.Port3_RowsInstall.fromBW,hback]⟩

/-- One actual emitted row-loop body reaches one owned setter; all earlier
and later trace operations are retained in the observed successful body. -/
theorem body_write (ops : Ops) (v : alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.QM31)
 (q : aspis_core.field.QM31) (next width : Usize)
 (basis : Array U32 256#usize) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize)
 (b : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (active : iter.start.val < iter.end.val) (bound : iter.end.val≤b.raw.val.length)
 (out : ControlFlow (core.ops.range.Range Usize × verifier.BatchedWeights) verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (run : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body
   (Port3_NativeRowFrame.install ops) v q next width basis iter b=ok out) :
 ∃ iter1 row, out=cont (iter1,{b with raw:=b.raw.set iter.start row}) ∧
   iter1.start.val=iter.start.val+1 ∧ iter1.end=iter.end := by
 obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,hr,ho,hs,he⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_some_spec
     (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
     (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x;rfl) (by intro x y;rfl) iter active)
 subst o
 unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body at run
 rw [hr] at run
 simp only [bind_tc_ok] at run
 obtain ⟨m,hm,run⟩ := AspisR1.Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ run
 obtain ⟨b1,hpush,run⟩ := AspisR1.Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ run
 obtain ⟨row,same⟩ := push_write b b1 iter.start q m (by omega) hpush
 subst b1
 iterate 9 obtain ⟨x,hx,run⟩ := AspisR1.Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ run
 exact ⟨iter1,row,(Result.ok.inj run).symm,hs,he⟩
#print axioms push_write
#print axioms body_write
end NBF_RowContext

/-- The actual checked Vec read follows from the SAME list observation;
it is no longer a separate caller-supplied success. -/
theorem indexed (raw : NBF_Frame.Raw) (index : Usize) (row : NBF_Frame.Row)
 (read : raw.val[index.val]?=some row) :
 alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice NBF_Frame.Row)
   raw index=ok row := by
 have hi := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp read).1
 obtain ⟨value,run,hvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec raw index hi)
 have eq : value=row := by
   have get : raw.val[index.val]?=some value := by
     rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi]
     exact congrArg some hvalue.symm
   exact Option.some.inj (get.symm.trans read)
 rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index]
 simpa only [eq] using run

theorem push (weights : BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (power : K)
 (basis : U32) (x : Fin 4 → U64)
 (inv : NBB_Sweep.Inv weights.terms.val index.val weights.raw)
 (read : weights.raw.val[index.val]?=some (makeRow x))
 (hc : ∀ k, (powerLimb power k).val<2^31-1) (hb : basis.val<2^31-1) :
 ∃ y : Fin 4 → U64,
 S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned weights index power basis=
   ok {weights with raw:=weights.raw.set index (makeRow y)} ∧
 NBB_Sweep.Inv weights.terms.val (index.val+1)
   (weights.raw.set index (makeRow y)) ∧
 (∀ j, j≠index.val →
   (weights.raw.set index (makeRow y)).val[j]?=weights.raw.val[j]?) :=
 NBF_Domain.push weights index power basis x inv read
   (indexed weights.raw index (makeRow x) read) hc hb

import NBF_Frame
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBF_Domain
open S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop (BatchedWeights K)
open S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement (makeRow powerLimb)
/-- The reached cursor invariant establishes the row leaf's exact phase domain.
The SAME indexed read supplies the four row words. -/
theorem row_domain (weights : BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (x : Fin 4 → U64)
 (inv : NBB_Sweep.Inv weights.terms.val index.val weights.raw)
 (read : weights.raw.val[index.val]?=some (makeRow x)) :
 ∀ k, NBB_Phase.Bound weights.terms.val (x k).val := by
 have bound := inv index.val (makeRow x) read
 have own : NBB_Sweep.Bound weights.terms.val (makeRow x) := by
   simpa only [Nat.lt_irrefl,if_false] using bound
 intro k
 apply own (x k)
 fin_cases k <;> simp [makeRow,Array.make]

/-- Every call to the inherited source theorem discharges the phase premise
from that reached cursor, rather than assuming a stronger per-row bound. -/
theorem push (weights : BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (power : K)
 (basis : U32) (x : Fin 4 → U64)
 (inv : NBB_Sweep.Inv weights.terms.val index.val weights.raw)
 (read : weights.raw.val[index.val]?=some (makeRow x))
 (nativeRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice S7Kani2OwnedRow.Row)
   weights.raw index=ok (makeRow x))
 (hc : ∀ k, (powerLimb power k).val<2^31-1) (hb : basis.val<2^31-1) :
 ∃ y : Fin 4 → U64,
 S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned weights index power basis=
   ok {weights with raw:=weights.raw.set index (makeRow y)} ∧
 NBB_Sweep.Inv weights.terms.val (index.val+1)
   (weights.raw.set index (makeRow y)) ∧
 (∀ j, j≠index.val →
   (weights.raw.set index (makeRow y)).val[j]?=weights.raw.val[j]?) := by
 have inRange := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp read).1
 obtain ⟨y,run,value,done⟩ := NBB_Push.source weights index power basis x
   inRange nativeRead hc hb (row_domain weights index x inv read)
 exact ⟨y,run,NBB_Push.sweep weights index (makeRow y) inv done,
   fun j different => NBF_Frame.set_frame _ _ _ _ different⟩

#print axioms row_domain
#print axioms push
end NBF_Domain

import NBB_Push
import NBB_RowTrace
import NBB_RowWitness
import NBB_Finish
import NBB_QueryTrace
import NBB_QueryWitness
import NBB_Cohort
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBF_Frame
abbrev Row := Array U64 4#usize
abbrev Raw := NBB_Sweep.Raw
/-- Linked single-row writes on the SAME vector; no whole-vector frame is a premise. -/
inductive Writes : Nat → Nat → Raw → Raw → Prop
 | nil (start : Nat) (raw : Raw) : Writes start 0 raw raw
 | step {start count : Nat} {before mid : Raw}
   (prior : Writes start count before mid) (index : Usize) (row : Row)
   (atCursor : index.val=start+count) (inRange : index.val<mid.val.length) :
   Writes start (count+1) before (mid.set index row)

theorem set_frame (raw : Raw) (index : Usize) (row : Row) (j : Nat)
 (different : j≠index.val) :
 (raw.set index row).val[j]?=raw.val[j]? := by
 change (raw.val.set index.val row)[j]?=raw.val[j]?
 simp only [List.getElem?_set,if_neg different,if_neg (Ne.symm different)]

theorem length {start count : Nat} {before after : Raw}
 (trace : Writes start count before after) : after.val.length=before.val.length := by
 induction trace with
 | nil => rfl
 | step prior index row atCursor inRange ih =>
   change (List.set _ _ _).length=_
   rw [List.length_set,ih]

/-- A window of row writes retains every position outside that window. -/
theorem outside {start count : Nat} {before after : Raw}
 (trace : Writes start count before after) (j : Nat)
 (disjoint : j<start ∨ start+count≤j) : after.val[j]?=before.val[j]? := by
 induction trace with
 | nil => rfl
 | step prior index row atCursor inRange ih =>
   rw [set_frame _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
   exact ih (by omega)

/-- The native row stride is four U64 words. Disjoint row indices give
non-overlapping word windows, without evaluating a 64-row buffer. -/
theorem windows (i j : Nat) (different : i≠j) :
 4*i+4≤4*j ∨ 4*j+4≤4*i := by omega

#print axioms set_frame
#print axioms length
#print axioms outside
#print axioms windows
end NBF_Frame

import NBB_Row

import S7Kani2OwnedPushModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBB_Push
open S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop (BatchedWeights K)
open S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement (makeRow powerLimb)
/-- Total owned Vec push and SAME row-phase advance. There is no successful
callee assumption and no restriction on the other raw rows. -/
theorem source (weights : BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (power : K)
 (basis : U32) (x : Fin 4 → U64)
 (hi : index.val<weights.raw.length)
 (read : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice S7Kani2OwnedRow.Row)
   weights.raw index=ok (makeRow x))
 (hc : ∀ k, (powerLimb power k).val<2^31-1) (hb : basis.val<2^31-1)
 (phase : ∀ k, NBB_Phase.Bound weights.terms.val (x k).val) :
 ∃ y : Fin 4 → U64,
 S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned weights index power basis=
  ok {weights with raw:=weights.raw.set index (makeRow y)} ∧
 (∀ k, (y k).val=AspisR1BatchedFoldSourceStep.sourcePush weights.terms.val (x k).val
   ((powerLimb power k).val*basis.val)) ∧
 NBB_Sweep.Bound (weights.terms.val+1) (makeRow y) := by
 obtain ⟨y,run,value,bounds⟩ := NBB_Row.source x power basis weights.terms.val hc hb phase
 have row : S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned (makeRow x) power basis
  ((weights.terms &&& 3#usize)=3#usize)=ok (makeRow y) := by
  simpa only [S7Kani2OwnedPushModel.phase_flag] using run
 refine ⟨y,S7Kani2OwnedPushModel.push_of_row weights index power basis _ _ hi read row,value,?_⟩
 intro word mem
 simp only [makeRow,Array.make,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at mem
 rcases mem with rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl <;> exact bounds _

/-- The row cursor moves without incrementing the transaction's term count. -/
theorem sweep (weights : BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (row : S7Kani2OwnedRow.Row)
 (inv : NBB_Sweep.Inv weights.terms.val index.val weights.raw)
 (done : NBB_Sweep.Bound (weights.terms.val+1) row) :
 NBB_Sweep.Inv weights.terms.val (index.val+1) (weights.raw.set index row) :=
 NBB_Sweep.update weights.terms.val index.val weights.raw row index rfl inv done
#print axioms source
#print axioms sweep
end NBB_Push

/-- Total four-limb emitted transition and its next phase, on arbitrary inputs
satisfying the actual canonical/periodic caller invariant. -/
theorem source (x : Fin 4 → U64) (power : S7Kani2OwnedRow.K)
 (basis : U32) (terms : Nat)
 (hc : ∀ j, (powerLimb power j).val<2^31-1)
 (hb : basis.val<2^31-1) (hp : ∀ j, NBB_Phase.Bound terms (x j).val) :
 ∃ y : Fin 4 → U64,

 (∀ j, (y j).val=AspisR1BatchedFoldSourceStep.sourcePush terms (x j).val
   ((powerLimb power j).val*basis.val)) ∧
 (∀ j, NBB_Phase.Bound (terms+1) (y j).val) := by

 refine ⟨y,run,value,?_⟩
 intro j

 (ha : S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned (makeRow x) power basis (decide (terms%4=3))=ok a)

import S7OwnedP6ScalarProof
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBB_Phase
open AspisR1BatchedFoldSourceStep

def Bound (terms raw : Nat) : Prop := raw < 2^34+(terms%4)*(2^31-2)^2

/-- The actual four-query flushing cadence preserves its exact envelope. -/
theorem next (terms raw a b : Nat) (ha : a<2^31-1) (hb : b<2^31-1)
 (hr : Bound terms raw) : Bound (terms+1) (sourcePush terms raw (a*b)) := by
 have product := product_bound ha hb
 change a*b≤(2^31-2)^2 at product
 have phase : terms%4<4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
 have safe : raw+a*b<2^64 := by
  have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ((2^31-2)^2) (show terms%4≤3 by omega)
  unfold Bound at hr
  omega
 unfold Bound sourcePush
 split
 · have folded := fold_lt_two34 safe
   omega
 · have hn : (terms+1)%4=terms%4+1 := by omega
   rw [hn]
   unfold Bound at hr
   omega

/-- The scalar fragment is total on the SAME caller phase domain. -/
theorem scalar (raw : U64) (a b : U32) (terms : Nat)
 (ha : a.val<2^31-1) (hb : b.val<2^31-1) (hr : Bound terms raw.val) :
 ∃ out : U64,
 S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned raw a b (decide (terms%4=3))=ok out ∧
 out.val=sourcePush terms raw.val (a.val*b.val) ∧ Bound (terms+1) out.val := by
 obtain ⟨out,run,value⟩ := S7OwnedP6ScalarProof.scalar_eq_source_push raw a b terms ha hb hr
 exact ⟨out,run,value,by rw [value];exact next terms raw.val a.val b.val ha hb hr⟩

/-- A native-compatible value is unique, including its full U64 carrier. -/
theorem unique (raw : U64) (a b : U32) (t : Nat) (x y : U64)
 (hx : x.val=sourcePush t raw.val (a.val*b.val))
 (hy : y.val=sourcePush t raw.val (a.val*b.val)) : x=y := by
 apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
 exact hx.trans hy.symm

#print axioms next
#print axioms scalar
#print axioms unique
end NBB_Phase
