import NBB_Phase
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBB_Sweep
def Bound (t : Nat) (row : Array U64 4#usize) : Prop := ∀ x∈row.val, NBB_Phase.Bound t x.val
abbrev Raw := alloc.vec.Vec (Array U64 4#usize)
/-- Rows before the real cursor have advanced; all other rows retain the
current query's phase. The query term counter is incremented only afterwards. -/
def Inv (t cursor : Nat) (raw : Raw) : Prop := ∀ j row,
 raw.val[j]?=some row → Bound (if j<cursor then t+1 else t) row

theorem initial (t : Nat) (raw : Raw) (phase : ∀ row∈raw.val,Bound t row) : Inv t 0 raw := by
 intro j row get
 simpa only [Nat.not_lt_zero,if_false] using phase row (List.mem_of_getElem? get)
/-- One setter advances precisely the newly processed row; all other rows
retain their previous phase and position, including arbitrary suffixes. -/
theorem update (t j : Nat) (raw : Raw) (row : (Array U64 4#usize)) (i : Usize)
 (same : i.val=j) (inv : Inv t j raw) (done : Bound (t+1) row) :
 Inv t (j+1) (raw.set i row) := by
 intro k value get
 change (raw.val.set i.val row)[k]?=some value at get
 by_cases eq : k=j
 · subst k
   have len : j<raw.val.length := by
    have len : j<(raw.val.set i.val row).length := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp get).1
    simpa only [List.length_set] using len
   rw [same,List.getElem?_set_self len] at get
   cases Option.some.inj get
   simpa only [Nat.lt_succ_self,if_true] using done
 · have get0 : raw.val[k]?=some value := by
    simpa only [same,List.getElem?_set,if_neg eq,if_neg (Ne.symm eq)] using get
   have old := inv k value get0
   have iff : (k<j+1)↔k<j := by omega
   simpa only [iff] using old

theorem final (t width : Nat) (raw : Raw) (len : raw.val.length≤width)
 (inv : Inv t width raw) : ∀ row∈raw.val,Bound (t+1) row := by
 intro row mem
 obtain ⟨j,get⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem?.mp mem
 have lt : j<width := by have := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp get).1;omega
 simpa only [if_pos lt] using inv j row get
#print axioms initial
#print axioms update
#print axioms final
end NBB_Sweep

NBB_RowTrace.source:
import NBB_Row
import S7OwnedP6RowContract
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBB_RowTrace
abbrev Row := Fin 4 → Nat
/-- One native store and its complete pointwise frame. -/
def Frame (j : Fin 4) (value : Nat) (before after : Row) : Prop :=
 ∀ k, after k=if k=j then value else before k
inductive Steps (step : Fin 4 → Row → Nat) : List (Fin 4) → Row → Row → Prop
 | nil (r : Row) : Steps step [] r r
 | cons {j js before middle after}
   (head : Frame j (step j before) before middle)
   (tail : Steps step js middle after) : Steps step (j::js) before after

theorem frame_unique (j : Fin 4) (value : Nat) (before after : Row)
 (frame : Frame j value before after) : after=Function.update before j value := by
 funext k
 rw [frame]
 by_cases same : k=j
 · subst k; simp
 · simp [Function.update_of_ne same,same]

theorem steps_result (step : Fin 4 → Row → Nat) (indices : List (Fin 4)) (before after : Row)
 (trace : Steps step indices before after) :
 after=indices.foldl (fun row j => Function.update row j (step j row)) before := by
 induction trace with
 | nil => rfl
 | cons head tail ih => rw [List.foldl_cons,←frame_unique _ _ _ _ head];exact ih

/-- Linked native add/store and fold/store steps give the entire source row,
without a supplied final row equation. -/
theorem source_result (before limbs : Row) (basis : Nat) (flush : Bool)
 (added after : Row)
 (adds : Steps (fun j row => row j+limbs j*basis) [0,1,2,3] before added)
 (folds : if flush then Steps (fun j row => AspisV8R17.RawReducer.foldBits (row j))
   [0,1,2,3] added after else after=added) :
 after=S7OwnedP6RowContract.reference before limbs basis flush := by
 have ha := steps_result _ _ _ _ adds
 cases flush with
 | false =>
   change after=added at folds
   rw [folds,ha]
   exact S7OwnedP6RowContract.four_lane_fusion before limbs basis false
 | true =>
   change Steps _ _ added after at folds
   rw [steps_result _ _ _ _ folds,ha]
   exact S7OwnedP6RowContract.four_lane_fusion before limbs basis true

/-- The full native four-word output is exactly the emitted cohort result.
Only one-store traces enter; native frame gates and scalar laws construct them. -/
theorem native_result (before out : Fin 4 → U64) (power : S7Kani2OwnedRow.K)
 (basis : U32) (terms : Nat) (added : Row)
 (hc : ∀ j, (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb power j).val<2^31-1)
 (hb : basis.val<2^31-1) (hp : ∀ j, NBB_Phase.Bound terms (before j).val)
 (adds : Steps (fun j row => row j+
   (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb power j).val*basis.val)
   [0,1,2,3] (fun j => (before j).val) added)
 (folds : if decide (terms%4=3) then
   Steps (fun j row => AspisV8R17.RawReducer.foldBits (row j))
     [0,1,2,3] added (fun j => (out j).val)
   else (fun j => (out j).val)=added) :
 S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.makeRow before) power basis
  (decide (terms%4=3))=ok (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.makeRow out) := by
 have values := source_result (fun j => (before j).val)
  (fun j => (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb power j).val)
  basis.val (decide (terms%4=3)) added (fun j => (out j).val) adds folds
 have model := S7OwnedP6RowContract.source_eq_batched_model
  (fun j => (before j).val) (fun j => (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb power j).val) basis.val terms
 have fused := S7OwnedP6RowContract.four_lane_fusion
  (fun j => (before j).val) (fun j => (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb power j).val)
  basis.val (decide (terms%4=3))
 obtain ⟨y,run,hy,_⟩ := NBB_Row.source before power basis terms hc hb hp
 have same : out=y := by
  funext j
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  have v := congrFun (values.trans (fused.symm.trans model)) j
  exact v.trans (hy j).symm
 simpa only [same] using run
#print axioms frame_unique
#print axioms steps_result
#print axioms source_result
#print axioms native_result
end NBB_RowTrace

import NBB_RowTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBB_RowWitness
open NBB_RowTrace

theorem steps (step : Fin 4 → Row → Nat) (indices : List (Fin 4)) (before : Row) :
 ∃ after, Steps step indices before after := by
 induction indices generalizing before with
 | nil => exact ⟨before,.nil before⟩
 | cons j js ih =>
  let middle := Function.update before j (step j before)
  obtain ⟨after,tail⟩ := ih middle
  refine ⟨after,.cons ?_ tail⟩
  intro k
  by_cases same : k=j
  · subst k; simp [middle]
  · simp [middle,same]

/-- Every caller-domain input admits linked native-shaped one-store traces,
and their full output is the SAME successful emitted carrier. -/
theorem construct (before : Fin 4 → U64) (power : S7Kani2OwnedRow.K)
 (basis : U32) (terms : Nat)
 (hc : ∀ j, (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb power j).val<2^31-1)
 (hb : basis.val<2^31-1) (hp : ∀ j, NBB_Phase.Bound terms (before j).val) :
 ∃ (added : Row) (out : Fin 4 → U64),
 Steps (fun j row => row j+(S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb power j).val*basis.val)
  [0,1,2,3] (fun j => (before j).val) added ∧
 (if decide (terms%4=3) then Steps (fun j row => AspisV8R17.RawReducer.foldBits (row j))
   [0,1,2,3] added (fun j => (out j).val) else (fun j => (out j).val)=added) ∧
 S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.makeRow before) power basis
  (decide (terms%4=3))=ok (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.makeRow out) := by
 obtain ⟨added,adds⟩ := steps (fun j row => row j+
  (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb power j).val*basis.val) [0,1,2,3]
  (fun j => (before j).val)
 obtain ⟨out,run,value,_⟩ := NBB_Row.source before power basis terms hc hb hp
 have model := S7OwnedP6RowContract.source_eq_batched_model
  (fun j => (before j).val) (fun j => (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb power j).val)
  basis.val terms
 have fused := S7OwnedP6RowContract.four_lane_fusion
  (fun j => (before j).val) (fun j => (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb power j).val)
  basis.val (decide (terms%4=3))
 have outValue : (fun j => (out j).val)=
  S7OwnedP6RowContract.reference (fun j => (before j).val)
   (fun j => (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb power j).val) basis.val (decide (terms%4=3)) := by
  funext j
  rw [value]
  exact congrFun (model.symm.trans fused) j
 refine ⟨added,out,adds,?_,run⟩
 cases flag : decide (terms%4=3) with
 | false =>
  simp only [flag,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
  have result := source_result _ _ basis.val false added added adds rfl
  exact outValue.trans (by simpa only [flag] using result.symm)
 | true =>
  simp only [flag,if_true]
  obtain ⟨after,folds⟩ := steps (fun j row => AspisV8R17.RawReducer.foldBits (row j)) [0,1,2,3] added
  have result := source_result _ _ basis.val true added after adds folds
  have same : after=(fun j => (out j).val) := result.trans (by simpa only [flag] using outValue.symm)
  simpa only [same] using folds
#print axioms steps
#print axioms construct
end NBB_RowWitness

import Port3_FlushInstall
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

namespace NBB_Finish
open AspisR1.Port3_FlushInstall
/-- Every actual 64-weight destination is fully materialized, on arbitrary raw
U64 rows. No phase or canonicality precondition is needed by finish. -/
theorem source (b : BW) (old : Slice K)
 (raw64 : b.raw.val.length=64) (old64 : old.val.length=64) :
 ∃ out : Slice K, flush b old=ok out ∧ out.val.length=64 ∧
 out.val=((b.raw.val.take 64).map (fun row => fromMutable
  (S8Kani2FinishReferenceJoin.toFinish (S8OwnedP6Finish.modelValue row)))) ∧
 (∀ q∈out.val, Canonical q) := by
 have lengths : old.val.length≤b.raw.val.length := by omega
 let out := fromSlice
  ⟨(S8JoinFinishExact.output b.raw (toWeights old)).val.map S8Kani2FinishReferenceJoin.toFinish,
   by simpa using (S8JoinFinishExact.output b.raw (toWeights old)).property⟩
 have run : flush b old=ok out := flush_exact b old lengths
 obtain ⟨contents,len⟩ := accepted_contents b old out lengths run
 exact ⟨out,run,len.trans old64,by simpa only [old64] using contents,
  accepted_canonical b old out lengths run⟩

theorem unique (b : BW) (old x y : Slice K)
 (hx : flush b old=ok x) (hy : flush b old=ok y) : x=y :=
 Result.ok.inj (hx.symm.trans hy)

end NBB_Finish

import Port3_NativeQueryFrame
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBB_QueryTrace
open AspisR1Stage2
abbrev Acc := verifier.Accumulator
abbrev BW := verifier.BatchedWeights
abbrev State := core.result.Result (Acc × BW) verifier.Error
abbrev Call := Acc → BW → Result State
/-- Complete local driver trace, including a rejected or failed last call.
No whole-loop output equality is a field of this relation. -/
inductive Trace (call : Call) (end1 : Nat) : State → Result State → Prop
 | error (e : verifier.Error) : Trace call end1 (.Err e) (ok (.Err e))
 | stop (a : Acc) (b : BW) (done : end1≤a.next.val) :
   Trace call end1 (.Ok (a,b)) (ok (.Ok (a,b)))
 | step {a : Acc} {b : BW} {reply : State} {out : Result State}
   (active : a.next.val<end1) (head : call a b=ok reply)
   (tail : Trace call end1 reply out) : Trace call end1 (.Ok (a,b)) out
 | fail {a : Acc} {b : BW} (active : a.next.val<end1) (e : Aeneas.Std.Error)
   (head : call a b=Result.fail e) : Trace call end1 (.Ok (a,b)) (Result.fail e)
 | div {a : Acc} {b : BW} (active : a.next.val<end1)
   (head : call a b=Result.div) : Trace call end1 (.Ok (a,b)) Result.div

theorem unroll (call : QueryCall) (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
 (g : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize)
 (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (geo : verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (end1 : Usize) (state : State) :
 verifier.candidate.query_loop_loop call state proof p g obs geo end1=
 match state with
 | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
 | .Ok (a,b) => if end1.val≤a.next.val then ok (.Ok (a,b)) else
   (do let reply ← call proof p a g obs geo b
       verifier.candidate.query_loop_loop call reply proof p g obs geo end1) := by
 unfold verifier.candidate.query_loop_loop
 rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
 cases state with
 | Err e => rfl
 | Ok pair =>
  rcases pair with ⟨a,b⟩
  by_cases done : end1.val≤a.next.val
  · simp [verifier.candidate.query_loop_loop.body,done]
  · simp [verifier.candidate.query_loop_loop.body,done]
    cases call proof p a g obs geo b <;> rfl

/-- Every linked local callback trace gives the complete cohort Result,
including first rejection, failure or divergence. -/
theorem native_result (call : QueryCall) (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
 (g : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize)
 (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (geo : verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (end1 : Usize) (state : State) (out : Result State)
 (trace : Trace (fun a b => call proof p a g obs geo b) end1.val state out) :
 verifier.candidate.query_loop_loop call state proof p g obs geo end1=out := by
 induction trace with
 | error e => rw [unroll]
 | stop a b done => rw [unroll];dsimp only;rw [if_pos done]
 | step active head tail ih => rw [unroll];dsimp only;rw [if_neg (by omega),head,bind_tc_ok];exact ih
 | fail active e head => rw [unroll];dsimp only;rw [if_neg (by omega),head,bind_tc_fail]
 | div active head => rw [unroll];dsimp only;rw [if_neg (by omega),head,bind_tc_div]

#print axioms unroll
#print axioms native_result
end NBB_QueryTrace

NBB_QueryWitness.source:
import NBB_QueryTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBB_QueryWitness
open AspisR1Stage2 NBB_QueryTrace
/-- A local advancing callback constructs its own finite driver trace,
including the first error/failure/divergence. No final success is assumed. -/
theorem construct (call : Call) (end1 : Nat)
 (advance : ∀ a a1 b b1, call a b=ok (.Ok (a1,b1)) → a1.next.val=a.next.val+1)
 (a : Acc) (b : BW) : ∃ out, Trace call end1 (.Ok (a,b)) out := by
 induction fuel : end1-a.next.val generalizing a b with
 | zero => exact ⟨ok (.Ok (a,b)),.stop a b (by omega)⟩
 | succ n ih =>
  have active : a.next.val<end1 := by omega
  cases head : call a b with
  | fail e => exact ⟨Result.fail e,.fail active e head⟩
  | div => exact ⟨Result.div,.div active head⟩
  | ok reply =>
   cases reply with
   | Err e => exact ⟨ok (.Err e),.step active head (.error e)⟩
   | Ok pair =>
    rcases pair with ⟨a1,b1⟩
    have next := advance a a1 b b1 head
    obtain ⟨out,tail⟩ := ih a1 b1 (by omega)
    exact ⟨out,.step active head tail⟩

/-- The exact direct cohort query body supplies its next-counter law from
its SAME reached query read and accumulation tail. -/
theorem direct (ops : AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops) (proof : Slice U8)
 (p : verifier.Prepared) (g : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize)
 (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (geo : verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (end1 : Usize) (a : Acc) (b : BW) :
 ∃ out, Trace (fun a b => AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryBody.verifier.candidate.query_values
    ops proof p a g obs geo b) end1.val (.Ok (a,b)) out ∧
 AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryBody.verifier.candidate.query_loop ops proof p a g obs geo b end1=out := by
 obtain ⟨out,trace⟩ := construct (fun a b =>
  AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryBody.verifier.candidate.query_values ops proof p a g obs geo b)
  end1.val (fun a a1 b b1 h =>
   (AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryFrame.query_fields ops proof p a a1 g obs geo b b1 h).2.2) a b
 refine ⟨out,trace,?_⟩
 rw [AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryFrame.loop_eq]
 exact NBB_QueryTrace.native_result _ proof p g obs geo end1 (.Ok (a,b)) out trace
#print axioms construct
#print axioms direct
end NBB_QueryWitness

import NEV_CodeFieldRaw.Funs
import NBG_Embedding
import NBF_RowInstall
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_CodeFieldBridge
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev RawE := NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
abbrev StageE := NBF_RowInstall.E

def value (x : U32) : RawE :=
  ⟨⟨⟨AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.reduce x,0#u32⟩,⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩⟩,
    ⟨⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩,⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩⟩⟩

def toStage (x : RawE) : StageE :=
  ⟨⟨⟨x.c0.c0.a,x.c0.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c0.c1.a,x.c0.c1.b⟩⟩,
    ⟨⟨x.c1.c0.a,x.c1.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c1.c1.a,x.c1.c1.b⟩⟩⟩

def fromStage (x : StageE) : RawE :=
  ⟨⟨⟨x.c0.c0.a,x.c0.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c0.c1.a,x.c0.c1.b⟩⟩,
    ⟨⟨x.c1.c0.a,x.c1.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c1.c1.a,x.c1.c1.b⟩⟩⟩

theorem raw_roundtrip (x : RawE) : fromStage (toStage x)=x := by cases x;rfl

theorem stage_roundtrip (x : StageE) : toStage (fromStage x)=x := by cases x;rfl

/-- Reuse the existing generic remainder law; no arithmetic is reproved. -/
theorem rem (x : U32) : x % NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.P =
    ok (AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.reduce x) := by
  simpa only [NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.P,AspisS1M31Embedding.aspis_core.field.P]
    using AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.rem_total x

/-- Complete newly emitted frozen trait path on ALL raw words, including both
normalization passes. All reached definitions are emitted, not templates. -/
theorem total (x : U32) :
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31 x =
      ok (value x) := by
  simp only [NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.QM31.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.CM31.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.CM31.from_m31,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.QM31.from_cm31,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_qm31,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.canonical_qm31,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.canonical_qm31.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnTupleM31M31.call,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.ZERO,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.CM31.ZERO,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO,
    rem,bind_tc_ok,AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.reduce_idempotent,
    AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.reduce_zero,value]

/-- This is the exact concrete callback installed in the adopted accumulation
cohort. Canonicality is required and must come from the caller's basis proof. -/
theorem cohort (ops : AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops) (x : U32)
    (canonical : x.val<2147483647) :
    (do let out ← NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31 x
        ok (toStage out)) = (NBF_RowInstall.install ops).op10 x := by
  have reduced : AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.reduce x=x := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    rw [AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.reduce_val]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt canonical
  rw [total,bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [toStage,value,reduced,NBF_RowInstall.install,NBF_RowInstall.embedM,NBF_RowInstall.zeroQ]

#print axioms raw_roundtrip
#print axioms stage_roundtrip
#print axioms rem
#print axioms total
#print axioms cohort
end NEV_CodeFieldBridge
end

import S1M31EmbeddingSourceV1
import CurrentPreparedInstalledMeaning
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisS1M31Embedding.Total
open AspisS1M31Embedding

def reduce (x : U32) : U32 := ⟨BitVec.umod x.bv (2147483647#u32).bv⟩

theorem reduce_val (x : U32) : (reduce x).val=x.val%2147483647 := by
  change (x.bv % (2147483647#32)).toNat=x.bv.toNat%2147483647
  rw [BitVec.toNat_umod]
  rfl

theorem reduce_idempotent (x : U32) : reduce (reduce x)=reduce x := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  simp only [reduce_val,Nat.mod_mod]

theorem reduce_zero : reduce 0#u32=0#u32 := by rfl

theorem rem_total (x : U32) : x%aspis_core.field.P=ok (reduce x) := by
  unfold aspis_core.field.P
  rfl

def value (x : U32) : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact :=
  ⟨⟨⟨reduce x,0#u32⟩,⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩⟩,⟨⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩,⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩⟩⟩

/-- TOTAL actual emitted CodeField path, including both normalization passes,
for every raw M31 word. No canonical input or successful-child premise. -/
theorem source_total (x : U32) : source_from_m31 x=ok (value x) := by
  simp only [source_from_m31,
    aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31,
    aspis_core.field.QM31.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31,
    aspis_core.field.CM31.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31,
    aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31,
    rem_total,bind_tc_ok,aspis_core.field.CM31.from_m31,
    aspis_core.field.QM31.from_cm31,aspis_core.field.M31.ZERO,
    aspis_core.field.CM31.ZERO,aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_qm31,
    aspis_core.field.wide_exact.canonical_qm31,
    aspis_core.field.wide_exact.canonical_qm31.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnTupleM31M31.call,
    reduce_idempotent,reduce_zero,aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO,value]

abbrev PrepWide := AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.WideExact

def toPrep (x : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact) : PrepWide :=
  ⟨⟨⟨x.c0.c0.a,x.c0.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c0.c1.a,x.c0.c1.b⟩⟩,
   ⟨⟨x.c1.c0.a,x.c1.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c1.c1.a,x.c1.c1.b⟩⟩⟩

/-- Concrete caller child, retaining all eight emitted field coordinates. -/
def embed (x : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.M31) : Result PrepWide := do
  let out ← source_from_m31 x
  ok (toPrep out)

theorem embed_total (x : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.M31) :
    embed x=ok (toPrep (value x)) := by
  rw [embed,source_total,bind_tc_ok]

theorem embed_canonical (x : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.M31) :
    AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete.Canonical
      (AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.toClaimE (toPrep (value x))) := by
  have h : (reduce x).val<2147483647 := by rw [reduce_val];exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
  have z : (0#u32).val<2147483647 := by decide
  exact ⟨⟨⟨h,z⟩,⟨z,z⟩⟩,⟨⟨z,z⟩,⟨z,z⟩⟩⟩

#print axioms reduce_val
#print axioms reduce_idempotent
#print axioms source_total
#print axioms embed_total
#print axioms embed_canonical
end AspisS1M31Embedding.Total

set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

open AspisR1PublicPreparation
open PreparedFromQmSourceBridge

def installedBoundaries (sampling : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (embed : aspis_core.field.M31 → Result aspis_core.field.WideExact) : PreparedModel.Boundaries :=
  withSourceFromQm (CurrentQueryRho.withConcreteQueries (withCandidateSamplers sampling) embed)

theorem installed_as_candidate_samplers (sampling : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (embed : aspis_core.field.M31 → Result aspis_core.field.WideExact) :
    installedBoundaries sampling embed =
      withCandidateSamplers (withSourceFromQm (CurrentQueryRho.withConcreteQueries sampling embed)) := rfl

theorem installed_as_concrete_queries (sampling : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (embed : aspis_core.field.M31 → Result aspis_core.field.WideExact) :
    installedBoundaries sampling embed =
      CurrentQueryRho.withConcreteQueries (withSourceFromQm (withCandidateSamplers sampling)) embed := rfl

theorem prepared_installed_meaning {H : Type}
    (sampling : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (embed : aspis_core.field.M31 → Result aspis_core.field.WideExact)
    (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H) (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : verifier.View) (hash : H) (out : verifier.Prepared)
    (scratch scratchIn : Array PE 29#usize)
    (hinactive : Canonical (toClaimE v.inactive))
    (h : PreparedScratchModel.prepare
      (AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.concreteBoundaries (installedBoundaries sampling embed))
      D sem v hash scratchIn=ok (.Ok out,scratch)) :
    (Canonical (toClaimE out.gamma) ∧ Canonical (toClaimE out.kappa)) ∧
    CanonicalAlphaPair out ∧
    OriginalPayloadClaimMeaning sem v.y1 (toClaimE v.inactive)
      (toClaimE out.gamma) (toClaimE out.kappa) (toClaimE out.claim)
      (mapArray toClaimE scratch) ∧
    (∀ i : Usize, i.val<29 → ∃ value : E,
      Array.index_usize (mapArray toClaimE scratch) i=ok value ∧
      Canonical value ∧ decode value=decode (toClaimE out.gamma)^i.val) := by
  rw [installed_as_candidate_samplers] at h
  let base := withSourceFromQm (CurrentQueryRho.withConcreteQueries sampling embed)
  exact ⟨prepared_candidate_samplers_canonical base D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn h,
    prepared_candidate_alpha_pair base D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn h,
    prepared_candidate_samplers_original_payload base D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn hinactive h,
    prepared_candidate_samplers_scratch base D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn h⟩

#print axioms installed_as_candidate_samplers
#print axioms installed_as_concrete_queries
#print axioms prepared_installed_meaning

theorem prepared_installed_query_rho {H M Cv : Type} {L : Nat}
    (sampling : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H) (p : FS2.Duplex.Params M Cv L)
    (pubInput : Slice U8) (root : TranscriptStep.Bytes32) (length : U32)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (embed : aspis_core.field.M31 → Result aspis_core.field.WideExact)
    (out : verifier.Prepared) (scratch scratchIn : Array PE 29#usize)
    (h : PreparedScratchModel.prepare
      (AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.concreteBoundaries (installedBoundaries sampling embed))
      D sem v hash scratchIn=ok (.Ok out,scratch)) :
    ∃ (row : U8) (before afterQueries last : transcript.Transcript H) (block : Array U8 32#usize),
      (row=30#u8 ∨ row=31#u8) ∧
      QueriesModel.queries (Query31ConcreteMaterializedSchedule.concreteBoundaries sourceDefaultState embed)
        D before row v.final_message=ok (.Ok out.queries,afterQueries) ∧
      QueryScheduleFacts D p pubInput root length before afterQueries row v.final_message out.queries ∧
      transcript.Transcript.block D afterQueries (if row=30#u8 then 31#u8 else 32#u8)
        PreparedScratchReachability.emptyPayload=ok (block,last) ∧
      sampler.qm31_sample block=ok out.rho ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.CurrentCanonicalQM
        (AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.toCurrent (SamplerTransport.toOld out.rho)) ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.coordinates (SamplerTransport.toOld out.rho)=
        AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits (AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank.rank block) ∧
      out.state=last.state := by
  rw [installed_as_concrete_queries] at h
  exact CurrentQueryRho.prepared_success_concrete_query_rho
    (withSourceFromQm (withCandidateSamplers sampling)) D p pubInput root length
    sem v hash embed out scratch scratchIn h

#print axioms prepared_installed_query_rho

import CurrentPreparedCandidateSamplers
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge
open AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete

def CanonicalAlphaPair (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) : Prop :=
  ∃ a b : PE,out.alpha=Array.make 2#usize [a,b] ∧
    Canonical (toClaimE a) ∧ Canonical (toClaimE b)

theorem public_zero_canonical :
    Canonical (toClaimE AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.WideExact.ZERO) := by
  unfold AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.WideExact.ZERO
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO
  have h0 : (0#u32).val<2147483647 := by decide
  exact ⟨⟨⟨h0,h0⟩,⟨h0,h0⟩⟩,⟨⟨h0,h0⟩,⟨h0,h0⟩⟩⟩

theorem scalar_candidate_samplers_false_canonical {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (before after : AspisR1PublicPreparation.transcript.Transcript H)
    (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) (out : PE)
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.scalar (withCandidateSamplers sampling)
      D before row payload false=ok (out,after)) : Canonical (toClaimE out) := by
  rw [candidate_sampler_updates_commute] at h
  exact AspisR1Post25SamplerOrdinaryCallbackV2.scalar_candidate_ordinary_canonical
    (withCandidateGamma sampling) D before after row payload out h

theorem tail_candidate_alpha_pair {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.View) (gamma kappa alpha0 : PE)
    (before : AspisR1PublicPreparation.transcript.Transcript H)
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) (scratch : Array PE 29#usize)
    (hc0 : Canonical (toClaimE alpha0))
    (ht : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchReachability.Tail
      (concreteBoundaries (withCandidateSamplers sampling)) D sem v gamma kappa alpha0 before out scratch) :
    CanonicalAlphaPair out := by
  cases ht with
  | single hf ha =>
    obtain ⟨queries,afterQueries,last,rho,claim,hq,hr,hp,hc,he⟩ := ha
    subst out
    exact ⟨alpha0,_,rfl,hc0,public_zero_canonical⟩
  | double hf root bytes1 bytes2 alpha1 afterAlpha hroot hb1 hb2 halpha1 ha =>
    have hc1 := scalar_candidate_samplers_false_canonical sampling D before afterAlpha 30#u8
      (AspisR1PublicPreparation.alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes2) alpha1 halpha1
    obtain ⟨queries,afterQueries,last,rho,claim,hq,hr,hp,hc,he⟩ := ha
    subst out
    exact ⟨alpha0,alpha1,rfl,hc0,hc1⟩

theorem prepared_candidate_alpha_pair {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) (scratch scratchIn : Array PE 29#usize)
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare
      (concreteBoundaries (withCandidateSamplers sampling)) D sem v hash scratchIn=ok (.Ok out,scratch)) :
    CanonicalAlphaPair out := by
  obtain ⟨start,t1,t2,t3,bytes,gamma,kappa,alpha0,hseed,hg,hb,hk,ha,ht⟩ :=
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchReachability.prepare_success
      (concreteBoundaries (withCandidateSamplers sampling)) D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn h
  have hc0 := scalar_candidate_samplers_false_canonical sampling D t2 t3 29#u8 v.round0 alpha0 ha
  exact tail_candidate_alpha_pair sampling D sem v gamma kappa alpha0 t3 out scratch hc0 ht

#print axioms public_zero_canonical
#print axioms scalar_candidate_samplers_false_canonical
#print axioms tail_candidate_alpha_pair
#print axioms prepared_candidate_alpha_pair
end AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge

import CurrentPreparedGammaRank
import CurrentSamplerOrdinaryCallbackV2
import CurrentPreparedScratchMeaning
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge
open AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete
local notation "ordinaryBoundary" => AspisR1Post25SamplerOrdinaryCallbackV2.withCandidateOrdinary

def withCandidateSamplers (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries :=
  withCandidateGamma (ordinaryBoundary sampling)

theorem candidate_sampler_updates_commute
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries) :
    withCandidateSamplers sampling=ordinaryBoundary (withCandidateGamma sampling) := rfl

theorem prepared_candidate_samplers_canonical {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) (scratch scratchIn : Array PE 29#usize)
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare
      (concreteBoundaries (withCandidateSamplers sampling)) D sem v hash scratchIn=ok (.Ok out,scratch)) :
    Canonical (toClaimE out.gamma) ∧ Canonical (toClaimE out.kappa) := by
  refine ⟨prepared_candidate_gamma_canonical (ordinaryBoundary sampling) D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn h,?_⟩
  have ho := h
  rw [candidate_sampler_updates_commute] at ho
  exact AspisR1Post25SamplerOrdinaryCallbackV2.prepared_candidate_ordinary_kappa_canonical
    (withCandidateGamma sampling) D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn ho

theorem prepared_candidate_samplers_original_payload {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) (scratch scratchIn : Array PE 29#usize)
    (hinactive : Canonical (toClaimE v.inactive))
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare
      (concreteBoundaries (withCandidateSamplers sampling)) D sem v hash scratchIn=ok (.Ok out,scratch)) :
    OriginalPayloadClaimMeaning sem v.y1 (toClaimE v.inactive)
      (toClaimE out.gamma) (toClaimE out.kappa) (toClaimE out.claim)
      (mapArray toClaimE scratch) := by
  have hc := prepared_candidate_samplers_canonical sampling D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn h
  exact prepared_success_original_payload_claim (withCandidateSamplers sampling) D sem v hash
    out scratch scratchIn hc.1 hc.2 hinactive h

theorem prepared_candidate_samplers_scratch {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) (scratch scratchIn : Array PE 29#usize)
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare
      (concreteBoundaries (withCandidateSamplers sampling)) D sem v hash scratchIn=ok (.Ok out,scratch)) :
    ∀ i : Usize, i.val<29 → ∃ value : E,
      Array.index_usize (mapArray toClaimE scratch) i=ok value ∧
      Canonical value ∧ decode value=decode (toClaimE out.gamma)^i.val := by
  exact prepared_success_scratch_meaning (withCandidateSamplers sampling) D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn
    (prepared_candidate_samplers_canonical sampling D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn h).1 h

#print axioms candidate_sampler_updates_commute

import CurrentPreparedGammaSpecialization
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge
open AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete

def GammaRankMeaning (block : Array U8 32#usize) (out : PE) : Prop :=
  ∃ r : Fin (AspisCircleGroupOrder.P^8),
    r.val=AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank.rank block % (AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P^8-1)+1 ∧
    decode (toClaimE out)=R0C.ModuloField.fieldRank r

theorem gamma_decode_same (x : AspisR1GammaCaller.DigitsModel.GammaWide) :
    decode (toClaimE (gammaToPublic x))=AspisR1GammaCaller.DigitsModel.gammaWideToExact x := by
  rfl

theorem candidateGammaPublic_success_rank (block : Array U8 32#usize) (out : PE)
    (h : candidateGammaPublic block=ok out) : GammaRankMeaning block out := by
  unfold candidateGammaPublic at h
  cases hg : AspisR1GammaCaller.sampler.gamma_sample
      AspisR1GammaCaller.DigitsModel.candidateGammaHelpers block with
  | fail e => simp only [hg,bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [hg,bind_tc_div] at h; cases h
  | ok value =>
    simp only [hg,bind_tc_ok] at h
    have he : gammaToPublic value=out := Result.ok.inj h
    obtain ⟨digits,hd,hc,hv,hf⟩ :=
      AspisR1GammaCaller.DigitsModel.candidate_gamma_decode_fieldRank block value hg
    refine ⟨_,?_,?_⟩
    swap
    · rw [←he,gamma_decode_same]
      exact hf
    · rfl

private theorem bind_success {A B : Type} (m : Result A) (f : A → Result B) (v : B)
    (h : (do let x ← m; f x)=ok v) : ∃ x,m=ok x ∧ f x=ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

theorem scalar_candidate_gamma_rank {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (before after : AspisR1PublicPreparation.transcript.Transcript H)
    (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) (out : PE)
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.scalar (withCandidateGamma sampling)
      D before row payload true=ok (out,after)) :
    ∃ block : Array U8 32#usize,
      AspisR1PublicPreparation.transcript.Transcript.block D before row payload=ok (block,after) ∧
      GammaRankMeaning block out := by
  unfold AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.scalar at h
  obtain ⟨p,hblock,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  rcases p with ⟨block,t⟩
  simp only [withCandidateGamma,ite_true] at h
  obtain ⟨value,hvalue,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨i,hi,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨u,htrace,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  have he : (value,t)=(out,after) := Result.ok.inj h
  cases he
  exact ⟨block,hblock,candidateGammaPublic_success_rank block value hvalue⟩

theorem prepared_candidate_gamma_rank {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) (scratch scratchIn : Array PE 29#usize)
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare
      (concreteBoundaries (withCandidateGamma sampling)) D sem v hash scratchIn=ok (.Ok out,scratch)) :
    ∃ (start after : AspisR1PublicPreparation.transcript.Transcript H) (block : Array U8 32#usize),
      AspisR1PublicPreparation.transcript.Transcript.new D hash sem.transcript.state v.variant=ok start ∧
      AspisR1PublicPreparation.transcript.Transcript.block D start 27#u8 v.y1=ok (block,after) ∧
      GammaRankMeaning block out.gamma := by
  obtain ⟨start,t1,t2,t3,bytes,gamma,kappa,alpha0,hseed,hg,hb,hk,ha,ht⟩ :=
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchReachability.prepare_success
      (concreteBoundaries (withCandidateGamma sampling)) D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn h
  obtain ⟨block,hblock,hrank⟩ := scalar_candidate_gamma_rank sampling D start t1 27#u8 v.y1 gamma hg
  have he := (tail_concrete_run (withCandidateGamma sampling) D sem v gamma kappa alpha0
    t3 out scratch ht).1
  exact ⟨start,t1,block,hseed,hblock,by simpa only [he] using hrank⟩

#print axioms gamma_decode_same
#print axioms candidateGammaPublic_success_rank
#print axioms scalar_candidate_gamma_rank
#print axioms prepared_candidate_gamma_rank
end AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge

import CurrentPreparedGammaCallback
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge
open AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete

private theorem bind_success {A B : Type} (m : Result A) (f : A → Result B) (v : B)
    (h : (do let x ← m; f x)=ok v) : ∃ x,m=ok x ∧ f x=ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

def withCandidateGamma (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries :=
  {sampling with gamma:=candidateGammaPublic}

theorem scalar_candidate_gamma_canonical {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (before after : AspisR1PublicPreparation.transcript.Transcript H)
    (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) (out : PE)
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.scalar (withCandidateGamma sampling)
      D before row payload true=ok(out,after)) : Canonical (toClaimE out) := by
  unfold AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.scalar at h
  obtain ⟨p,hblock,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  rcases p with ⟨block,t⟩
  simp only [withCandidateGamma,ite_true] at h
  obtain ⟨value,hvalue,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨i,hi,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨u,htrace,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  have he : value=out := congrArg Prod.fst (Result.ok.inj h)
  rw [←he]
  exact candidateGammaPublic_success_canonical block value hvalue

theorem prepared_candidate_gamma_canonical {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) (scratch scratchIn : Array PE 29#usize)
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare
      (concreteBoundaries (withCandidateGamma sampling)) D sem v hash scratchIn=ok(.Ok out,scratch)) :
    Canonical (toClaimE out.gamma) := by
  obtain ⟨start,t1,t2,t3,bytes,gamma,kappa,alpha0,hseed,hg,hb,hk,ha,ht⟩ :=
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchReachability.prepare_success
      (concreteBoundaries (withCandidateGamma sampling)) D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn h
  have hc := scalar_candidate_gamma_canonical sampling D start t1 27#u8 v.y1 gamma hg
  have he := (tail_concrete_run (withCandidateGamma sampling) D sem v gamma kappa alpha0
    t3 out scratch ht).1
  rw [he]
  exact hc

theorem prepared_candidate_gamma_original_payload {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) (scratch scratchIn : Array PE 29#usize)
    (hkappa : Canonical (toClaimE out.kappa)) (hinactive : Canonical (toClaimE v.inactive))
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare
      (concreteBoundaries (withCandidateGamma sampling)) D sem v hash scratchIn=ok(.Ok out,scratch)) :
    OriginalPayloadClaimMeaning sem v.y1 (toClaimE v.inactive)
      (toClaimE out.gamma) (toClaimE out.kappa) (toClaimE out.claim)
      (mapArray toClaimE scratch) := by
  exact prepared_success_original_payload_claim (withCandidateGamma sampling) D sem v hash
    out scratch scratchIn (prepared_candidate_gamma_canonical sampling D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn h)
    hkappa hinactive h

#print axioms scalar_candidate_gamma_canonical
#print axioms prepared_candidate_gamma_canonical
#print axioms prepared_candidate_gamma_original_payload
end AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge

import CurrentPreparedOriginalPayload
import GammaCandidateCanonicalOutput
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge
open AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete

def gammaToPublic (v : AspisR1GammaCaller.DigitsModel.GammaWide) : PE :=
  ⟨⟨⟨v.c0.c0.a,v.c0.c0.b⟩,⟨v.c0.c1.a,v.c0.c1.b⟩⟩,
    ⟨⟨v.c1.c0.a,v.c1.c0.b⟩,⟨v.c1.c1.a,v.c1.c1.b⟩⟩⟩

def candidateGammaPublic (block : Array U8 32#usize) : Result PE := do
  let out ← AspisR1GammaCaller.sampler.gamma_sample
    AspisR1GammaCaller.DigitsModel.candidateGammaHelpers block
  ok (gammaToPublic out)

theorem candidateGammaPublic_success_canonical (block : Array U8 32#usize) (out : PE)
    (h : candidateGammaPublic block=ok out) : Canonical (toClaimE out) := by
  unfold candidateGammaPublic at h
  cases hg : AspisR1GammaCaller.sampler.gamma_sample
      AspisR1GammaCaller.DigitsModel.candidateGammaHelpers block with
  | fail e => simp only [hg,bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [hg,bind_tc_div] at h; cases h
  | ok value =>
    simp only [hg,bind_tc_ok] at h
    have he : gammaToPublic value=out := Result.ok.inj h
    rw [←he]

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def ConcreteClaimRun {H : Type} (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.View)
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) (scratch : Array PE 29#usize) : Prop :=
  ClaimPowers.powers 29#usize (toClaimE out.gamma)=ok (mapArray toClaimE scratch) ∧
  verifier.prepared_claim (AspisR1S5ClaimDotConcreteAdapter.concreteOps QRaw)
    (toClaimDigest D) (toClaimSem sem) v.y1 (toClaimE v.inactive)
    (mapArray toClaimE scratch) (toClaimE out.kappa)=ok (.Ok (toClaimE out.claim))

theorem afterQueries_concrete_run {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.View) (gamma kappa : PE)
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) (scratch : Array PE 29#usize)
    {alpha : Array PE 2#usize} {row : U8} {before : AspisR1PublicPreparation.transcript.Transcript H}
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchReachability.AfterQueries
      (concreteBoundaries sampling) D sem v gamma kappa alpha row before out scratch) :
    out.gamma=gamma ∧ out.kappa=kappa ∧ ConcreteClaimRun D sem v out scratch := by
  obtain ⟨queries,afterQueries,last,rho,claim,hq,hrho,hp,hc,he⟩ := h
  have hp1 := powersPublic_success gamma scratch hp
  have hc1 := claimPublic_success D sem v.y1 v.inactive kappa claim scratch hc
  subst out
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl,hp1,hc1⟩

theorem tail_concrete_run {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.View) (gamma kappa alpha0 : PE)
    (before : AspisR1PublicPreparation.transcript.Transcript H)
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) (scratch : Array PE 29#usize)
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchReachability.Tail
      (concreteBoundaries sampling) D sem v gamma kappa alpha0 before out scratch) :
    out.gamma=gamma ∧ out.kappa=kappa ∧ ConcreteClaimRun D sem v out scratch := by
  cases h with
  | single hf ha => exact afterQueries_concrete_run sampling D sem v gamma kappa out scratch ha
  | double hf root b1 b2 a1 ta hr hb1 hb2 hal ha =>
    exact afterQueries_concrete_run sampling D sem v gamma kappa out scratch ha

theorem prepared_success_concrete_claim {H : Type}
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared) (scratch scratchIn : Array PE 29#usize)
    (h : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.prepare
      (concreteBoundaries sampling) D sem v hash scratchIn=ok (.Ok out,scratch)) :
    ConcreteClaimRun D sem v out scratch := by
  obtain ⟨start,t1,t2,t3,bytes,gamma,kappa,alpha0,hseed,hg,hb,hk,ha,ht⟩ :=
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchReachability.prepare_success
      (concreteBoundaries sampling) D sem v hash out scratch scratchIn h
  exact (tail_concrete_run sampling D sem v gamma kappa alpha0 t3 out scratch ht).2.2

/-- Only nominal carrier transport: both original row loop bodies and the exact
borrow continuation are unchanged. No arithmetic theorem is reproved. -/
theorem row (r : Array U64 4#usize) (p : RawPower) (basis : U32) (flush : Bool) :
 NEI_PushRaw.update_residue_row r p basis flush =
 NEG_PushActual.update_residue_row r (toPower p) basis flush := by rfl

 (do let out ← NEI_PushRaw.BatchedWeights.push b index p basis; ok (toBW out)) =
 NEG_PushActual.BatchedWeights.push (toBW b) index (toPower p) basis := by
 simp only [NEI_PushRaw.BatchedWeights.push,NEG_PushActual.BatchedWeights.push,
   lift,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok,toBW]
 congr 1
 funext pair
 rcases pair with ⟨a,back⟩
 change (do let out ← (do
           let updated ← NEI_PushRaw.update_residue_row a p basis
             (decide (b.terms &&& 3#usize=3#usize))
           ok (⟨back updated,b.terms⟩ : RawBW))
            ok (toBW out)) =
        (do let updated ← NEG_PushActual.update_residue_row a (toPower p) basis
              (decide (b.terms &&& 3#usize=3#usize))
            ok (⟨back updated,b.terms⟩ : NEG_PushActual.BatchedWeights))
 simp only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok,toBW]
 rw [row]

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

 alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array U64 4#usize)) b.raw index
/-- Same full carrier, selected child input, returned row, Vec restoration and
unchanged terms; unrestricted Result equality. -/
theorem same_call (b : BW) (index : Usize) (p : Power) (basis : U32) :
 NEG_PushActual.BatchedWeights.push b index p basis =
 (do let row ← rowRead b index
     let out ← NEG_RowIsolated.update_residue_row row p basis
       ((b.terms &&& 3#usize)=3#usize)
     ok ({b with raw := b.raw.set index out} : BW)) := by
 rw [NEG_PushAssociation.source,Port26ROW.owned_push_complete]
 simp only [NEG_RowAssociation.emitted_to_owned,rowRead,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]

def Domain (b : BW) (index : Usize) (p : Power) (basis : U32) : Prop :=
 index.val < b.raw.val.length ∧
 ∀ row, rowRead b index=ok row → NEI_RowBridge.Domain row p basis

theorem complete (b : BW) (index : Usize) (p : Power) (basis : U32)
 (domain : Domain b index p basis) :
 ∃ row out,
 rowRead b index=ok row ∧ NEI_RowBridge.Domain row p basis ∧
 NEG_RowIsolated.update_residue_row row p basis ((b.terms &&& 3#usize)=3#usize)=ok out ∧
 NEG_PushActual.BatchedWeights.push b index p basis=
 ok ({b with raw := b.raw.set index out} : BW) := by
 obtain ⟨row,read,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec b.raw index domain.1)
 have hr : rowRead b index=ok row := read
 have safe := domain.2 row hr
 obtain ⟨out,run,_⟩ := NEI_RowBridge.complete row p basis _ safe
 refine ⟨row,out,hr,safe,run,?_⟩
 rw [same_call,hr]
 simp only [bind_tc_ok,run]
#print axioms same_call
#print axioms complete
end NEI_PushBridge
end

import Port26ROW_Add
import Port26ROW_Fold
import Port23PUSH_Frame
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Port26ROW
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open Port23PUSH Port25ARRAY

/-- Complete mutable source row with the content delegation instance, on every
full four-word carrier. Checked add failures and div are preserved; total folds
commute across checked later lanes because they introduce no failure/effect in
this pure Result interpretation. Native association/effects are separate. -/
theorem row_complete (row : Row) (power : Power) (basis : U32) (flush : Bool) :
    verifier.update_residue_row concrete row power basis flush =
      S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned row (toK power) basis flush := by
  rcases row_four row with ⟨a,b,c,d,rfl⟩
  rw [owned_four]
  change (do
    let row1 ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop0 ⟨0#usize,4#usize⟩
      (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) basis
      (Array.make 4#usize [power.c0.a,power.c0.b,power.c1.a,power.c1.b])
    if flush then
      (do let (it,back) ← concrete row1
          let f ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 it id
          ok (back f))
    else ok row1) = _
  rw [add_tail0]
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]
  congr 1
  funext x0
  congr 1
  funext x1
  congr 1
  funext x2
  congr 1
  funext x3
  cases flush with
  | false => rfl
  | true => exact fold_readback x0 x1 x2 x3

/-- Exact carrier conversion: all raw rows, terms and four power words. -/
def toBW (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.BatchedWeights :=
  ⟨b.raw,b.terms⟩
def fromBW (b : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.BatchedWeights) : verifier.BatchedWeights :=
  ⟨b.raw,b.terms⟩

theorem carrier_roundtrip (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) : fromBW (toBW b) = b := by
  cases b
  rfl

/-- Unconditional owned outer normalization. No safe domain or successful row
execution is assumed. Indexing before mutation preserves invalid-index failure. -/
theorem owned_push_complete (b : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.BatchedWeights)
    (index : Usize) (power : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.K) (basis : U32) :
    S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned b index power basis =
      (do let row ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Row)
            b.raw index
          let updated ← S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned row power basis
            ((b.terms &&& 3#usize) = 3#usize)
          ok {b with raw := b.raw.set index updated}) := by
  by_cases bound : index.val < b.raw.val.length
  · obtain ⟨row,hr,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec b.raw index bound)
    obtain ⟨⟨old,back⟩,hm,_,hback⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_usize_spec b.raw index bound)
    have hr' : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Row)
        b.raw index = ok row := hr
    have hm' : alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Row)
        b.raw index = ok (old,back) := by
      rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_slice_index]
      exact hm
    simp only [S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned,hr',lift,bind_tc_ok,hm',hback]
    all_goals rfl
  · simp [S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned,alloc.vec.Vec.index,
      core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice,alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize,
      Slice.index_usize,bound]

/-- Actual mutable source-emitted push equals the owned source push under exact
carrier conversion, including full Results and the entire Vec.set/terms frame.
The explicit collection delegation is derived; native association is separate. -/
theorem push_complete (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (index : Usize)
    (power : Power) (basis : U32) :
    verifier.BatchedWeights.push concrete b index power basis =
      (do let out ← S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned (toBW b) index (toK power) basis
          ok (fromBW out)) := by
  rw [Port23PUSH.push_complete,owned_push_complete]
  simp only [row_complete,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok,toBW,fromBW]
  all_goals rfl

#print axioms row_complete
#print axioms toBW
#print axioms fromBW
#print axioms carrier_roundtrip
#print axioms owned_push_complete
#print axioms push_complete
end Port26ROW
end

import Port25ARRAY_Lane
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Port26ROW
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open Port23PUSH Port25ARRAY
abbrev Row := Array U64 4#usize
abbrev Power := Port23PUSH.field.QM31

def toK (q : Power) : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.K :=
  ⟨(q.c0.a,q.c0.b),(q.c1.a,q.c1.b)⟩

theorem row_four (row : Row) : ∃ a b c d, row = Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d] := by
  rcases row with ⟨l,h⟩
  change l.length = 4 at h
  rcases l with _ | ⟨a,l⟩
  · cases h
  rcases l with _ | ⟨b,l⟩
  · cases h
  rcases l with _ | ⟨c,l⟩
  · cases h
  rcases l with _ | ⟨d,l⟩
  · cases h
  rcases l with _ | ⟨e,l⟩
  · exact ⟨a,b,c,d,rfl⟩
  · simp at h

/-- One symbolic source loop unfolding, retaining checked operations and order. -/
theorem add_unroll (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (row : Row)
    (basis : U32) (limbs : Array U32 4#usize) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop0 iter row basis limbs =
      (do let step ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop0.body limbs iter row basis
          match step with
          | done out => ok out
          | cont (it,r,b) => verifier.update_residue_row_loop0 it r b limbs) := by
  unfold verifier.update_residue_row_loop0
  rw [loop.eq_def]
  simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
  cases h : verifier.update_residue_row_loop0.body limbs iter row basis with
  | ok step => cases step with
    | done out => simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
    | cont state => rcases state with ⟨it,r,b⟩; simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
  | fail e => simp only [h,bind_tc_fail]
  | div => simp only [h,bind_tc_div]

theorem range_next (j k : Usize) (active : j.val < 4) (inc : k.val = j.val+1) :
    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize ⟨j,4#usize⟩ =
      ok (some j,⟨k,4#usize⟩) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨o,it⟩,run,ho,hs,he⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_some_spec
      (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
      (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x; rfl) (by intro a b; rfl)
      ⟨j,4#usize⟩ active)
  subst o
  have hk : it.start = k := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by dsimp at hs; omega)
  rcases it with ⟨start,ending⟩
  dsimp at hk he
  subst start
  subst ending
  exact run

/-- Exact existing owned row on arbitrary full words. This establishes its
all-adds-then-pure-fold normal form, without claiming the mutable loop join. -/
theorem owned_four (a b c d : U64) (power : Power) (basis : U32) (flush : Bool) :
    S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) (toK power) basis flush =
      (do let x0 ← addWord a power.c0.a basis
          let x1 ← addWord b power.c0.b basis
          let x2 ← addWord c power.c1.a basis
          let x3 ← addWord d power.c1.b basis
          ok (Array.make 4#usize [finish flush x0,finish flush x1,
            finish flush x2,finish flush x3])) := by
  change (do
    let x0 ← S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned a power.c0.a basis flush
    let x1 ← S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned b power.c0.b basis flush
    let x2 ← S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned c power.c1.a basis flush
    let x3 ← S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned d power.c1.b basis flush
    ok (Array.make 4#usize [x0,x1,x2,x3])) = _
  simp only [scalar_all_results,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]

/-- ACTUAL emitted fold body, including end-of-iteration deferred back closure.
Fold totality removes its possible failure; next's Result is retained exactly. -/
theorem fold_body_complete (it : Iter U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body it back =
      (do let (o,it1,nextBack) ← core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next it
          match o with
          | none => ok (done (fun im => back (nextBack im none)))
          | some limb => ok (cont (it1,
              fun im => back (nextBack im (some (folded limb)))))) := by
  cases h : core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next it with
  | ok value =>
    rcases value with ⟨o,it1,nextBack⟩
    cases o with
    | none =>
      simp only [verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body,h,bind_tc_ok]
      rfl
    | some limb =>
      simp only [verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body,h,bind_tc_ok]
      change (do let y ← foldWord limb
                 ok (cont (it1,fun im => back (nextBack im (some y))))) = _
      rw [fold_eq,bind_tc_ok]
      rfl
  | fail e => simp only [verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body,h,bind_tc_fail]
  | div => simp only [verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body,h,bind_tc_div]


#print axioms toK
#print axioms row_four
#print axioms add_unroll
#print axioms range_next
#print axioms owned_four
#print axioms fold_body_complete
end Port26ROW
end

import Port25ARRAY_Std
import S7Kani2OwnedPush
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Port25ARRAY
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer

def addWord (raw : U64) (limb basis : U32) : Result U64 := do
  let a ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from limb)
  let b ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from basis)
  let p ← a * b
  raw + p

def foldWord (x : U64) : Result U64 := do
  let low ← lift (x &&& 2147483647#u64)
  let high ← x >>> 31#i32
  low + high

theorem fold_total (x : U64) : ∃ y, foldWord x = ok y := by
  obtain ⟨y,hy,_⟩ := foldExecution_success x
  refine ⟨y,?_⟩
  change foldExecution x = ok y
  exact hy

def folded (x : U64) : U64 := Classical.choose (fold_total x)
theorem fold_eq (x : U64) : foldWord x = ok (folded x) :=
  Classical.choose_spec (fold_total x)
def finish (flush : Bool) (x : U64) : U64 := if flush then folded x else x

theorem scalar_all_results (raw : U64) (limb basis : U32) (flush : Bool) :
    S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned raw limb basis flush =
      (do let x ← addWord raw limb basis; ok (finish flush x)) := by
  simp only [S7OwnedP6Scalar.residue_scalar_owned, addWord, bind_assoc_eq,
    lift, bind_tc_ok]
  congr 1
  funext p
  congr 1
  funext x
  cases flush <;> simp only [finish, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
  exact fold_eq x

/-- Multiplication is total on all full U32 words. Raw addition remains checked. -/
theorem product_total (limb basis : U32) :
    ∃ p, ((core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from limb) *
      (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from basis) : Result U64) = ok p := by
  have ha := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.widen_value limb
  have hb := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.widen_value basis
  have hp : (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from limb).val *
      (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from basis).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [ha,hb]
    have h := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt limb.bv.isLt basis.bv.isLt
    exact h
  obtain ⟨p,hp,_⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducerOps.mul_success _ _ hp
  exact ⟨p,hp⟩

/-- A total pure fold can pass a checked computation without losing its fail
or div outcome. The computation's original order is preserved. -/
theorem total_fold_order {A B C : Type} (m : Result A) (n : Result B)
    (f : A → C) :
    (do let a ← m; let b ← n; ok (f a,b)) =
      (do let a ← m; let c ← ok (f a); let b ← n; ok (c,b)) := by
  cases m <;> rfl

#print axioms addWord
#print axioms foldWord
#print axioms fold_total
#print axioms folded
#print axioms fold_eq
#print axioms finish
#print axioms scalar_all_results
#print axioms product_total
#print axioms total_fold_order
end Port25ARRAY
end

import Port23PUSH_Source
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Port25ARRAY
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Iter (T : Type) := core.slice.iter.IterMut T

/-- Literal array -> mutable slice -> iter_mut delegation, with the caller's
transformer continuation applied to the original iterator before readback.
No backend registration or native association is installed. -/
def arrayIntoIter {T : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array T N) :
    Result (Iter T × ((Iter T → Iter T) → Array T N)) := do
  let (s, arrayBack) ← lift (Array.to_slice_mut a)
  let (it, sliceBack) ← core.slice.Slice.iter_mut s
  ok (it, fun transform => arrayBack (sliceBack (transform it)))

theorem delegation {T : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array T N) :
    arrayIntoIter a = ok (⟨a.to_slice,0⟩,
      fun transform => Array.from_slice a (transform ⟨a.to_slice,0⟩).slice) := by
  rfl

/-- Full back law includes the existing wrapper's fallback for malformed
transformers. Actual next/back closures preserve the slice length. -/
theorem back_carrier {T : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array T N)
    (f : Iter T → Iter T) :
    (Array.from_slice a (f ⟨a.to_slice,0⟩).slice).val =
      if (f ⟨a.to_slice,0⟩).slice.val.length = N.val
      then (f ⟨a.to_slice,0⟩).slice.val else a.val := by
  simp only [Array.from_slice]
  split <;> rfl

theorem back_identity {T : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array T N) :
    Array.from_slice a ((id : Iter T → Iter T) ⟨a.to_slice,0⟩).slice = a := by
  cases a
  simp [Array.from_slice, Array.to_slice]

/-- Concrete transformer ABI for the exact Port23 row carrier. -/
def concrete : Port23PUSH.ArrayIntoIter := arrayIntoIter

#print axioms arrayIntoIter
#print axioms delegation
#print axioms back_carrier
#print axioms back_identity
#print axioms concrete
end Port25ARRAY
end

Port26ROW_Fold.source:
import Port26ROW_Steps
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Port26ROW
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open Port23PUSH Port25ARRAY

def atRow (a b c d : U64) (n : Nat) : Iter U64 :=
  ⟨(Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]).to_slice,n⟩
def put (n : Nat) (y : U64) (im : Iter U64) : Iter U64 :=
  {im with slice := im.slice.setAtNat n y}

theorem fold_unroll (it : Iter U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 it back =
      (do let step ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body it back
          match step with
          | done out => ok out
          | cont (it,b) => verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 it b) := by
  unfold verifier.update_residue_row_loop1
  rw [loop.eq_def]
  cases h : verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body it back with
  | ok step => cases step with
    | done out => simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
    | cont state => rcases state with ⟨it,b⟩; simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
  | fail e => simp only [h,bind_tc_fail]
  | div => simp only [h,bind_tc_div]

theorem fold_body0 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body (atRow a b c d 0) back =
      ok (cont (atRow a b c d 1, fun im => back (put 0 (folded a) im))) := by
  rw [fold_body_complete]
  rfl

theorem fold_body1 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body (atRow a b c d 1) back =
      ok (cont (atRow a b c d 2, fun im => back (put 1 (folded b) im))) := by
  rw [fold_body_complete]
  rfl

theorem fold_body2 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body (atRow a b c d 2) back =
      ok (cont (atRow a b c d 3, fun im => back (put 2 (folded c) im))) := by
  rw [fold_body_complete]
  rfl

theorem fold_body3 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body (atRow a b c d 3) back =
      ok (cont (atRow a b c d 4, fun im => back (put 3 (folded d) im))) := by
  rw [fold_body_complete]
  rfl

theorem fold_body4 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body (atRow a b c d 4) back =
      ok (done back) := by
  rw [fold_body_complete]
  rfl

theorem fold_tail4 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 (atRow a b c d 4) back =
      ok (fun im => back (im)) := by
  rw [fold_unroll,fold_body4]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]

theorem fold_tail3 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 (atRow a b c d 3) back =
      ok (fun im => back (put 3 (folded d) (im))) := by
  rw [fold_unroll,fold_body3]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  exact fold_tail4 a b c d _

theorem fold_tail2 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 (atRow a b c d 2) back =
      ok (fun im => back (put 2 (folded c) (put 3 (folded d) (im)))) := by
  rw [fold_unroll,fold_body2]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  exact fold_tail3 a b c d _

theorem fold_tail1 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 (atRow a b c d 1) back =
      ok (fun im => back (put 1 (folded b) (put 2 (folded c) (put 3 (folded d) (im))))) := by
  rw [fold_unroll,fold_body1]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  exact fold_tail2 a b c d _

theorem fold_tail0 (a b c d : U64) (back : Iter U64 → Iter U64) :
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 (atRow a b c d 0) back =
      ok (fun im => back (put 0 (folded a) (put 1 (folded b) (put 2 (folded c) (put 3 (folded d) (im)))))) := by
  rw [fold_unroll,fold_body0]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  exact fold_tail1 a b c d _

/-- Actual iterator continuation is applied to its original input, then the
existing from_slice readback. All four writes and the entire carrier retained. -/
theorem fold_readback (a b c d : U64) :
    (do let (it,back) ← concrete (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])
        let f ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 it id
        ok (back f)) =
      ok (Array.make 4#usize [folded a,folded b,folded c,folded d]) := by
  change (do let f ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 (atRow a b c d 0) id
             ok (Array.from_slice (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])
               (f (atRow a b c d 0)).slice)) = _
  rw [fold_tail0]
  rfl

#print axioms atRow
#print axioms put
#print axioms fold_unroll
#print axioms fold_body0
#print axioms fold_body1
#print axioms fold_body2
#print axioms fold_body3
#print axioms fold_body4
#print axioms fold_tail0
#print axioms fold_tail1
#print axioms fold_tail2
#print axioms fold_tail3
#print axioms fold_tail4
#print axioms fold_readback
end Port26ROW
end

import Port23PUSH_Source
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Port23PUSH
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- Full-result outer normalization of the *mutable source-emitted* push.
The row update is unchanged, with its external mutable-array primitive explicit.
No row-success, overflow, canonicality or in-range premise is imposed. -/
theorem push_complete (arrayIntoIter : ArrayIntoIter)
    (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (power : field.QM31) (basis : field.M31) :
    verifier.BatchedWeights.push arrayIntoIter b index power basis =
      (do
        let row ← alloc.vec.Vec.index
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array U64 4#usize)) b.raw index
        let updated ← verifier.update_residue_row arrayIntoIter row power basis
          ((b.terms &&& 3#usize) = 3#usize)
        ok {b with raw := b.raw.set index updated}) := by
  by_cases bound : index.val < b.raw.val.length
  · obtain ⟨row,hr,hrow⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec b.raw index bound)
    obtain ⟨⟨old,back⟩,hm,hold,hback⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_usize_spec b.raw index bound)
    have hm' : alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array U64 4#usize)) b.raw index =
        ok (old,back) := by
      rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_slice_index]
      exact hm
    have hr' : alloc.vec.Vec.index
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array U64 4#usize)) b.raw index =
        ok row := hr
    have oldrow : old = row := by
      simpa only [hold] using hrow.symm
    simp only [verifier.BatchedWeights.push, lift, bind_tc_ok, hm', hr', hback, oldrow]
    rfl
  · simp [verifier.BatchedWeights.push, alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_slice_index,
      alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_usize, alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize, bound,
      alloc.vec.Vec.index, core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice, Slice.index_usize, lift]

/-- An invalid index rejects before entering either row loop. -/
theorem push_bad_index (arrayIntoIter : ArrayIntoIter)
    (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (power : field.QM31) (basis : field.M31)
    (bad : ¬ index.val < b.raw.val.length) :
    verifier.BatchedWeights.push arrayIntoIter b index power basis = fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds := by
  rw [push_complete]
  simp [alloc.vec.Vec.index, core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice,
    alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize, Slice.index_usize, bad]

private theorem bind_ok {A B : Type} (m : Result A) (k : A → Result B) (out : B)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok out) : ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok out := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => cases h
  | div => cases h

/-- Entire successful Vec frame, not only equality of the selected row.
No bound or arithmetic domain is assumed. Failure/div behavior is in push_complete. -/
theorem push_success_frame (arrayIntoIter : ArrayIntoIter)
    (b after : verifier.BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (power : field.QM31) (basis : field.M31)
    (run : verifier.BatchedWeights.push arrayIntoIter b index power basis = ok after) :
    ∃ row updated,
      alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array U64 4#usize))
        b.raw index = ok row ∧
      verifier.update_residue_row arrayIntoIter row power basis
        ((b.terms &&& 3#usize) = 3#usize) = ok updated ∧
      after = {b with raw := b.raw.set index updated} := by
  rw [push_complete] at run
  obtain ⟨row,hr,run⟩ := bind_ok _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨updated,hu,run⟩ := bind_ok _ _ _ run
  exact ⟨row,updated,hr,hu,(Result.ok.inj run).symm⟩

#print axioms push_complete
#print axioms push_bad_index
#print axioms bind_ok
#print axioms push_success_frame
end Port23PUSH
end

import NEG_RowCertificate
import NEI_IteratorMeaning
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEI_RowBridge
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Power := NEG_RowAssociation.Power
/-- Weak success domain: only the reached checked additions must fit. No
canonical field or phase restriction is introduced by the row bridge. -/
def Domain (row : Array U64 4#usize) (p : Power) (basis : U32) : Prop :=
 ∀ j raw, j.val<4 → Array.index_usize row j=ok raw →
  raw.val+(S7Kani2OwnedRow.limb (NEG_RowBridge.modelPower p) j).val*basis.val<2^64

theorem complete (row : Array U64 4#usize) (p : Power) (basis : U32)
 (flush : Bool) (domain : Domain row p basis) :
 ∃ out, NEG_RowIsolated.update_residue_row row p basis flush=ok out ∧
 S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned row (NEG_RowBridge.modelPower p) basis flush=ok out := by
 obtain ⟨out, run⟩ := NEG_RowBridge.total row p basis flush domain
 exact ⟨out,run,by rw [← NEG_RowAssociation.emitted_to_owned];exact run⟩

/-- Exact all-outcome equality, for arbitrary continuation and raw input. -/
theorem continuation {α : Type} (row : Array U64 4#usize) (p : Power)
 (basis : U32) (flush : Bool) (k : Array U64 4#usize → Result α) :
 (do let out ← NEG_RowIsolated.update_residue_row row p basis flush; k out) =
 (do let out ← S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned row (NEG_RowBridge.modelPower p) basis flush; k out) :=
 NEG_RowCertificate.continuation row p basis flush k
#print axioms complete
#print axioms continuation
end NEI_RowBridge
end

import NEG_RowBridge
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEG_RowCertificate
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Power := NEG_RowAssociation.Power
/-- Both equalities concern the same result and the same original full carrier.
This is a model certificate; native/iterator/P6 transport remains external. -/
theorem same_run (row : Array U64 4#usize) (p : Power) (basis : U32) (terms : Nat)
    (canonical : ∀ j : Usize, j.val<4 →
      (S7Kani2OwnedRow.limb (NEG_RowBridge.modelPower p) j).val<2147483647)
    (basisCanonical : basis.val<2147483647)
    (phase : ∀ j raw, j.val<4 → Array.index_usize row j=ok raw →
      raw.val<2^34+(terms%4)*(2^31-2)^2) :
    ∃ out,
      NEG_RowIsolated.update_residue_row row p basis (decide (terms%4=3))=ok out ∧
      S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned row (NEG_RowBridge.modelPower p) basis
        (decide (terms%4=3))=ok out := by
  obtain ⟨out,run⟩ := NEG_RowBridge.from_phase row p basis terms canonical basisCanonical phase
  refine ⟨out,run,?_⟩
  rw [NEG_RowAssociation.emitted_to_owned] at run
  exact run

/-- Source-emitted equality transports arbitrary caller continuations, including
rejections and divergence, without an independent successful execution. -/
theorem continuation {α : Type} (row : Array U64 4#usize) (p : Power)
    (basis : U32) (flush : Bool) (k : Array U64 4#usize → Result α) :
    (do let out ← NEG_RowIsolated.update_residue_row row p basis flush; k out) =
    (do let out ← S7Kani2OwnedRow.residue_owned row (NEG_RowBridge.modelPower p) basis flush; k out) := by
  rw [NEG_RowAssociation.emitted_to_owned]
#print axioms same_run
#print axioms continuation
end NEG_RowCertificate
end

NEG_RowBridge.source:
import NEG_RowStepAssociation
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEG_RowBridge
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Power := NEG_RowAssociation.Power
abbrev modelPower (p : Power) := Port26ROW.toK (NEG_RowAssociation.toOld p)

theorem total (row : Array U64 4#usize) (p : Power) (basis : U32) (flush : Bool)
    (safe : ∀ j raw, j.val<4 → Array.index_usize row j=ok raw →
      raw.val+(S7Kani2OwnedRow.limb (modelPower p) j).val*basis.val<2^64) :
    ∃ out, NEG_RowIsolated.update_residue_row row p basis flush=ok out := by
  rw [NEG_RowAssociation.emitted_to_owned]
  exact S7Kani2OwnedRow.row_total row (modelPower p) basis flush safe

theorem from_phase (row : Array U64 4#usize) (p : Power) (basis : U32) (terms : Nat)
    (canonical : ∀ j : Usize, j.val<4 →
      (S7Kani2OwnedRow.limb (modelPower p) j).val<2147483647)
    (basisCanonical : basis.val<2147483647)
    (phase : ∀ j raw, j.val<4 → Array.index_usize row j=ok raw →
      raw.val<2^34+(terms%4)*(2^31-2)^2) :
    ∃ out, NEG_RowIsolated.update_residue_row row p basis (decide (terms%4=3))=ok out := by
  apply total
  intro j raw hj read
  exact S7OwnedP6ScalarProof.phase_bound raw _ basis (terms%4)
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)) (canonical j hj) basisCanonical (phase j raw hj read)

#print axioms total
#print axioms from_phase
end NEG_RowBridge
end

import NEG_RowAssociation
import NEG_RowDomain
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEG_RowStepAssociation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1

theorem product_ok (a b : U32) (ha : a.val < 2147483647) (hb : b.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ p : U64,
      ((core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from a) *
        (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from b) : Result U64) = ok p ∧
      p.val = a.val*b.val ∧ p.val ≤ 4611686009837453316 := by
  have wa := ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.widen_value a
  have wb := ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.widen_value b
  have bound := NEG_RowDomain.product_bound a.val b.val ha hb
  have fit : (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from a).val *
      (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from b).val < 2^64 := by rw [wa,wb]; omega
  obtain ⟨p,run,value⟩ := ExtractedCurrentReducerOps.mul_success _ _ fit
  refine ⟨p,run,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [wa,wb] using value
  · rw [value,wa,wb];exact bound

/-- The same emitted arithmetic site is an admissible specialization of the
native bounded-product log. This does not assume the desired row output. -/
theorem arithmetic_site (raw : U64) (a b : U32)
    (ha : a.val < 2147483647) (hb : b.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ p : U64, p.val = a.val*b.val ∧ p.val ≤ 4611686009837453316 ∧
      Port25ARRAY.addWord raw a b = (raw+p : Result U64) := by
  obtain ⟨p,run,value,bound⟩ := product_ok a b ha hb
  refine ⟨p,value,bound,?_⟩
  simp only [Port25ARRAY.addWord,lift,bind_tc_ok,run]

/-- All source iterations establish the exact domains of both CLOSED indexed
read helpers; no caller result, independent successful run, or free word is a
hypothesis. -/
theorem reads (row : Array U64 4#usize) (limbs : Array U32 4#usize)
    (j : Usize) (hj : j.val < 4) :
    ∃ old limb, NEG_RowIsolated.residue_limb_at row j = ok old ∧
      NEG_RowIsolated.power_limb_at limbs j = ok limb ∧
      old = row.val[j.val]'(by rw [row.property];exact hj) ∧
      limb = limbs.val[j.val]'(by rw [limbs.property];exact hj) := by
  obtain ⟨old,hr,hvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec row j (by scalar_tac))
  obtain ⟨limb,hl,lvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec limbs j (by scalar_tac))
  exact ⟨old,limb,hr,hl,hvalue,lvalue⟩

theorem reached_index (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize)
    (active : iter.start.val < iter.end.val) (stop : iter.end = 4#usize) :
    iter.start.val < 4 := by rw [stop] at active;exact active

/-- Phase-three bound retained by the frozen batching schedule. -/
def Bound (row : Nat) : Prop :=
  row ≤ 17179869183 + 3 * (2147483646 * 2147483646)

theorem product_bound (a b : Nat) (ha : a < 2147483647) (hb : b < 2147483647) :
    a*b ≤ 2147483646*2147483646 := by
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)

theorem checked_add_safe (row a b : Nat) (hr : Bound row)
    (ha : a < 2147483647) (hb : b < 2147483647) :
    row + a*b < 2^64 := by
  have hp := product_bound a b ha hb
  unfold Bound at hr
  omega

theorem u64_product_exact (a b : Nat) (ha : a < 2147483647) (hb : b < 2147483647) :
    NEG_ProductAbstraction.machineProduct 64 a b = a*b := by
  have hp := product_bound a b ha hb
  unfold NEG_ProductAbstraction.machineProduct

all canonical native products. No exact-product assumption enters Kani. -/

    (ha : a < 2147483647) (hb : b < 2147483647) :
    ∃ p, p ≤ 2147483646*2147483646 ∧ p=a*b :=
