NEG_ProductAbstraction.source:
import Aeneas
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEG_ProductAbstraction
/-- Integer specification for a wrapping multiplication site. This relation is
not a license to remove an actual Rust instruction without a native association. -/
def Product (width a b p : Nat) : Prop := p = (a * b) % 2^width

def machineProduct (width a b : Nat) : Nat := (a * b) % 2^width

theorem admissible (width a b : Nat) :
    Product width a b (machineProduct width a b) := by rfl

theorem unique (width a b p : Nat) (h : Product width a b p) :
    p = machineProduct width a b := h

theorem transfer (width a b : Nat) (P : Nat → Prop)
    (abstract : ∀ p, Product width a b p → P p) :
    P (machineProduct width a b) := abstract _ (admissible width a b)

/-- Products can be independent symbolic log entries provided each entry is
associated with the operands of the same reached native site. -/
theorem log_admissible (n width : Nat) (a b : Fin n → Nat) :
    ∀ i, Product width (a i) (b i) (machineProduct width (a i) (b i)) := by
  intro i
  exact admissible width (a i) (b i)

theorem log_transfer (n width : Nat) (a b : Fin n → Nat)
    (P : (Fin n → Nat) → Prop)
    (abstract : ∀ log, (∀ i, Product width (a i) (b i) (log i)) → P log) :
    P (fun i => machineProduct width (a i) (b i)) :=
  abstract _ (log_admissible n width a b)

/-- A relational arbitrary-prestate step transports invariants by induction.
The step refinement remains an explicit proof obligation. -/
theorem iterate_invariant {State : Type} (step : State → State)
    (I : State → Prop) (preserves : ∀ s, I s → I (step s))
    (initial : State) (h : I initial) (n : Nat) :
    I (Nat.rec initial (fun _ s => step s) n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ n ih => exact preserves _ ih

#print axioms admissible
#print axioms unique
#print axioms transfer
#print axioms log_admissible
#print axioms log_transfer
#print axioms iterate_invariant
end NEG_ProductAbstraction

/-- The repaired transformer interface merely composes the array and slice
borrow restorations. Its native realization is checked separately, for U64[4]. -/
theorem constructor (row : Array U64 4#usize) :
 NEG_RowIsolated.MutAArray.Insts.CoreIterTraitsCollectIntoIteratorMutATIterMut.into_iter row =
 ok (({slice := row.to_slice, i := 0} : Iter),
   fun transform => row.from_slice (transform {slice := row.to_slice, i := 0}).slice) := by

/-- Arbitrary active iterator state, including the exact backward write location. -/

 core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next it =
 ok (some (it.slice[it.i]), ({slice := it.slice, i := it.i+1} : Iter),
   fun tail value => match value with
    | none => tail
    | some v => {tail with slice := tail.slice.setAtNat it.i v}) := by
 unfold core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next
 simp only [dif_pos h]
 congr 1
 ext tail value <;> simp only
 all_goals first | rfl | (cases value <;> rfl)
theorem stopped (it : Iter) (h : ¬ it.i < it.slice.len.val) :
 core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next it = ok (none,it,fun tail _ => tail) := by

 rw [dif_neg h]

noncomputable section
namespace NEV_BorrowMaps
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NEV_AccumulateCarriers
/-- Same indexed value through the full-vector nominal carrier map. -/
theorem vector_read {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (v : alloc.vec.Vec A) (index : Usize)
    (inside : index.val<v.val.length) :
    ∃ value, Slice.index_usize v.deref index=ok value ∧
      Slice.index_usize (mapVec f v).deref index=ok (f value) := by
  obtain ⟨value,read,point⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec v index inside)
  have mappedInside : index.val<(mapVec f v).val.length := by
    simpa only [mapVec,List.length_map] using inside
  obtain ⟨mapped,mappedRead,mappedAt⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec (mapVec f v) index mappedInside)
  have mappedAt' : mapped=f (v.val[index.val]'inside) := by
    simpa only [mapVec,List.getElem_map] using mappedAt
  have same : mapped=f value := mappedAt'.trans (congrArg f point.symm)
  refine ⟨value,read,?_⟩
  exact mappedRead.trans (congrArg Result.ok same)

/-- The actual reached getter and the installed cohort read have the SAME
input index and returned four raw words, on the caller's length domain. -/
theorem weight_read (ops : AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops)
    (v : alloc.vec.Vec RawQ) (index : Usize) (inside : index.val<v.val.length) :
    ∃ q, NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulated_weight_at v.deref index=ok q ∧
      (NBF_RowInstall.install ops).op12 (mapVec toQ v).deref index=ok (toQ q) := by
  obtain ⟨q,read,mapped⟩ := vector_read toQ v index inside
  exact ⟨q,read,mapped⟩
#print axioms vector_read
#print axioms weight_read
end NEV_BorrowMaps

def normalized (q : Q) : Q :=
 ⟨⟨AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.reduce q.c0.a,AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.reduce q.c0.b⟩,
  ⟨AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.reduce q.c1.a,AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.reduce q.c1.b⟩⟩
def Canonical (q : Q) : Prop :=
 (q.c0.a.val<2147483647 ∧ q.c0.b.val<2147483647) ∧
 (q.c1.a.val<2147483647 ∧ q.c1.b.val<2147483647)

all-machine-word S1 law, rather than a new arithmetic proof. -/

    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.canonical_qm31 q=ok (normalized q) := by
  simp only [NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.canonical_qm31,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.canonical_qm31.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnTupleM31M31.call,
    NEV_CodeFieldBridge.rem,bind_tc_ok,normalized]
theorem reduce_identity (word : U32) (small : word.val<2147483647) :
    AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.reduce word=word := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [AspisS1M31Embedding.Total.reduce_val]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt small
theorem identity (q : Q) (canonical : Canonical q) : normalized q=q := by
  simp only [normalized,reduce_identity q.c0.a canonical.1.1,
    reduce_identity q.c0.b canonical.1.2,reduce_identity q.c1.a canonical.2.1,
    reduce_identity q.c1.b canonical.2.2]

    (q : NEV_AccumulateCarriers.RawQ)
    (canonical : Canonical (NEV_AccumulateRaw.NEV_Bindings.toCtorQ q)) :

        ok (NEV_AccumulateCarriers.toE e)) =
      (NBF_RowInstall.install ops).op1 (NEV_AccumulateCarriers.toQ q) := by
  simp only [NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_qm31,
    NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_qm31,
    total,identity _ canonical,bind_tc_ok,NEV_CodeFieldRaw.aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO]
  rfl

import NBF_Basis

namespace NBF_BasisInstall
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
/-- Scalar arithmetic uses the retained emitted probe definitions. Connecting
these callbacks to native field calls is the named NBC_FieldOps dependency. -/
def install (ops : Ops) : Ops :=
 {ops with
   op4 := ok 0#u32
   op5 := ok 1#u32
   op6 := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub,
   op7 := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul,
   op8 := fun x=>AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.add x x}

theorem block (ops : Ops) (basis : Array U32 256#usize) (node : U32)
 (n : Usize) (hn : n.val≤128) :
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0 (install ops)
   {start:=0#usize,«end»:=n} node basis n=
 S7Kani2BasisLoop.basis_block_owned AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul
   basis node n 0#usize := by
 rw [NBF_Basis.iterate (install ops) node n n.val
   {start:=0#usize,«end»:=n} basis hn rfl (by simp)]
 rw [S7Kani2BasisLoop.extracted_basis_block_composition _ basis node n 0#usize n.val hn (by simp)]
 rfl

theorem checked_mul (x y : Usize) (small : x.val*y.val≤4096) :
 (x*y : Result Usize)=ok (Usize.wrapping_mul x y) := by
 have capacity : 4096≤Usize.max := by scalar_tac
 have spec : WP.spec (x*y : Result Usize) (fun out=>out.val=x.val*y.val) := by
   apply UScalar.mul_spec
   simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using small.trans capacity
 obtain ⟨out,run,value⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists spec
 have same : out=Usize.wrapping_mul x y := by
   apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
   exact value.trans (Port3_Wrapping.wrap_mul_value x y small).symm
 exact run.trans (congrArg Result.ok same)
#print axioms block
#print axioms checked_mul
end NBF_BasisInstall

import NBF_RowsTotal
import S7Kani2BasisLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBF_Basis
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
/-- One emitted basis body is the inherited S7 block step. The only field
operation is the SAME explicit op7; bounded checked/wrapping offsets agree. -/
theorem step (ops : Ops) (node : U32) (n : Usize)
 (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
 (hn : n.val≤128) (finish : iter.end=n) (active : iter.start.val < n.val) :
 ∃ iter1, iter1.start.val=iter.start.val+1 ∧ iter1.end=iter.end ∧
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body ops node n iter basis=
   (do let out ← S7Kani2BasisLoop.step ops.op7 node n iter.start basis
       ok (cont (iter1,out))) := by
 obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,run,ho,hs,he⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_some_spec
     (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
     (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x;rfl) (by intro x y;rfl)
     iter (by rw [finish];exact active))
 subst o
 have add := Port3_Wrapping.checked_add n iter.start (by omega)
 refine ⟨iter1,hs,he,?_⟩
 simp [verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body,run,
   S7Kani2BasisLoop.step,add,lift]

theorem stop (ops : Ops) (node : U32) (n : Usize)
 (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
 (done : iter.end.val ≤ iter.start.val) :
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body ops node n iter basis=ok (.done basis) := by
 obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,run,ho,hi⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_none_spec
     (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
     (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x y;rfl) iter done)
 subst o
 simp [verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body,run]

/-- Result-valued association, preserving first failure/divergence, for the
actual native inner loop and inherited bounded S7 composition. -/
theorem iterate (ops : Ops) (node : U32) (n : Usize)
 (fuel : Nat) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
 (hn : n.val≤128) (finish : iter.end=n) (span : iter.start.val+fuel=n.val) :
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0 ops iter node basis n=
 S7Kani2BasisLoop.iterate (S7Kani2BasisLoop.step ops.op7 node n) fuel iter.start basis := by
 induction fuel generalizing iter basis with
 | zero =>
   unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0
   rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
   have halt := stop ops node n iter basis (by rw [finish];omega)
   simp only [halt,S7Kani2BasisLoop.iterate,bind_tc_ok]
 | succ k ih =>
   obtain ⟨iter1,hs,he,body⟩ := step ops node n iter basis hn finish (by omega)
   have inc := Port3_Wrapping.checked_add iter.start 1#usize (by change iter.start.val+1≤4096;omega)
   have idx : Usize.wrapping_add iter.start 1#usize=iter1.start := by
     apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
     rw [Port3_Wrapping.increment iter.start (by omega),hs]
   unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0
   rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
   simp only [body,S7Kani2BasisLoop.iterate,bind_assoc_eq,inc,idx,bind_tc_ok]
   cases run : S7Kani2BasisLoop.step ops.op7 node n iter.start basis with
   | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail]
   | div => simp only [bind_tc_div]
   | ok out =>
     simp only [bind_tc_ok]
     exact ih iter1 out (he.trans finish) (by omega)
#print axioms step
#print axioms stop
#print axioms iterate
end NBF_Basis

import NBF_Progress
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBF_RowsTotal
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
/-- Finite induction over the actual emitted row loop, using the inherited
phase progress witness at every reached pre-state. No accepted output premise. -/
theorem total (ops : Ops) (v : alloc.vec.Vec NBF_RowInstall.Q)
 (q : NBF_RowInstall.Q) (next : Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
 (fuel : Nat) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (b : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (t : Nat) (width : iter.end.val=64) (span : iter.start.val+fuel=64)
 (v64 : v.val.length=64)
 (progress : S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress t iter.start.val (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b))
 (hq : ∀ k, (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb (Port3_RowsInstall.toK q) k).val<2^31-1)
 (hb : ∀ j : Usize, j.val<64 → ∀ m, Array.index_usize basis j=ok m → m.val<2^31-1) :
 ∃ out, verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (NBF_RowInstall.install ops)
   iter v q next b 64#usize basis=ok out ∧
 S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress t 64 (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW out) := by
 induction fuel generalizing iter b with
 | zero =>
   have done : iter.end.val≤ iter.start.val := by omega
   have stop := Port3_NativeRowLoop.stopped (NBF_RowInstall.install ops)
     v q next 64#usize basis iter b done
   refine ⟨b,?_,by simpa only [show iter.start.val=64 by omega] using progress⟩
   unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
   rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
   simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,stop,bind_tc_ok]
 | succ n ih =>
   obtain ⟨iter1,b1,step,start,finish,progress1⟩ := NBF_Progress.body ops v q next basis
     iter b t width (by omega) v64 progress hq hb
   obtain ⟨out,tail,progressOut⟩ := ih iter1 b1 (by rw [finish];exact width)
     (by omega) progress1
   refine ⟨out,?_,progressOut⟩
   unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
   rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
   simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,step,bind_tc_ok]
   exact tail

/-- Every64-row traversal from cursor0 is total and establishes the next
phase for every row on the SAME actual output carrier. -/
theorem full (ops : Ops) (v : alloc.vec.Vec NBF_RowInstall.Q)
 (q : NBF_RowInstall.Q) (next : Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
 (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (v64 : v.val.length=64)
 (progress : S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress b.terms.val 0 (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b))
 (hq : ∀ k, (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb (Port3_RowsInstall.toK q) k).val<2^31-1)
 (hb : ∀ j : Usize, j.val<64 → ∀ m, Array.index_usize basis j=ok m → m.val<2^31-1) :
 ∃ out, verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (NBF_RowInstall.install ops)
   {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} v q next b 64#usize basis=ok out ∧
 out.terms=b.terms ∧ out.raw.val.length=64 ∧
 ∀ (j : Nat) (row : NBF_Frame.Row), out.raw.val[j]?=some row → NBB_Sweep.Bound (b.terms.val+1) row := by
 obtain ⟨out,run,hp⟩ := total ops v q next basis 64
   {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} b b.terms.val (by rfl) (by rfl) v64 progress hq hb
 have sweep := NBF_Progress.sweep b.terms.val 64 out hp
 refine ⟨out,run,?_,hp.2.1,?_⟩
 · apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq;exact hp.1
 · intro j row read
   have hi : j<64 := by
     have len : out.raw.val.length=64:=hp.2.1
     have := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp read).1
     omega
   simpa only [if_pos hi] using sweep j row read
#print axioms total
#print axioms full
end NBF_RowsTotal

NBF_Progress.source:
import NBF_RowInstall
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBF_Progress
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2
open S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement (makeRow)
/-- The inherited source progress invariant supplies the local raw-vector
cursor invariant, with no additional per-row phase assumption. -/
theorem sweep (t cursor : Nat) (b : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (progress : S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress t cursor (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b)) :
 NBB_Sweep.Inv t cursor b.raw := by
 intro j row read
 have hj : j<64 := by
   have lt := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp read).1
   have size : b.raw.val.length=64 := progress.2.1
   omega
 obtain ⟨x,get,phase⟩ := progress.2.2 j hj
 have eq : row=makeRow x := Option.some.inj (read.symm.trans get)
 subst row
 intro word mem
 simp only [makeRow,Array.make,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at mem
 rcases mem with rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl <;> exact phase _

/-- Every local direct native-body call gets its exact phase/read domain
from the inherited SAME progress witness. Its successor progress is derived. -/
theorem body (ops : Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops) (v : alloc.vec.Vec NBF_RowInstall.Q)
 (q : NBF_RowInstall.Q) (next : Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
 (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (b : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (t : Nat) (width : iter.end.val=64) (active : iter.start.val<64)
 (v64 : v.val.length=64)
 (progress : S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress t iter.start.val (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b))
 (hq : ∀ k, (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb (Port3_RowsInstall.toK q) k).val<2^31-1)
 (hb : ∀ j : Usize, j.val<64 → ∀ m, Array.index_usize basis j=ok m → m.val<2^31-1) :
 ∃ iter1 b1,
 Port3_NativeQueryBody.verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body
   (NBF_RowInstall.install ops) v q next 64#usize basis iter b=
   ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter1,b1)) ∧
 iter1.start.val=iter.start.val+1 ∧ iter1.end=iter.end ∧
 S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress t iter1.start.val (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b1) := by
 obtain ⟨x,get,phase⟩ := progress.2.2 iter.start.val active
 have inv : NBB_Sweep.Inv b.terms.val iter.start.val b.raw := by
   have terms : b.terms.val=t := progress.1
   rw [terms];exact sweep t iter.start.val b progress
 obtain ⟨iter1,row,run,start,finish,inv1⟩ := NBF_RowInstall.body ops v q next basis iter b x
   width active v64 inv get hq hb
 let b1 : verifier.BatchedWeights := {b with raw:=b.raw.set iter.start row}
 let y : Fin 4 → U64 := fun k=>row.val[k.val]'(by simpa [row.property] using k.isLt)
 have rebuild : makeRow y=row := by
   apply Subtype.ext
   apply List.ext_getElem
   · simp [makeRow,Array.make,row.property]
   · intro i h1 h2
     have hi : i<4 := by have len := row.property;change row.val.length=4 at len;omega
     interval_cases i <;> rfl
 have get1 : (b.raw.set iter.start row).val[iter.start.val]?=some row := by
   change (b.raw.val.set iter.start.val row)[iter.start.val]?=some row
   rw [List.getElem?_set_self (by have size : b.raw.val.length=64 := progress.2.1;omega)]
 have done : ∀ k, S7Kani3PhaseInvariant.Phase (t+1) (y k).val := by
   intro k
   have bounds := inv1 iter.start.val row get1 (y k) (List.getElem_mem _)
   have terms : b.terms.val=t := progress.1
   simpa [terms,NBB_Phase.Bound,S7Kani3PhaseInvariant.Phase,
     AspisR1BatchedFoldSourceStep.productCap] using bounds
 have pc : S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress t (iter.start.val+1) (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b1) := by
   have written := S7JoinRowsTrace.progress_write t iter.start.val (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b)
     y iter.start rfl active progress done
   change S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress t (iter.start.val+1)
     {Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b with raw:=b.raw.set iter.start row}
   simpa only [rebuild,Port3_RowsInstall.toBW] using written
 exact ⟨iter1,b1,run,start,finish,by simpa only [start] using pc⟩
#print axioms sweep
#print axioms body
end NBF_Progress

import NEV_BasisOuterRaw
import NBF_BasisDomain
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_BasisProducer
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def source (node : U32) : Result (Array U32 256#usize) := do
 let initial ← Array.update (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32) 0#usize 1#u32
 NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 1#u32 node 64#usize initial 1#usize
/-- The actual width64 initialization and six-level loop reach exactly the
retained basis producer, for every raw input node. -/
theorem association (ops : AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops) (node : U32) :
    source node=NBF_BasisDomain.source ops node := by
  have continuations :
      (fun initial : Array U32 256#usize =>
        NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 1#u32 node 64#usize initial 1#usize) =
      (fun initial : Array U32 256#usize =>
        AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryBody.verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0
          (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops) 1#u32 node 64#usize initial 1#usize) := by
    funext initial
    exact NEV_BasisOuterRaw.levels_eq ops 6 initial node 1#usize 64#usize
      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  exact congrArg (fun next : Array U32 256#usize → Result (Array U32 256#usize) =>
    do let initial ← Array.update (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32) 0#usize 1#u32
       next initial) continuations

theorem total (ops : AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops) (node : U32) :
    ∃ basis,source node=ok basis ∧ AspisR1.S7JoinBasisCanonical.Canonical basis := by
  rw [association ops node]
  exact NBF_BasisDomain.total ops node
/-- Caller domain is derived from the SAME actual returned basis and read. -/
theorem read_canonical (ops : AspisR1.Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops) (node : U32)
    (basis : Array U32 256#usize) (run : source node=ok basis)
    (index : Usize) (inside : index.val<256) (word : U32)
    (read : NEV_AccumulateRaw.basis_at basis index=ok word) : word.val<2147483647 := by
  rw [association ops node] at run
  exact NBF_BasisDomain.read_canonical ops node basis run index inside word read
#print axioms association
#print axioms total
#print axioms read_canonical
end NEV_BasisProducer
end

NEV_BasisOuterRaw.source:
import NEV_BasisOuterStep
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_BasisOuterRaw
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open S7Kani3BasisOuter (levels t2 double)
/-- Transport the new emitted outer loop through the retained six-level
schedule. Existing S7 totality supplies intermediate basis/node results. -/
theorem levels_eq (ops : Ops) (fuel : Nat) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
    (node : U32) (n width : Usize) (positive : 0<n.val) (bound : width.val≤256)
    (schedule : n.val*2^fuel=width.val) :
    NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 1#u32 node width basis n=
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops)
        1#u32 node width basis n := by
  induction fuel generalizing basis node n with
  | zero =>
    have done : ¬n<width := by
      change ¬n.val<width.val
      simp only [pow_zero,Nat.mul_one] at schedule
      omega
    unfold NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def,Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    dsimp only
    simp only [NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body,
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body,if_neg done,bind_tc_ok]
  | succ k ih =>
    have power : 0<2^k := by positivity
    have doubleBound : n.val*2≤width.val := by
      have : 1≤2^k := by omega
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (n.val*2) this
      rw [pow_succ] at schedule
      nlinarith
    have small : n.val≤128 := by omega
    have active : n<width := by
      change n.val<width.val
      have : 2≤2^(k+1) := by rw [pow_succ];omega
      nlinarith
    let n1 := Usize.wrapping_mul n 2#usize
    have successor : n1.val=n.val*2 := Port3_Wrapping.wrap_mul_value n 2#usize
      (by change n.val*2≤4096;omega)
    have block := NBF_BasisInstall.block ops basis node n small
    have body : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body
        (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops) 1#u32 width node basis n=
        (do let b1 ← S7Kani2BasisLoop.basis_block_owned
              AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul basis node n 0#usize
            let node1 ← t2 node
            ok (cont (node1,b1,n1))) := by
      unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body
      rw [if_pos active,block]
      simp only [NBF_BasisInstall.install,t2,double,lift,bind_tc_ok,bind_assoc_eq]
      rfl
    unfold NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def,Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    dsimp only
    rw [NEV_BasisOuterStep.body ops 1#u32 node width n basis small,body]
    obtain ⟨b1,hb⟩ := S7Kani3BasisTotal.block_total basis node n 0#usize n.val small (by simp)
    obtain ⟨node1,ht,hcanon⟩ := S7Kani3BasisOuter.t2_total node
    simp only [hb,ht,bind_tc_ok]
    exact ih b1 node1 n1 (by rw [successor];omega) (by
      rw [successor]
      rw [pow_succ] at schedule
      nlinarith)

#print axioms levels_eq
end NEV_BasisOuterRaw
end

import NEV_BasisRaw

noncomputable section
namespace NEV_BasisOuterStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody

theorem multiply (x y : U32) : NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.mul x y=
    AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul x y := by
  rw [NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.mul,NEI_FieldScalar.m_mul,
    AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.m31_mul_same]
theorem subtract (x y : U32) : NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.sub x y=
    AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub x y := by
  rw [NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.sub,NEI_FieldScalar.m_sub,
    AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.m31_sub_same]
theorem double (x : U32) : NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.double x=
    AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.add x x := by
  change NEI_LineFull.aspis_core.field.M31.add x x=_
  rw [NEI_FieldScalar.m_add,AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.m31_add_same]

/-- New emitted outer body uses the SAME retained inner loop, same node update,
and nonwrapping bounded doubling. No arithmetic recurrence is reproved. -/
theorem body (ops : Ops) (one node : U32) (width n : Usize)
    (basis : Array U32 256#usize) (small : n.val≤128) :
    NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body one width node basis n =
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body
        (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops) one width node basis n := by
  have inner := NEV_BasisRaw.inner_loop ops node n n.val
    {start:=0#usize,«end»:=n} basis small rfl (by simp)
  have counter := NBF_BasisInstall.checked_mul n 2#usize (by change n.val*2≤4096;omega)
  simp [NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body,
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body,inner,NBF_BasisInstall.install,
    multiply,subtract,double,counter,lift]

#print axioms multiply

#print axioms double

end NEV_BasisOuterStep

import NEV_AccumulateRaw.Funs
import NEI_FieldScalar
import NBF_BasisInstall
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_BasisRaw
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
/-- New actual-body association only. Arithmetic is the imported closed field
bridge, and the recurrence/induction below is the retained NBF/S7 recurrence. -/
theorem inner_step (ops : Ops) (node : U32) (n : Usize)
    (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
    (small : n.val≤128) (finish : iter.end=n) (active : iter.start.val<n.val) :
    NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body node n iter basis =
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body
        (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops) node n iter basis := by
  obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,run,ho,hs,he⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_some_spec
      (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
      (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x;rfl) (by intro x y;rfl)
      iter (by rw [finish];exact active))
  subst o
  have add := Port3_Wrapping.checked_add n iter.start (by omega)
  simp [NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body,
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body,run,bind_tc_ok,
    NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.mul,NEI_FieldScalar.m_mul,
    AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.m31_mul_same,NBF_BasisInstall.install,add,lift]

theorem inner_stop (ops : Ops) (node : U32) (n : Usize)
    (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
    (done : iter.end.val≤ iter.start.val) :
    NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body node n iter basis =
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body
        (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops) node n iter basis := by
  obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,run,ho,hi⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_none_spec
      (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
      (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x y;rfl) iter done)
  subst o
  simp only [NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body,
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body,run,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl

/-- The only new induction transports the newly imported checked Rust loop to
its already-proved NBF emitted loop. No basis arithmetic is reproved. -/
theorem inner_loop (ops : Ops) (node : U32) (n : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
    (small : n.val≤128) (finish : iter.end=n) (span : iter.start.val+fuel=n.val) :
    NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0 iter node basis n =
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0 (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops)
        iter node basis n := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter basis with
  | zero =>
    unfold NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def,Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    dsimp only
    have done : iter.end.val≤ iter.start.val := by rw [finish];omega
    rw [inner_stop ops node n iter basis done]
    rw [NBF_Basis.stop (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops) node n iter basis done]
  | succ k ih =>
    have active : iter.start.val<n.val := by omega
    obtain ⟨iter1,hs,he,body⟩ := NBF_Basis.step (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops)
      node n iter basis small finish active
    unfold NEV_AccumulateRaw.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def,Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    dsimp only
    rw [inner_step ops node n iter basis small finish active,body]
    cases step : S7Kani2BasisLoop.step (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops).op7 node n iter.start basis with
    | fail e => simp only [step,bind_tc_fail]
    | div => simp only [step,bind_tc_div]
    | ok out =>
      simp only [step,bind_tc_ok]
      exact ih iter1 out (he.trans finish) (by omega)

#print axioms inner_step
#print axioms inner_stop
#print axioms inner_loop
end NEV_BasisRaw

import SAQ_RawWide
import SAQ_LineEmbedding
import R1ZCircleFoldMathV1
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SAQ_LineSource
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof
abbrev FP := ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P
def quarter : U32 := 536870912#u32
def decodeBase (x : U32) : FP := x.val
def values4 {K : Type} (a b c d : K) (i : Fin 4) : K :=
  match i.val with | 0 => a | 1 => b | 2 => c | _ => d
private theorem values4_0 {K : Type} (a b c d : K) : values4 a b c d 0=a := rfl
private theorem values4_1 {K : Type} (a b c d : K) : values4 a b c d 1=b := rfl
private theorem values4_2 {K : Type} (a b c d : K) : values4 a b c d 2=c := rfl
private theorem values4_3 {K : Type} (a b c d : K) : values4 a b c d 3=d := rfl
private theorem decodeQuarter : decodeBase quarter=R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustQuarter := rfl
private theorem decodeHalf : decodeBase (1073741824#u32)=R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf := rfl

theorem baseMul (x y z : U32) (h : field.M31.mul x y=ok z) :
    z.val<2147483647 ∧ decodeBase z=decodeBase x*decodeBase y := by
  rw [m31_mul_same] at h
  exact ⟨R17CurrentDomainCanonical.mul_success_canonical x y z h,
    R17CurrentM31Semantics.current_mul_decode x y z h⟩

theorem scale (x z : E) (s : U32) (h : field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 x s=ok z) :
    CanonicalWide z ∧ decodeWide z=decodeWide x *
      algebraMap FP AspisWideTower.WideExact (decodeBase s) :=
  SAQ_LineEmbedding.scale x z s h

def line
  (alpha : E)
  (a : Array E 4#usize)
  (inverse : Array U32 5#usize) :
  Result E
  := do
  let ix ← Array.index_usize inverse 2#usize
  let iy ← Array.index_usize inverse 3#usize
  let iz ← Array.index_usize inverse 4#usize
  let a1 ← Array.index_usize a 0#usize
  let b ← Array.index_usize a 1#usize
  let c ← Array.index_usize a 2#usize
  let d ← Array.index_usize a 3#usize
  let we ← field.wide_exact.WideExact.add a1 b
  let we1 ← field.wide_exact.WideExact.add we c
  let we2 ← field.wide_exact.WideExact.add we1 d
  let h0 ← field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 we2 quarter
  let we3 ← field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub we c
  let we4 ← field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub we3 d
  let m ← field.M31.mul quarter iz
  let h2 ← field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 we4 m
  let we5 ← field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub a1 b
  let m1 ← field.M31.mul 1073741824#u32 ix

structure Cuts (alpha a b c d : E) (lx ly lz : U32) (out : E) where
  we : E

theorem cuts (alpha a b c d out : E) (ix iy lx ly lz : U32)
    (h : line alpha (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])
      (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz])=ok out) :
    Nonempty (Cuts alpha a b c d lx ly lz out) := by
  have ia0 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 0#usize = .ok a := rfl

  obtain ⟨we,Hwe,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h

  obtain ⟨we5,Hwe5,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨m1,Hm1,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h

  obtain ⟨we6,Hwe6,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h

import SAQ_RawQM
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SAQ_RawWide
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof

theorem add_exact (x y z : E) (h : field.wide_exact.WideExact.add x y=ok z) :
    decodeWide z=decodeWide x+decodeWide y := by
  unfold field.wide_exact.WideExact.add at h
  obtain ⟨a,ha,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨b,hb,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  have same : (⟨a,b⟩ : E)=z := Result.ok.inj h
  subst z
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · exact SAQ_RawQM.add_exact x.c0 y.c0 a ha
  · exact SAQ_RawQM.add_exact x.c1 y.c1 b hb

theorem sub_exact (x y z : E) (h : field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub x y=ok z) :
    decodeWide z=decodeWide x-decodeWide y := by
  unfold field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub at h
  obtain ⟨a,ha,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨b,hb,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  have same : (⟨a,b⟩ : E)=z := Result.ok.inj h
  subst z
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · exact qm_sub_exact x.c0 y.c0 a ha
  · exact qm_sub_exact x.c1 y.c1 b hb

theorem mul_exact (x y z : E) (h : field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul x y=ok z) :
    CanonicalWide z ∧ decodeWide z=decodeWide x*decodeWide y := by
  unfold field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul at h
  obtain ⟨ac,hac,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨bd,hbd,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨qa,hqa,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨qb,hqb,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨cross,hcross,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨u,hu,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨lo,hlo,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨diff,hdiff,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨hi,hhi,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  have same : (⟨lo,hi⟩ : E)=z := Result.ok.inj h
  subst z
  have dac := SAQ_RawQM.mul_exact x.c0 y.c0 ac hac
  have dbd := SAQ_RawQM.mul_exact x.c1 y.c1 bd hbd
  have dqa := SAQ_RawQM.add_exact x.c0 x.c1 qa hqa
  have dqb := SAQ_RawQM.add_exact y.c0 y.c1 qb hqb
  have dcross := SAQ_RawQM.mul_exact qa qb cross hcross
  have cu := mul_u_success_canonical bd u dbd.1 hu
  have dlo := qm_add_success ac u lo dac.1 cu hlo
  have cd := qm_sub_success_canonical cross ac diff dcross.1 dac.1 hdiff
  have ch := qm_sub_success_canonical diff bd hi cd dbd.1 hhi
  refine ⟨⟨dlo.1,ch⟩,?_⟩
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · simp only [decodeWide,QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul]
    rw [dlo.2,mul_u_exact bd u hu,dac.2,dbd.2]
    ring
  · simp only [decodeWide,QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul,zero_mul,zero_add,add_zero]
    rw [qm_sub_exact diff bd hi hhi,qm_sub_exact cross ac diff hdiff,
      dcross.2,dqa,dqb,dac.2,dbd.2]
    ring

#print axioms add_exact
#print axioms sub_exact
#print axioms mul_exact
end AspisR1.SAQ_RawWide
end

import SAQ_WideABI
import R17CurrentDomainCanonical
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SAQ_RawCM
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof
abbrev C := field.CM31
def Canon (x : C) : Prop := x.a.val<2147483647 ∧ x.b.val<2147483647

theorem add_exact (x y z : C) (h : field.CM31.add x y=ok z) :
    decodeC z=decodeC x+decodeC y := by
  unfold field.CM31.add at h
  obtain ⟨a,ha,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨b,hb,h⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ h
  have same : (⟨a,b⟩ : C)=z := Result.ok.inj h
  subst z
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · exact m31_add_exact x.a y.a a ha
  · exact m31_add_exact x.b y.b b hb

theorem mul_exact (x y z : C) (h : field.CM31.mul x y=ok z) :
    Canon z ∧ decodeC z=decodeC x*decodeC y := by
  have hm := cm_mul_same x y
  rw [h,bind_tc_ok] at hm
  have hr := R17CurrentCM31Semantics.current_cm31_mul_decode (toCM x) (toCM y) (toCM z) hm.symm
  have hc := R17CurrentDomainCanonical.arithmetic_cm_mul_success_canonical
    (toCM x) (toCM y) (toCM z) hm.symm
  refine ⟨hc,?_⟩
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · simpa [decodeC,decodeM,toCM,R17CurrentCM31Semantics.decodeCM,
      R17CurrentM31Semantics.decode,R17FibrePointDecodedProduct.cm31Product,
      QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul,sub_eq_add_neg] using congrArg Prod.fst hr
  · simpa [decodeC,decodeM,toCM,R17CurrentCM31Semantics.decodeCM,
      R17CurrentM31Semantics.decode,R17FibrePointDecodedProduct.cm31Product,
      QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul] using congrArg Prod.snd hr

theorem add_canonical (x y z : C) (hx : Canon x) (hy : Canon y)
    (h : field.CM31.add x y=ok z) : Canon z := by
  have hm := cm_add_same x y
  rw [h,bind_tc_ok] at hm
  obtain ⟨out,ho,hc,_,_⟩ := ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.current_cm_add_mod (toCM x) (toCM y) hx hy
  have same : toCM z=out := Result.ok.inj (hm.trans ho)
  change ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM (toCM z)
  rw [same]
  exact hc

theorem sub_canonical (x y z : C) (hx : Canon x) (hy : Canon y)
    (h : field.CM31.sub x y=ok z) : Canon z := by
  have hm := cm_sub_same x y
  rw [h,bind_tc_ok] at hm
  obtain ⟨out,ho,hc,_,_⟩ := ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.current_cm_sub_mod (toCM x) (toCM y) hx hy
  have same : toCM z=out := Result.ok.inj (hm.trans ho)
  change ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM (toCM z)
  rw [same]
  exact hc

theorem by_r_canonical (x z : C) (hx : Canon x)
    (h : field.mul_by_r x=ok z) : Canon z := by
  have hm := mul_by_r_same x
  rw [h,bind_tc_ok] at hm
  obtain ⟨out,ho,hc⟩ := AspisR1CurrentWideMul.by_r_total (toCM x) hx
  have same : toCM z=out := Result.ok.inj (hm.trans ho)
  change ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM (toCM z)
  rw [same]
  exact hc

#print axioms add_exact
#print axioms mul_exact
#print axioms add_canonical
#print axioms sub_canonical
#print axioms by_r_canonical
end AspisR1.SAQ_RawCM
end

def toQ (x : K) : Q := ⟨⟨x.c0.a,x.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c1.a,x.c1.b⟩⟩
def fromQ (x : Q) : K := ⟨⟨x.c0.a,x.c0.b⟩,⟨x.c1.a,x.c1.b⟩⟩

theorem q_canonical (x : K) : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical x ↔
    AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.CanonicalQM (toQ x) := by
  unfold Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.CanonicalQM
  change (_ ∧ _ ∧ _ ∧ _) ↔ ((_ ∧ _) ∧ (_ ∧ _))
  tauto

    AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.CanonicalWide (toW x) := by
  exact and_congr (q_canonical x.c0) (q_canonical x.c1)

  rfl

  exact congrArg₂ (fun a b => (⟨a,b⟩ : OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.E))
    (q_decode x.c0) (q_decode x.c1)

import Port5Q1_QueryPorts
import R17CurrentM31Semantics
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SAQ_Query
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Ops := Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops

/-- Select the extracted scalar bodies used by the shipped query arithmetic.
All wide, parser, geometry and observation slots are preserved. -/
def install (ops : Ops) : Ops :=
  {ops with
    op4 := ok 0#u32
    op5 := ok 1#u32
    op6 := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub
    op7 := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul
    op8 := S7Kani3BasisOuter.double}

theorem basis (ops : Ops) : Port4C_BasisOuter.SessionABasis (install ops) :=
  ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

theorem m31 (ops : Ops) : Port5Q1_NodeModel.SessionAM31 (install ops) := by
  constructor
  · intro x y z run
    exact R17CurrentM31Semantics.current_mul_decode x y z run
  · intro x y run
    have h := R17CurrentM31Semantics.current_add_decode x x y run
    change S7JoinBasisMachine.decode y = 2*S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x
    change S7JoinBasisMachine.decode y = S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x + S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x at h
    rw [h]; ring
  · intro x run
    have same : 1#u32=x := Result.ok.inj run
    subst x
    rfl
  · intro x y z run
    exact R17CurrentM31Semantics.current_sub_decode x y z run

/-- Only the primitive rows not discharged by scalar source selection. -/
structure Remaining (ops : Ops) : Prop where
  arithmetic : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.SessionABackends ops
  decoder : Port5Q1_OpeningValues.SessionAS3 ops
  line : ∀ alpha values inverse value, ops.op16 alpha values inverse=ok value →
    CheckpointBytes5Output.ofE value=FoldRuntimeAlgebra.lineWithInverses
      (CheckpointBytes5Output.ofE alpha)
      (algebraMap Port5Q1_QueryPorts.FP Port5Q1_QueryPorts.FE
        (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port5Q1_GeometryBinding.lane inverse 2)))
      (algebraMap Port5Q1_QueryPorts.FP Port5Q1_QueryPorts.FE
        (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port5Q1_GeometryBinding.lane inverse 3)))
      (algebraMap Port5Q1_QueryPorts.FP Port5Q1_QueryPorts.FE
        (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port5Q1_GeometryBinding.lane inverse 4)))
      (Port5Q1_OpeningValues.values values)
  line_canonical : ∀ alpha values inverse value,
    ops.op16 alpha values inverse=ok value → Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE value

theorem primitives (ops : Ops) (rest : Remaining (install ops)) :
    Port5Q1_QueryPorts.SessionAPrimitives (install ops) :=
  ⟨basis ops,rest.arithmetic,m31 ops,rest.decoder,rest.line,rest.line_canonical⟩

/-- Selection does not change any dictionary already bound to these bodies. -/
theorem fixed (ops : Ops) (h : Port4C_BasisOuter.SessionABasis ops) :
    install ops=ops := by
  cases ops
  cases h
  simp_all only [install]

#print axioms basis
#print axioms m31
#print axioms primitives
#print axioms fixed
end AspisR1.SAQ_Query
end

import Port5Q1_OpeningValues
import Port5Q1_GeometryAccessor
import Port5Q1_NodeModel
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port5Q1_QueryPorts
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open CheckpointBytes5Output (ofK ofE)
abbrev FE := OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.E
abbrev FK := OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.K
abbrev FP := ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P

def install (ops : Ops) : Ops :=
  {ops with op11 := Port4B_Opening.opening, op18 := Port5Q1_GeometryBinding.forQuery}

/-- Session A op7 port on the SAME returned Prepared. No query/geometry or
accumulator result is a preparation field. Its concrete instance is upstream. -/
structure SessionAPrepare (p : verifier.Prepared) (data : MatchingSupport.Data FE)
    (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144) (rho : FK) : Prop where
  queries : ∀ i (hi : i<22),
    (Port5Q1_GeometryBinding.queryAt p.queries i).val=(q ⟨i,hi⟩).val
  rho_eq : ofK p.rho=rho
  rho_canonical : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical p.rho
  alpha1 : ∀ alpha, Array.index_usize p.alpha 1#usize=ok alpha → ofE alpha=data.alpha1

/-- Named S3/S4/S5/S9 local primitive ports. Each field refers to an actual
helper operand/result, never a parsed query, successful parent or advance. -/
structure SessionAPrimitives (ops : Ops) : Prop where
  basis : Port4C_BasisOuter.SessionABasis ops
  arithmetic : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.SessionABackends ops
  m31 : Port5Q1_NodeModel.SessionAM31 ops
  decoder : Port5Q1_OpeningValues.SessionAS3 ops
  line : ∀ alpha values inverse value, ops.op16 alpha values inverse=ok value →
    ofE value=FoldRuntimeAlgebra.lineWithInverses (ofE alpha)
      (algebraMap FP FE (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port5Q1_GeometryBinding.lane inverse 2)))
      (algebraMap FP FE (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port5Q1_GeometryBinding.lane inverse 3)))
      (algebraMap FP FE (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port5Q1_GeometryBinding.lane inverse 4)))
      (Port5Q1_OpeningValues.values values)
  line_canonical : ∀ alpha values inverse value,
    ops.op16 alpha values inverse=ok value → Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE value

#print install
end AspisR1.Port5Q1_QueryPorts

import Port4C_QueryStd
import Port4C_QueryArithmetic
import Port4B_Opening
import R1FoldedLeafCodec
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port5Q1_OpeningValues
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2
open Port3_NativeQueryBody
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames
open MultiproofConeCanonical MultiproofConeSlices
open OraclePortCompactDraft
abbrev E := aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
abbrev FE := AspisWideTower.WideExact

def zero : E := ⟨⟨⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩,⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩⟩,⟨⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩,⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩⟩⟩
def values (a : Array E 4#usize) (j : Fin 4) : FE :=
  CheckpointBytes5Output.ofE (a.val[j.val]?.getD zero)

/-- Session A S3's exact strict byte-decoder port, on its own operand slice.
This mentions no parsed proof, query/fold, Prepared or model result. -/
structure SessionAS3 (ops : Ops) : Prop where
  decode : ∀ bytes i value, i.val<4 → bytes.val.length=128 → ops.op21 bytes i=ok value →
    FoldedLeafCodec.decodeWide (slice (bytesOf bytes.val) (32*i.val) 32)=
      some (CheckpointBytes5Output.ofE value)

theorem read (ops : Ops) (decoder : SessionAS3 ops) (opening : Slice U8)
    (size : opening.val.length=832) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val<4) (value : E)
    (run : Port4C_QueryStd.readValue ops opening i=ok value) :
    FoldedLeafCodec.decodeWide
      (slice (slice (bytesOf opening.val) 672 128) (32*i.val) 32)=
        some (CheckpointBytes5Output.ofE value) := by
  have loVal : (672#usize).val=672 := by scalar_tac
  have hiVal : (800#usize).val=800 := by scalar_tac
  have range := range_total opening 672#usize 800#usize (by decide) (by rw [size]; decide)
  unfold Port4C_QueryStd.readValue at run
  rw [range,bind_tc_ok] at run
  have length : (sub opening 672#usize 800#usize).val.length=128 := by
    have h := sub_length opening 672#usize 800#usize (by decide) (by rw [size]; decide)
    rw [loVal,hiVal] at h
    exact h
  have exact := decoder.decode (sub opening 672#usize 800#usize) i value hi length run
  simpa only [bytes_sub,loVal,hiVal] using exact

theorem four (ops : Ops) (decoder : SessionAS3 ops) (opening : Slice U8)
    (size : opening.val.length=832) (out : Array E 4#usize)
    (run : (Port4C_QueryStd.install ops).op0 4#usize
      (verifier.candidate.query_values.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeWideExact
        (Port4C_QueryStd.install ops)) opening=ok out) :
    FoldedLeafCodec.decodeFolded (slice (bytesOf opening.val) 672 128)=some (values out) := by
  obtain ⟨v0,v1,v2,v3,r0,r1,r2,r3,contents⟩ := Port4C_QueryStd.four_reads ops opening out run
  apply (FoldedLeafCodec.decodeFolded_eq_some_iff _ _).2
  constructor
  · unfold slice bytesOf
    rw [List.length_take,List.length_drop,List.length_map,size]
    rfl
  · intro j
    have h0 := read ops decoder opening size 0#usize (by decide) v0 r0
    have h1 := read ops decoder opening size 1#usize (by decide) v1 r1
    have h2 := read ops decoder opening size 2#usize (by decide) v2 r2
    have h3 := read ops decoder opening size 3#usize (by decide) v3 r3
    fin_cases j
    · simp only [values,contents,List.getElem?_cons_zero,List.getElem?_cons_succ,Option.getD_some]
      exact h0
    · simp only [values,contents,List.getElem?_cons_zero,List.getElem?_cons_succ,Option.getD_some]
      exact h1
    · simp only [values,contents,List.getElem?_cons_zero,List.getElem?_cons_succ,Option.getD_some]
      exact h2
    · simp only [values,contents,List.getElem?_cons_zero,List.getElem?_cons_succ,Option.getD_some]
      exact h3

#print axioms read
#print axioms four
end AspisR1.Port5Q1_OpeningValues
end

Port4C_QueryArithmetic.source:
import Port4C_QueryValues

/-! Primitive S3/S4/S5/S9 backend ports remain session A hypotheses. They
mention only the primitive's actual operands/result, not a query, accepted
transaction, trace or desired advance law. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_QueryArithmetic
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2
open Port3_NativeQueryBody Port4C_QueryValues
open CheckpointBytes5Output (ofE ofK)
abbrev FK := OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.K
abbrev FE := OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.E

def CanonE (x : E) : Prop :=
  Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical x.c0 ∧ Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical x.c1

structure SessionABackends (ops : Ops) : Prop where
  s3_s4_s5_mulE : ∀ value power product,
    CanonE value → Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical power →
    ops.op3 value power=ok product →
    ofE product=ofE value * LiteralOpeningView.eK (ofK power) ∧ CanonE product
  s3_s4_s5_addE : ∀ left right sum,
    CanonE left → CanonE right → ops.op2 left right=ok sum →
    ofE sum=ofE left+ofE right ∧ CanonE sum
  s3_s4_s9_mulK : ∀ left right product,
    Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical left → Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical right →
    ops.op9 left right=ok product →
    ofK product=ofK left*ofK right ∧ Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical product

/-- The output rhs/power are decoded from the SAME native accumulation.
The row updates stay in pending until flush, so this does not assert that the
unflushed physical weights have already changed. -/
theorem accumulation (ops : Ops) (backend : SessionABackends ops)
    (p : verifier.Prepared) (a out : verifier.Accumulator) (node : M) (value : E)
    (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights)
    (hp : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical a.power)
    (hrho : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical p.rho) (hrhs : CanonE a.rhs)
    (hv : CanonE value)
    (h : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node ops p a node value b=ok (out,bout)) :
    ofE out.rhs=ofE a.rhs+LiteralOpeningView.eK (ofK a.power)*ofE value ∧
    ofK out.power=ofK a.power*ofK p.rho ∧ CanonE out.rhs ∧
    Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical out.power := by
  obtain ⟨product,hprod,hadd,hmul,_,_⟩ := Port4C_QueryValues.accumulated ops p a out node value b bout h
  have product := backend.s3_s4_s5_mulE value a.power product hv hp hprod
  have sum := backend.s3_s4_s5_addE a.rhs _ out.rhs hrhs product.2 hadd
  have power := backend.s3_s4_s9_mulK a.power p.rho out.power hp hrho hmul
  refine ⟨?_,power.1,sum.2,power.2⟩
  rw [sum.1,product.1,mul_comm]

/-- Opening/fold/geometry observations are derived from this call. A caller
may instantiate the line-value interpretation on precisely that observation.
There is no separately supplied successful opening or accumulation. -/
theorem query (ops : Ops) (backend : SessionABackends ops)
    (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a out : verifier.Accumulator)
    (g : Array E 29#usize) (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
    (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights)
    (hp : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical a.power)
    (hrho : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical p.rho) (hrhs : CanonE a.rhs)
    (line_canonical : ∀ alpha values inverses value,
      ops.op16 alpha values inverses=ok value → CanonE value)
    (h : verifier.candidate.query_values ops proof p a g obs geometry b=ok (.Ok (out,bout))) :
    ∃ o : Observation ops proof p a out g obs geometry b bout,
      ofE out.rhs=ofE a.rhs+LiteralOpeningView.eK (ofK a.power)*ofE o.value ∧
      ofK out.power=ofK a.power*ofK p.rho ∧ out.next.val=a.next.val+1 ∧
      out.weights=a.weights ∧ CanonE out.rhs ∧ Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical out.power := by
  obtain ⟨o⟩ := Port4C_QueryValues.observed ops proof p a out g obs geometry b bout h
  have fields := Port3_NativeQueryFrame.query_fields ops proof p a out g obs geometry b bout h
  have arithmetic := accumulation ops backend p a out o.node o.value b bout hp hrho hrhs
    (line_canonical o.alpha1 o.values o.inverse o.value o.line) o.accumulate
  exact ⟨o,arithmetic.1,arithmetic.2.1,fields.2.2,fields.2.1,arithmetic.2.2⟩

#print axioms accumulation
#print axioms query
end AspisR1.Port4C_QueryArithmetic
end

Port5Q1_GeometryAccessor.source:
import Port5Q1_GeometryReads
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port5Q1_GeometryAccessor
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2
open Port5Q1_GeometryBinding
attribute [local irreducible] Port5Q1_Domain.words Port5Q1_Domain.lineZ

theorem offset (i start : Usize) (order : start.val ≤ i.val) :
    (Usize.wrapping_sub i start).val=i.val-start.val := by
  have ib : i.val<UScalar.size .Usize := by rw [UScalar.size_def]; exact i.bv.isLt
  have sb : start.val<UScalar.size .Usize := by rw [UScalar.size_def]; exact start.bv.isLt
  rw [Usize.wrapping_sub_val_eq,
    show i.val+(UScalar.size .Usize-start.val)=UScalar.size .Usize+(i.val-start.val) by omega,
    Nat.add_mod,Nat.mod_self,Nat.zero_add,Nat.mod_mod,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]

/-- Both actual native reads select the SAME query in the SAME returned
geometry. No fresh inverse array or independently successful read is chosen. -/
theorem reads (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start end1 : Usize)
    (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (binding : Binding queries start end1 geometry)
    (i : Usize) (lo : start.val ≤ i.val) (hi : i.val<end1.val)
    (inverse : Array U32 5#usize) (z : U32)
    (inverseRead : forQuery geometry i=ok inverse)
    (zRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U32)
      geometry.line_z (Usize.wrapping_sub i geometry.start)=ok z) :
    S7JoinBasisMachine.decode z=Port5Q1_Domain.lineZ (queryAt queries i.val).val ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 5, S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (lane inverse j)=
      ((Port5Q1_Domain.words (queryAt queries i.val).val)[j.val]?.getD 0)⁻¹) := by
  have ov : (Usize.wrapping_sub i geometry.start).val=i.val-start.val := by
    rw [binding.start_eq,offset i start lo]
  have localBound : i.val-start.val<end1.val-start.val := by omega
  obtain ⟨actual,run,contents⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec geometry.line_z (Usize.wrapping_sub i geometry.start)
      (by change (Usize.wrapping_sub i geometry.start).val<geometry.line_z.val.length; rw [ov,binding.line_size]; exact localBound))
  have same : actual=z := Result.ok.inj (run.symm.trans zRead)
  have zCell : geometry.line_z.val[i.val-start.val]?.getD 0#u32=z := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by rw [binding.line_size]; exact localBound),Option.getD_some]
    simpa only [ov] using contents.symm.trans same
  obtain ⟨actual,run,contents⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec geometry.inverses (Usize.wrapping_sub i geometry.start)
      (by change (Usize.wrapping_sub i geometry.start).val<geometry.inverses.val.length; rw [ov,binding.inverse_size]; exact localBound))
  have same : actual=inverse := Result.ok.inj (run.symm.trans inverseRead)
  have iCell : geometry.inverses.val[i.val-start.val]?.getD
      (Array.make 5#usize [0#u32,0#u32,0#u32,0#u32,0#u32])=inverse := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by rw [binding.inverse_size]; exact localBound),Option.getD_some]
    simpa only [ov] using contents.symm.trans same
  have indexEq : start.val+(i.val-start.val)=i.val := by omega
  constructor
  · have hz := binding.line (i.val-start.val) localBound
    rw [zCell,indexEq] at hz
    exact hz
  · intro j
    have hx := binding.inverses (i.val-start.val) localBound j
    rw [iCell,indexEq] at hx
    exact hx

#print axioms offset
#print axioms reads
end AspisR1.Port5Q1_GeometryAccessor
end

abbrev FP := ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P
variable {CoreError : Type}
theorem accepted (ops : Ops CoreError)
    (leaves : Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.SessionAPrimitives ops)
    (domain : Port5Q1_Domain.SessionADomain ops)
    (multiply : ops.op9=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul)
    (one : ops.op7=ok (1#u32))
    (inverseLeaf : ops.op11=Port4C_InverseExecution.inverse_owned)
    (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start end1 : Usize) (out : verifier.QueryGeometry)
    (nonempty : start.val<end1.val)
    (run : Port3_GeometryStage.geometry (Port5Q1_GeometryTerminal.install ops)
      queries start end1=ok (.Ok out)) : Binding queries start end1 out := by
  obtain ⟨flat,inverse,hs,hlen,flatlen,canon,nonzero,invlen,values,groups,flatMeaning,lineMeaning⟩ :=
    Port5Q1_GeometryModel.for_range ops leaves domain multiply one inverseLeaf queries start end1 out nonempty run
  have range := Port4C_GeometryRange.accepted_range (Port5Q1_GeometryTerminal.install ops)
    queries start end1 out run
  obtain ⟨_,order,bound,_,_⟩ := range
  refine ⟨hs,nonempty,bound,hlen,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [groups,List.length_map,List.length_range]
  · exact Port5Q1_GeometryLine.line_cells queries start end1 out order bound lineMeaning
  · exact Port5Q1_GeometryInverseCells.inverse_cells queries start end1 out order bound flat inverse flatlen values groups flatMeaning

#print axioms accepted
end AspisR1.Port5Q1_GeometryReads

namespace AspisR1.Port5Q1_GeometryBinding

def queryAt (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (i : Nat) : U32 := queries.val[i]?.getD 0#u32
def lane (a : Array U32 5#usize) (j : Fin 5) : U32 := a.val[j.val]?.getD 0#u32

def forQuery (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (i : Usize) : Result (Array U32 5#usize) :=
  alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array U32 5#usize))
    geometry.inverses (Usize.wrapping_sub i geometry.start)

structure Binding (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start end1 : Usize)
    (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) : Prop where
  start_eq : geometry.start=start
  order : start.val<end1.val
  bound : end1.val≤22
  line_size : geometry.line_z.val.length=end1.val-start.val
  inverse_size : geometry.inverses.val.length=end1.val-start.val
  line : ∀ i, i<end1.val-start.val →
    S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (geometry.line_z.val[i]?.getD 0#u32)=
      Port5Q1_Domain.lineZ (queryAt queries (start.val+i)).val
  inverses : ∀ i, i<end1.val-start.val → ∀ j : Fin 5,
    S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (lane (geometry.inverses.val[i]?.getD
      (Array.make 5#usize [0#u32,0#u32,0#u32,0#u32,0#u32])) j)=
      ((Port5Q1_Domain.words (queryAt queries (start.val+i)).val)[j.val]?.getD 0)⁻¹

Port5Q1_ListCells.source:
import Port5Q1_GeometryModel
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port5Q1_ListCells
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
abbrev FP := ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P

theorem map_cell (xs : List U32) (i : Nat) :
    (xs.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode)[i]?.getD 0=
      S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (xs[i]?.getD 0#u32) := by
  rw [List.getElem?_map]
  cases xs[i]? <;> rfl

theorem flat_cell {A B : Type} (f : A → List B) (arity : ∀ x, (f x).length=5)
    (xs : List A) (i j : Nat) (hi : i<xs.length) (hj : j<5) :
    (xs.flatMap f)[5*i+j]?=(f xs[i])[j]? := by
  induction i generalizing xs with
  | zero =>
    cases xs with
    | nil => simp at hi
    | cons x tail =>
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons,Nat.mul_zero,Nat.zero_add]
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [arity]; exact hj)]
      rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    cases xs with
    | nil => simp at hi
    | cons x tail =>
      rw [List.flatMap_cons,List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [arity]; omega),arity]
      have offset : 5*(i+1)+j-5=5*i+j := by omega
      rw [offset,ih tail (by simpa using hi)]
      rfl

theorem record_cell (flat : alloc.vec.Vec U32) (i : Nat) (j : Fin 5) :
    (Port4C_CollectLoop.record flat i).val[j.val]?.getD 0#u32=
      Port4C_BatchInverse.cell flat.val (5*i+j.val) := by
  fin_cases j <;> rfl

#print axioms map_cell
#print axioms flat_cell
#print axioms record_cell
end AspisR1.Port5Q1_ListCells
end

Port5Q1_GeometryModel.source:
import Port5Q1_Gather
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port5Q1_GeometryModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2
open Port3_NativeGeometryBody
variable {CoreError : Type}

/-- Full nonempty for_range field result, on the SAME accepted current
parent. Raw-zero exclusion and field nonzero are derived through gathering;
there is no independent successful prefix, inversion or collect premise. -/
theorem for_range (ops : Ops CoreError)
    (leaves : Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.SessionAPrimitives ops)
    (domain : Port5Q1_Domain.SessionADomain ops)
    (multiply : ops.op9=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul)
    (one : ops.op7=ok (1#u32))
    (inverseLeaf : ops.op11=Port4C_InverseExecution.inverse_owned)
    (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start end1 : Usize) (out : verifier.QueryGeometry)
    (nonempty : start.val < end1.val)
    (accepted : Port3_GeometryStage.geometry (Port5Q1_GeometryTerminal.install ops)
      queries start end1=ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ flat inverse : alloc.vec.Vec U32,
      out.start=start ∧ out.line_z.val.length=end1.val-start.val ∧
      flat.val.length=5*(end1.val-start.val) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ flat.val, Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.Canonical x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ flat.val, S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x≠0) ∧
      inverse.val.length=flat.val.length ∧
      (∀ j, j<flat.val.length →
        S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port4C_BatchInverse.cell inverse.val j)=
          (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port4C_BatchInverse.cell flat.val j))⁻¹) ∧
      out.inverses.val=(List.range (end1.val-start.val)).map (Port4C_CollectLoop.record inverse) ∧
      flat.val.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode=
        ((queries.val.drop start.val).take (end1.val-start.val)).flatMap (fun q => Port5Q1_Domain.words q.val) ∧
      out.line_z.val.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode=
        ((queries.val.drop start.val).take (end1.val-start.val)).map (fun q => Port5Q1_Domain.lineZ q.val) := by
  let installed := Port5Q1_GeometryTerminal.install ops
  obtain ⟨selected,order,bound,selection,run⟩ := Port4C_GeometryRange.accepted_range
    installed queries start end1 out accepted
  have selectedFields := Port4C_GeometryFields.selection_fields queries start end1 selected order bound selection
  have installedLeaves : Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.SessionAPrimitives installed :=
    ⟨leaves.point,leaves.line,leaves.multiply,leaves.double,leaves.one,leaves.subtract⟩
  have installedDomain : Port5Q1_Domain.SessionADomain installed :=
    ⟨domain.fibre,domain.point,domain.line,domain.multiply,domain.double,domain.one,domain.subtract⟩
  obtain ⟨zs,flat,terminal,canon,raw,body,ending,zlen,flen,flatMeaning,lineMeaning⟩ :=
    Port5Q1_Gather.traversal installed installedLeaves installedDomain start ⟨selected,0⟩
      (alloc.vec.Vec.new U32) (alloc.vec.Vec.new U32) out selected.val.length
      (by simp) (by simp [alloc.vec.Vec.new]) (by simp [alloc.vec.Vec.new]) run
  have nz : ∀ x ∈ flat.val, S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x≠0 :=
    fun x member => Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.field_nonzero x (canon x member) (raw x member)
  have hz : zs.val.length=end1.val-start.val := by
    simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new,List.length_nil,Nat.zero_add,selectedFields.2] using zlen
  have hf : flat.val.length=5*(end1.val-start.val) := by
    simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new,List.length_nil,Nat.zero_add,selectedFields.2] using flen
  obtain ⟨inverse,hs,hl,hi,values,groups⟩ := Port5Q1_GeometryTerminal.terminal ops multiply one inverseLeaf
    start terminal zs flat out ending (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) nz body
  refine ⟨flat,inverse,hs,hl ▸ hz,hf,canon,nz,hi,values,by simpa only [hz] using groups,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new,List.map_nil,List.drop_zero,List.nil_append,selectedFields.1] using flatMeaning
  · rw [hl]
    simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new,List.map_nil,List.drop_zero,List.nil_append,selectedFields.1] using lineMeaning

#print axioms for_range
end AspisR1.Port5Q1_GeometryModel

Port5Q1_Gather.source:
import Port5Q1_Domain
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port5Q1_Gather
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1Stage2
open Port3_NativeGeometryBody
variable {CoreError : Type}

theorem traversal (ops : Ops CoreError) (leaves : Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.SessionAPrimitives ops)
    (domain : Port5Q1_Domain.SessionADomain ops)
    (start : Usize) (iter : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (zs flat : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (out : verifier.QueryGeometry) (fuel : Nat)
    (remaining : iter.i+fuel=iter.slice.val.length)
    (canonical : ∀ x ∈ flat.val, Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.Canonical x)
    (raw : ∀ x ∈ flat.val, x≠0#u32)
    (run : verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0 (Port4C_GeometryStd.install ops)
      iter start zs flat=ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ zsFinal flatFinal terminal,
      (∀ x ∈ flatFinal.val, Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.Canonical x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ flatFinal.val, x≠0#u32) ∧
      verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body (Port4C_GeometryStd.install ops)
        start terminal zsFinal flatFinal=ok (done (.Ok out)) ∧
      terminal.i=terminal.slice.val.length ∧
      zsFinal.val.length=zs.val.length+fuel ∧ flatFinal.val.length=flat.val.length+5*fuel ∧
      flatFinal.val.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode=flat.val.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode++
        (iter.slice.val.drop iter.i).flatMap (fun q => Port5Q1_Domain.words q.val) ∧
      zsFinal.val.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode=zs.val.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode++
        (iter.slice.val.drop iter.i).map (fun q => Port5Q1_Domain.lineZ q.val) := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter zs flat with
  | zero =>
    have next : core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next iter=ok (none,iter) := by
      unfold core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next
      split
      · rename_i active; change iter.i < iter.slice.val.length at active; omega
      · rfl
    unfold verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0 at run
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def] at run
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at run
    generalize bodyRun : verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body
      (Port4C_GeometryStd.install ops) start iter zs flat=result at run
    cases result with
    | fail e => cases run
    | div => cases run
    | ok flow =>
      cases flow with
      | cont s =>
        rcases s with ⟨iter1,zs1,flat1⟩
        exact False.elim (Port4C_GeometryControl.terminal_not_cont ops start iter iter iter1
          zs flat zs1 flat1 next bodyRun)
      | done value =>
        cases Result.ok.inj run
        refine ⟨zs,flat,iter,canonical,raw,bodyRun,by omega,by omega,by omega,?_,?_⟩
        · rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)]; simp
        · rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)]; simp
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have active : iter.i < iter.slice.val.length := by omega
    let query := iter.slice.val[iter.i]
    let nextIter : core.slice.iter.Iter U32 := {iter with i:=iter.i+1}
    have next : core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next iter=ok (some query,nextIter) := by
      unfold core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next
      split
      · rfl
      · rename_i inactive; exact False.elim (inactive active)
    unfold verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0 at run
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def] at run
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at run
    generalize bodyRun : verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body
      (Port4C_GeometryStd.install ops) start iter zs flat=result at run
    cases result with
    | fail e => cases run
    | div => cases run
    | ok flow =>
      cases flow with
      | done value =>
        cases Result.ok.inj run
        exact False.elim (Port4C_GeometryControl.active_not_done ops start iter nextIter query zs flat out next bodyRun)
      | cont s =>
        rcases s with ⟨iter1,zs1,flat1⟩
        have canon := Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.step ops leaves start iter nextIter iter1 query zs zs1 flat flat1 canonical next bodyRun
        have meaning := Port5Q1_Domain.gathered_row ops domain start iter nextIter iter1 query
          zs zs1 flat flat1 next bodyRun
        obtain ⟨r,u,parent,left,right,fibre,fleft,fright,point,square,doubled,one,fields⟩ :=
          Port4C_GeometryGather.step ops start iter nextIter iter1 query zs zs1 flat flat1 next bodyRun
        rcases fields with ⟨same,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,rowRaw,append,line⟩
        subst iter1
        have raw1 : ∀ x ∈ flat1.val, x≠0#u32 := by
          intro x hx
          rw [append,List.mem_append] at hx
          exact hx.elim (raw x) (rowRaw x)
        obtain ⟨zf,ff,term,cf,rf,ht,hi,hzl,hfl,hfm,hzm⟩ := ih nextIter zs1 flat1 (by dsimp [nextIter]; omega) canon raw1 run
        refine ⟨zf,ff,term,cf,rf,ht,hi,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
        · rw [line,List.length_append,List.length_singleton] at hzl; omega
        · rw [append,List.length_append] at hfl
          have len : r.words.length=5 := by simp [Port4C_GeometryGather.Row.words]
          rw [len] at hfl; omega

        · rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons active,List.flatMap_cons]
          rw [hfm,meaning.2.1]
          exact List.append_assoc _ _ _
        · rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons active,List.map_cons]
          rw [hzm,meaning.2.2]
          exact List.append_assoc _ _ _

#print axioms traversal
end AspisR1.Port5Q1_Gather
end

Port5Q1_Domain.source:
import Port5Q1_Geometry
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port5Q1_Domain
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1Stage2
open Port3_NativeGeometryBody
open AspisCircleGroupOrder AspisCircleTensorBinding
abbrev FP := ZMod P
variable {CoreError : Type}

def index (u : Nat) : Fin 262144 := ⟨u%262144,Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩
def parent (u : Nat) : Fin 65536 := ⟨u/4%65536,Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩
def lineZ (u : Nat) : FP := FoldGeometryBridge.lz (parent u)
def words (u : Nat) : List FP :=
  [X (FoldStoredGeometry.sourceFibre (index u)),(FoldStoredGeometry.sourceFibre (index u)).1.2,
    FoldGeometryBridge.lx (parent u),FoldGeometryBridge.ly (parent u),lineZ u]

/-- Session A's fast-domain and base-field primitive interpretations, indexed
only by each primitive's actual operands/return. No geometry success is hidden. -/
structure SessionADomain (ops : Ops CoreError) : Prop where
  fibre : ∀ u f, ops.op12 u=ok (.Ok f) → f=u ∧ f.val<262144
  point : ∀ f p, ops.op15 f=ok p →
    S7JoinBasisMachine.decode p.x=X (FoldStoredGeometry.sourceFibre (index f.val)) ∧
    S7JoinBasisMachine.decode p.y=(FoldStoredGeometry.sourceFibre (index f.val)).1.2
  line : ∀ f x, ops.op14 f=ok x →
    S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x=FoldStoredGeometry.sourceX18 (index f.val)
  multiply : ∀ x y z, ops.op9 x y=ok z →
    S7JoinBasisMachine.decode z=S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x*S7JoinBasisMachine.decode y
  double : ∀ x y, ops.op10 x=ok y → S7JoinBasisMachine.decode y=2*S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x
  one : ∀ x, ops.op7=ok x → S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x=1
  subtract : ∀ x y z, ops.op8 x y=ok z →
    S7JoinBasisMachine.decode z=S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x-S7JoinBasisMachine.decode y

theorem gathered_row (ops : Ops CoreError) (leaves : SessionADomain ops) (start : Usize)
    (iter iter1 iterOut : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (query : U32)
    (zs zsOut flat flatOut : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (next : core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next iter=ok (some query,iter1))
    (run : verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body (Port4C_GeometryStd.install ops)
      start iter zs flat=ok (cont (iterOut,zsOut,flatOut))) :
    query.val<262144 ∧
    flatOut.val.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode=flat.val.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode++words query.val ∧
    zsOut.val.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode=zs.val.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode++[lineZ query.val] := by
  obtain ⟨r,u,v,left,right,fibre,fleft,fright,point,square,doubled,one,fields⟩ :=
    Port4C_GeometryGather.step ops start iter iter1 iterOut query zs zsOut flat flatOut next run
  rcases fields with ⟨_,cast,new,pointRun,div,leftEq,newLeft,lineX,rightEq,newRight,lineY,hx,hy,mul,dbl,unit,sub,_,append,line⟩
  have fi := leaves.fibre _ _ new
  have fl := leaves.fibre _ _ newLeft
  have fr := leaves.fibre _ _ newRight
  have castEq : u=UScalar.cast .Usize query := (Result.ok.inj cast).symm
  have uv : u.val=query.val := by
    rw [castEq,UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
    have limit : query.val<4294967296 := query.bv.isLt
    have cap : 4294967296 ≤ UScalar.size .Usize := by rw [UScalar.size_def]; scalar_tac
    have fit := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le limit cap
    simpa only [UScalar.size_def] using fit
  have vb : v.val=u.val/4 := by
    obtain ⟨out,hout,value⟩ := UScalar.div_spec u (y:=4#usize) (by decide)
    have same := Result.ok.inj (hout.symm.trans div)
    subst out
    exact value
  have cap : 262144 < UScalar.size .Usize := by rw [UScalar.size_def]; scalar_tac
  have ub : u.val<262144 := by rw [←fi.1]; exact fi.2
  have lv : left.val=v.val*4 := by
    rw [leftEq]
    rw [Usize.wrapping_mul_val_eq]
    apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
    change v.val*4 < UScalar.size .Usize
    rw [vb]; omega
  have rv : right.val=left.val+3 := by
    rw [rightEq]
    rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
    apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
    change left.val+3 < UScalar.size .Usize
    rw [lv,vb]; omega
  have bound : query.val<262144 := by rw [←uv,←fi.1]; exact fi.2
  have p0 : index fleft.val=AspisR1.childIndex (parent query.val) 0 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    dsimp only [index,parent,AspisR1.childIndex]
    rw [fl.1,lv,vb,uv,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega),Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    omega
  have p3 : index fright.val=AspisR1.childIndex (parent query.val) 3 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    dsimp only [index,parent,AspisR1.childIndex]
    rw [fr.1,rv,lv,vb,uv,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega),Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    omega
  have cp := leaves.point _ _ pointRun
  have cx : S7JoinBasisMachine.decode r.lineX=FoldGeometryBridge.lx (parent query.val) := by
    rw [leaves.line _ _ lineX,p0]
    rfl
  have cy : S7JoinBasisMachine.decode r.lineY=FoldGeometryBridge.ly (parent query.val) := by
    rw [leaves.line _ _ lineY,p3]
    rfl
  have cz : S7JoinBasisMachine.decode r.lineZ=lineZ query.val := by
    rw [leaves.subtract _ _ _ sub,leaves.double _ _ dbl,leaves.multiply _ _ _ mul,
      leaves.one _ unit,cx]
    unfold lineZ FoldGeometryBridge.lz
    rw [pow_two]
  have pointIndex : index fibre.val=index query.val := by rw [fi.1,uv]
  have row : r.words.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode=words query.val := by
    change [S7JoinBasisMachine.decode r.x,S7JoinBasisMachine.decode r.y,
      S7JoinBasisMachine.decode r.lineX,S7JoinBasisMachine.decode r.lineY,
      S7JoinBasisMachine.decode r.lineZ]=_
    rw [hx,hy,cp.1,cp.2,pointIndex,cx,cy,cz]
    rfl
  refine ⟨bound,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [append,List.map_append,row]
  · rw [line,List.map_append,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,cz]

#print axioms gathered_row
end AspisR1.Port5Q1_Domain
end

namespace AspisR1.Port5Q1_MapPoint

theorem transfer {A B C : Type} (f : A → C) (g : B → C)
    (xs : List A) (ys : List B) (a : A) (b : B)
    (meaning : xs.map f=ys.map g) (i : Nat) (hi : i<ys.length) :
    f (xs[i]?.getD a)=g (ys[i]?.getD b) := by
  have lengths := congrArg List.length meaning
  simp only [List.length_map] at lengths
  have hx : i<xs.length := by omega
  have eq := congrArg (fun zs : List C => zs[i]?) meaning
  rw [List.getElem?_map,List.getElem?_map,
    List.getElem?_eq_getElem hx,List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi] at eq
  have result := Option.some.inj eq
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hx,List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi]
  exact result

#print axioms transfer
end AspisR1.Port5Q1_MapPoint

theorem inverse_cells
    (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start end1 : Usize) (out : verifier.QueryGeometry)
    (order : start.val≤end1.val) (bound : end1.val≤22)
    (flat inverse : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (flatlen : flat.val.length=5*(end1.val-start.val))
    (values : ∀ j, j<flat.val.length →
      S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port4C_BatchInverse.cell inverse.val j)=
        (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port4C_BatchInverse.cell flat.val j))⁻¹)
    (groups : out.inverses.val=(List.range (end1.val-start.val)).map (Port4C_CollectLoop.record inverse))
    (flatMeaning : flat.val.map S7JoinBasisMachine.decode=
      ((queries.val.drop start.val).take (end1.val-start.val)).flatMap (fun q => Port5Q1_Domain.words q.val)) :
    ∀ i, i<end1.val-start.val → ∀ j : Fin 5,
      S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (lane (out.inverses.val[i]?.getD
        (Array.make 5#usize [0#u32,0#u32,0#u32,0#u32,0#u32])) j)=
        ((Port5Q1_Domain.words (queryAt queries (start.val+i)).val)[j.val]?.getD 0)⁻¹ := by
  intro i hi j
  have groupRead : out.inverses.val[i]?=some (Port4C_CollectLoop.record inverse i) := by
    rw [groups,List.getElem?_map,List.getElem?_range hi]
    rfl
  rw [groupRead,Option.getD_some,lane,Port5Q1_ListCells.record_cell,values (5*i+j.val) (by omega)]
  congr 1
  have len := Port5Q1_SelectedCells.length queries start end1 order bound
  have result := Port5Q1_FlatPoint.transfer (fun q : U32 => Port5Q1_Domain.words q.val)
    Port5Q1_WordShape.length_words flat.val (Port5Q1_SelectedCells.selected queries start end1)
    0#u32 flatMeaning i j.val (by rw [len]; exact hi) j.isLt
  rw [Port5Q1_SelectedCells.get queries start end1 i hi] at result
  exact result

#print axioms inverse_cells
end AspisR1.Port5Q1_GeometryInverseCells

import Port5Q1_Advance
import Port5Q1_Domain
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port5Q1_NodeModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2
open Port3_NativeQueryBody
open AspisCircleGroupOrder
abbrev FP := ZMod P
abbrev FK := OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.K
attribute [local irreducible] FoldGeometryBridge.lz AspisV5FriReleasedLineGeometry.storedLine16X

structure SessionAM31 (ops : Ops) : Prop where
  multiply : ∀ x y z, ops.op7 x y=ok z →
    S7JoinBasisMachine.decode z=S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x*S7JoinBasisMachine.decode y
  double : ∀ x y, ops.op8 x=ok y → S7JoinBasisMachine.decode y=2*S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x
  one : ∀ x, ops.op5=ok x → S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x=1
  subtract : ∀ x y z, ops.op6 x y=ok z →
    S7JoinBasisMachine.decode z=S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x-S7JoinBasisMachine.decode y

theorem node (ops : Ops) (leaves : SessionAM31 ops) (u : Fin 65536)
    (z square doubled one out : U32)
    (line : S7JoinBasisMachine.decode z=FoldGeometryBridge.lz u)
    (mul : ops.op7 z z=ok square) (dbl : ops.op8 square=ok doubled)
    (unit : ops.op5=ok one) (sub : ops.op6 doubled one=ok out) :
    S7JoinBasisMachine.decode out=AspisV5FriReleasedLineGeometry.storedLine16X u := by
  rw [leaves.subtract _ _ _ sub,leaves.double _ _ dbl,leaves.multiply _ _ _ mul,
    leaves.one _ unit,line]
  have model := S7OwnedP6StoredNode.extra_t2_is_final_node (K:=FP) u
  simpa only [pow_two,Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply] using model

theorem scalar_map (x : FP) : Port4C_SumField.scalar x=algebraMap FP FK x := by
  rfl

theorem basis (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144) (j : Fin 22) (out : U32)
    (meaning : S7JoinBasisMachine.decode out=
      AspisV5FriReleasedLineGeometry.storedLine16X (AspisR1.parentIndex (n:=65536) (q j))) (i : Fin 64) :
    Port4C_SumField.scalar (AspisCircleTensorBinding.naturalLineValue
      (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode out) i.val)=QueryResidualBridge.basis (K:=FK) q j i := by
  rw [meaning,scalar_map,NaturalEmbedding.map_naturalLineValue]
  rfl

#print axioms node
#print axioms scalar_map
#print axioms basis
