Port5Q1_Advance.source:
import Port4C_FlushState
import OraclePortCheckpointResumeC5
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port5Q1_Advance
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open Port3_RowsInstall (toBW)
open S7Kani3CallerTrace (PushTrace Sum)
open S7JoinRowsTrace (Progress)
open CheckpointBytes5Output (ofK ofE)
abbrev Model := OraclePortCheckpointStateC3.Prepared Port4C_QueryState.FK Port4C_QueryState.FE

theorem advance_first (model : Model) (n : Nat) (s : QueryAccumulator.State Port4C_QueryState.FK Port4C_QueryState.FE) :
    OraclePortCheckpointStateC3.advance model n
      (QueryAccumulator.step model.iota model.rho (QueryAccumulator.extend22 model.values)
        (QueryAccumulator.extend22 model.basis) s)=
    OraclePortCheckpointStateC3.advance model (n+1) s := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    unfold OraclePortCheckpointStateC3.advance
    rw [ih]

/-- A local interpretation on the actual observations, used by the generic
Calls induction. Its concrete construction is the parsed/opening/geometry port,
not an additional successful query or a whole-loop equality. -/
def Binds (model : Model) (ops : Ops) (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
    (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize) (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
    (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (a out : verifier.Accumulator)
    (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights)
    (o : Port4C_QueryValues.Observation (Port4C_RowStd.install ops) proof p a out g obs geometry b bout) : Prop :=
  ofE o.value=QueryAccumulator.extend22 model.values a.next.val ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 64, Port4C_SumField.scalar
      (AspisCircleTensorBinding.naturalLineValue (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode o.node) i.val)=
      QueryAccumulator.extend22 model.basis a.next.val i

/-- Symbolic induction over the ACTUAL source Calls, carrying the source's
own PushTrace/phase and the exact virtual four-field state. -/
theorem calls (ops : Ops) (basisBackend : Port4C_BasisOuter.SessionABasis ops)
    (arithmetic : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.SessionABackends ops) (model : Model)
    (embedding : model.iota=LiteralOpeningView.eK)
    (old : S8OwnedP6Finish.Weights) (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
    (rho : model.rho=ofK p.rho)
    (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize) (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
    (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (end1 : Nat)
    (binding : ∀ a out b bout,
      verifier.candidate.query_values (Port4C_RowStd.install ops) proof p a g obs geometry b=ok (.Ok (out,bout)) →
      ∀ o : Port4C_QueryValues.Observation (Port4C_RowStd.install ops) proof p a out g obs geometry b bout,
        Binds model ops proof p g obs geometry a out b bout o)
    (a out : verifier.Accumulator) (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights) (n t : Nat) (sum : Sum)
    (size : a.weights.val.length=64) (limit : t+n≤22)
    (hp : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical a.power) (hrho : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical p.rho)
    (hrhs : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE a.rhs)
    (lineCanonical : ∀ alpha values inverses value,
      ops.op16 alpha values inverses=ok value → Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE value)
    (history : PushTrace old (toBW b) sum) (phase : Progress t 0 (toBW b))
    (actual : Port2_QueryLoop.Calls
      (fun a b => verifier.candidate.query_values (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
        proof p a g obs geometry b) end1 a b out bout n) :
    ∃ sumOut, PushTrace old (toBW bout) sumOut ∧ Progress (t+n) 0 (toBW bout) ∧
      Port4C_QueryState.state out sumOut=
        OraclePortCheckpointStateC3.advance model n (Port4C_QueryState.state a sum) ∧
      Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE out.rhs ∧ Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical out.power := by
  induction actual generalizing t sum with
  | done => exact ⟨sum,history,by simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using phase,rfl,hrhs,hp⟩
  | @step a a1 out b b1 bout n active returned tail ih =>
    obtain ⟨o,sum1,trace,progress,stateStep⟩ := Port4C_QueryState.observed_step ops basisBackend arithmetic
      old proof p a a1 g obs geometry b b1 sum t size (by omega) hp hrho hrhs lineCanonical history phase returned
    obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,weights,canonRhs,canonPower⟩ :=
      Port4C_QueryMeaning.query ops basisBackend arithmetic old proof p a a1 g obs geometry b b1 sum t
        size (by omega) hp hrho hrhs lineCanonical history phase returned
    have meaning := binding a a1 b b1 returned o
    have stepEq : Port4C_QueryState.state a1 sum1=
        QueryAccumulator.step model.iota model.rho (QueryAccumulator.extend22 model.values)
          (QueryAccumulator.extend22 model.basis) (Port4C_QueryState.state a sum) := by
      rw [stateStep]
      unfold QueryAccumulator.step
      rw [embedding,rho]
      dsimp only [Port4C_QueryState.state]
      congr 1
      · funext i
        rw [meaning.2 i]
      · rw [meaning.1]
    obtain ⟨sumOut,traceOut,progressOut,stateOut,canonRhsOut,canonPowerOut⟩ :=
      ih (t+1) sum1 (by rw [weights]; exact size) (by omega) canonPower canonRhs trace progress
    refine ⟨sumOut,traceOut,?_,?_,canonRhsOut,canonPowerOut⟩
    · simpa only [Nat.add_assoc,Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_left_comm] using progressOut
    · rw [stateOut,stepEq,advance_first]

#print axioms advance_first
#print axioms calls
end AspisR1.Port5Q1_Advance
end

import Port4C_FlushField
import Port4C_QueryState

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_FlushState
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2

/-- The SAME successful retained flush materializes the virtual query state
under the checkpoint's existing total decoder. No fresh mathematical state
or successful alternative flush is selected. -/
theorem exact_state (old : S8OwnedP6Finish.Weights) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (sum : S7Kani3CallerTrace.Sum)
    (flushed : Slice aspis_core.field.QM31)
    (size : a.weights.val.length=64) (rawSize : b.raw.val.length=64)
    (trace : S7Kani3CallerTrace.PushTrace old (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b) sum)
    (run : Port3_FlushInstall.flush b a.weights.deref=ok flushed) :
    CheckpointBytes5Output.accumulator
      {a with weights:=⟨flushed.val,flushed.property⟩}=Port4C_QueryState.state a sum := by
  have fields := Port4C_FlushField.accepted old b sum a.weights.deref flushed size rawSize trace run
  unfold CheckpointBytes5Output.accumulator Port4C_QueryState.state
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact fields.2 i

#print axioms exact_state
end AspisR1.Port4C_FlushState

Port4C_FlushField.source:
import Port4C_SumField

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_FlushField
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open S7Kani3CallerTrace (PushTrace Sum)
open Port3_FlushInstall (K BW)
open Port4C_SumField (weight)

theorem model_field (row : S8OwnedP6ValueModel.Row) :
    CheckpointBytes5Output.ofK
      (Port3_FlushInstall.fromMutable (S8Kani2FinishReferenceJoin.toFinish (S8OwnedP6Finish.modelValue row)))=
        S8JoinFinishField.rawValue row := by
  rw [Port4C_SumField.source_words]
  exact S8JoinFinishField.modelValue_field row

/-- Decode ALL64 weights from the SAME actual retained flush return. Raw
congruence comes from the native query's derived PushTrace, not a new finish
congruence or independently successful output premise. -/
theorem accepted (old : S8OwnedP6Finish.Weights) (b : BW) (sum : Sum)
    (input out : Slice K) (size : input.val.length=64) (rawSize : b.raw.val.length=64)
    (trace : PushTrace old (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b) sum)
    (h : Port3_FlushInstall.flush b input=ok out) :
    out.val.length=64 ∧ ∀ i : Fin 64,
      CheckpointBytes5Output.ofK ((out.val[i.val]?).getD
        (CheckpointBytes4ReaderFields.sourceK 0))=weight sum i.val := by
  have contents := Port3_FlushInstall.accepted_contents b input out (by omega) h
  refine ⟨contents.2.trans size,?_⟩
  intro i
  have hi : i.val<b.raw.val.length := by omega
  let row := b.raw.val[i.val]
  have rawRead : b.raw.val[i.val]?=some row := List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi
  have outputRead : out.val[i.val]?=some
      (Port3_FlushInstall.fromMutable (S8Kani2FinishReferenceJoin.toFinish (S8OwnedP6Finish.modelValue row))) := by
    rw [contents.1,List.getElem?_map,List.getElem?_take]
    simp only [size,i.isLt,if_pos,rawRead,Option.map_some]
  rw [outputRead,Option.getD_some,model_field]
  exact Port4C_SumField.raw_weight old (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b) sum trace i.val row rawRead

#print axioms model_field
#print axioms accepted
end AspisR1.Port4C_FlushField
end

Port4C_SumField.source:
import Port4C_QueryLoop

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_SumField
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open CheckpointBytes5Output (ofK)
open S7Kani3CallerTrace (Sum)
abbrev FK := OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.K
abbrev FP := ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P

def weight (sum : Sum) (i : Nat) : FK :=
  ⟨⟨(sum i 0 : FP),(sum i 1 : FP)⟩,⟨(sum i 2 : FP),(sum i 3 : FP)⟩⟩

def scalar (x : FP) : FK := ⟨⟨x,0⟩,⟨0,0⟩⟩

theorem source_words (q : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.field.QM31) :
    ofK q=⟨⟨(q.c0.a.val : FP),(q.c0.b.val : FP)⟩,
      ⟨(q.c1.a.val : FP),(q.c1.b.val : FP)⟩⟩ := by
  rfl

/-- Four exact row-limb updates are the actual quartic-field weight step. -/
theorem update (sum sumOut : Sum) (power : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.field.QM31)
    (basis : Nat → FP)
    (h : ∀ i, i<64 → ∀ k : Fin 4,
      (sumOut i k : FP)=(sum i k : FP)+
        (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb (Port3_RowsInstall.toK power) k).val*basis i)
    (i : Fin 64) :
    weight sumOut i.val=weight sum i.val+ofK power*scalar (basis i.val) := by
  rw [source_words]
  ext <;> simp [weight,scalar]
  · simpa [S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb,Port3_RowsInstall.toK] using h i.val i.isLt 0
  · simpa [S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb,Port3_RowsInstall.toK] using h i.val i.isLt 1
  · simpa [S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb,Port3_RowsInstall.toK] using h i.val i.isLt 2
  · simpa [S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb,Port3_RowsInstall.toK] using h i.val i.isLt 3

/-- S7's reached raw congruence determines the whole decoded field weight. -/
theorem raw_weight (old : S8OwnedP6Finish.Weights)
    (state : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.BatchedWeights) (sum : Sum)
    (trace : S7Kani3CallerTrace.PushTrace old state sum)
    (i : Nat) (row : S8OwnedP6ValueModel.Row) (read : state.raw.val[i]?=some row) :
    S8JoinFinishField.rawValue row=weight sum i := by
  have caller := S7Kani3CallerTrace.reached_invariant old state sum trace
  have coordinates : ∀ k : Fin 4,
      ((S8OwnedP6ValueModel.rowAt row k).val : FP)=(sum i k : FP) := by
    intro k
    have congruence := caller.congruence i row read k
    have eq := congrArg (fun n : Nat => (n : FP)) congruence
    simpa only [FP,AspisCircleGroupOrder.P,ZMod.natCast_mod] using eq
  change (⟨⟨_,_⟩,⟨_,_⟩⟩ : FK)=_
  rw [coordinates 0,coordinates 1,coordinates 2,coordinates 3]
  rfl

#print axioms source_words
#print axioms update
#print axioms raw_weight
end AspisR1.Port4C_SumField
end

Port4C_QueryLoop.source:
import Port4C_QueryMeaning

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_QueryLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open Port3_RowsInstall (toBW)
open S7Kani3CallerTrace (PushTrace Sum)
open S7JoinRowsTrace (Progress)

/-- Whole actual source-call sequence propagates its own phase, history and
rhs/power canonicality; no per-query invariant observations are supplied. -/
theorem calls (ops : Ops) (basisBackend : Port4C_BasisOuter.SessionABasis ops)
    (arithmetic : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.SessionABackends ops)
    (old : S8OwnedP6Finish.Weights) (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
    (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize) (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
    (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (end1 : Nat)
    (a out : verifier.Accumulator) (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights) (n t : Nat) (sum : Sum)
    (size : a.weights.val.length=64) (limit : t+n≤22)
    (hp : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical a.power) (hrho : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical p.rho)
    (hrhs : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE a.rhs)
    (lineCanonical : ∀ alpha values inverses value,
      ops.op16 alpha values inverses=ok value → Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE value)
    (history : PushTrace old (toBW b) sum) (phase : Progress t 0 (toBW b))
    (actual : Port2_QueryLoop.Calls
      (fun a b => verifier.candidate.query_values (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
        proof p a g obs geometry b) end1 a b out bout n) :
    ∃ sumOut, PushTrace old (toBW bout) sumOut ∧ Progress (t+n) 0 (toBW bout) ∧
      Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE out.rhs ∧ Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical out.power := by
  induction actual generalizing t sum with
  | done => exact ⟨sum,history,by simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using phase,hrhs,hp⟩
  | @step a a1 out b b1 bout n active returned tail ih =>
    obtain ⟨o,sum1,trace,progress,sums,rhs,power,next,weights,canonRhs,canonPower⟩ :=
      Port4C_QueryMeaning.query ops basisBackend arithmetic old proof p a a1 g obs geometry b b1 sum t
        size (by omega) hp hrho hrhs lineCanonical history phase returned
    obtain ⟨sumOut,traceOut,progressOut,canonRhsOut,canonPowerOut⟩ :=
      ih (t+1) sum1 (by rw [weights]; exact size) (by omega) canonPower canonRhs trace progress
    refine ⟨sumOut,traceOut,?_,canonRhsOut,canonPowerOut⟩
    simpa only [Nat.add_assoc,Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_left_comm] using progressOut

/-- Full native query loop, at either range, with actual source-call inversion.
This closes the previous per-step canonicality/phase/trace caller frontier. -/
theorem loop (ops : Ops) (basisBackend : Port4C_BasisOuter.SessionABasis ops)
    (arithmetic : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.SessionABackends ops)
    (old : S8OwnedP6Finish.Weights) (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
    (a out : verifier.Accumulator) (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize)
    (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry)
    (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights) (end1 : Usize) (t : Nat) (sum : Sum)
    (size : a.weights.val.length=64) (bound : a.next.val≤end1.val)
    (limit : t+(end1.val-a.next.val)≤22)
    (hp : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical a.power) (hrho : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical p.rho)
    (hrhs : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE a.rhs)
    (lineCanonical : ∀ alpha values inverses value,
      ops.op16 alpha values inverses=ok value → Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE value)
    (history : PushTrace old (toBW b) sum) (phase : Progress t 0 (toBW b))
    (h : verifier.candidate.query_loop (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
      proof p a g obs geometry b end1=ok (.Ok (out,bout))) :
    ∃ sumOut, PushTrace old (toBW bout) sumOut ∧
      Progress (t+(end1.val-a.next.val)) 0 (toBW bout) ∧
      out.next.val=end1.val ∧ out.weights=a.weights ∧
      Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE out.rhs ∧ Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical out.power := by
  rw [Port3_NativeQueryFrame.loop_eq] at h
  have actual := Port2_QueryLoop.source_calls
    (verifier.candidate.query_values (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)) proof p g obs geometry end1
    (fun a a1 b b1 h => (Port3_NativeQueryFrame.query_fields (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
      proof p a a1 g obs geometry b b1 h).2.2) a out b bout bound h
  obtain ⟨sumOut,trace,progress,canonRhs,canonPower⟩ := calls ops basisBackend arithmetic old proof p g obs
    geometry end1.val a out b bout _ t sum size limit hp hrho hrhs lineCanonical history phase actual
  have weights := Port3_QueryFrame.calls_weights _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    (fun a a1 b b1 h => (Port3_NativeQueryFrame.query_fields (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
      proof p a a1 g obs geometry b b1 h).2.1) actual
  exact ⟨sumOut,trace,progress,Port2_QueryLoop.returned_next _ _ _ _ _ _ _ actual,weights,canonRhs,canonPower⟩

#print axioms calls
#print axioms loop
end AspisR1.Port4C_QueryLoop
end

Port4C_QueryMeaning.source:
import Port4C_Accumulation
import Port4C_QueryArithmetic

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_QueryMeaning
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open Port3_RowsInstall (toK toBW)
open S7Kani3CallerTrace (PushTrace Sum)
open S7JoinRowsTrace (Progress)
open CheckpointBytes5Output (ofK ofE)

private theorem canonical (q : aspis_core.field.QM31) (h : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical q) :
    S7JoinBackendCarriers.Canonical (toK q) := by
  intro k
  fin_cases k
  · exact h.1
  · exact h.2.1
  · exact h.2.2.1
  · exact h.2.2.2

private theorem arithmetic_std (ops : Ops) (backend : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.SessionABackends ops) :
    Port4C_QueryArithmetic.SessionABackends (Port4C_RowStd.install ops) :=
  ⟨backend.s3_s4_s5_mulE,backend.s3_s4_s5_addE,backend.s3_s4_s9_mulK⟩

/-- CURRENT query opening/folds, native six-level basis, all64 row writes,
terms, rhs/power/next and canonicality from one accepted source call.
The actual folded value/node are retained for later parsed/frozen2 binding. -/
theorem query (ops : Ops) (basisBackend : Port4C_BasisOuter.SessionABasis ops)
    (arithmetic : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.SessionABackends ops)
    (old : S8OwnedP6Finish.Weights) (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
    (a out : verifier.Accumulator) (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize)
    (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry)
    (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights) (sum : Sum) (t : Nat)
    (size : a.weights.val.length=64) (termBound : t<22)
    (hp : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical a.power) (hrho : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical p.rho)
    (hrhs : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE a.rhs)
    (lineCanonical : ∀ alpha values inverses value,
      ops.op16 alpha values inverses=ok value → Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE value)
    (history : PushTrace old (toBW b) sum) (phase : Progress t 0 (toBW b))
    (h : verifier.candidate.query_values (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
      proof p a g obs geometry b=ok (.Ok (out,bout))) :
    ∃ (o : Port4C_QueryValues.Observation (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
        proof p a out g obs geometry b bout) (sumOut : Sum),
      PushTrace old (toBW bout) sumOut ∧ Progress (t+1) 0 (toBW bout) ∧
      (∀ i, i<64 → ∀ k : Fin 4,
        (sumOut i k : ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P)=(sum i k : ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P)+
          (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb (toK a.power) k).val*
            AspisCircleTensorBinding.naturalLineValue (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode o.node) i) ∧
      ofE out.rhs=ofE a.rhs+LiteralOpeningView.eK (ofK a.power)*ofE o.value ∧
      ofK out.power=ofK a.power*ofK p.rho ∧ out.next.val=a.next.val+1 ∧
      out.weights=a.weights ∧ Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE out.rhs ∧
      Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical out.power := by
  obtain ⟨o⟩ := Port4C_QueryValues.observed (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
    proof p a out g obs geometry b bout h
  have frame := Port3_NativeQueryFrame.query_fields (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
    proof p a out g obs geometry b bout h
  obtain ⟨sumOut,trace,progress,sums⟩ := Port4C_Accumulation.rows ops basisBackend old p a out b bout
    o.node o.value sum t size (by omega) termBound (canonical a.power hp) history phase o.accumulate
  have fields := Port4C_QueryArithmetic.accumulation (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
    (arithmetic_std ops arithmetic) p a out o.node o.value b bout hp hrho hrhs
    (lineCanonical o.alpha1 o.values o.inverse o.value o.line) o.accumulate
  exact ⟨o,sumOut,trace,progress,sums,fields.1,fields.2.1,frame.2.2,frame.2.1,fields.2.2⟩

#print axioms canonical
#print axioms arithmetic_std
#print axioms query
end AspisR1.Port4C_QueryMeaning
end

Port4C_Accumulation.source:
import Port4C_BasisMeaning

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_Accumulation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open Port3_RowsInstall (toK toBW fromBW)
open Port3_PushFrame (bind_success)
open S7Kani3CallerTrace (PushTrace Sum)
open S7JoinRowsTrace (Progress)
abbrev K := aspis_core.field.QM31

private theorem backend_std (ops : Ops) (backend : Port4C_BasisOuter.SessionABasis ops) :
    Port4C_BasisOuter.SessionABasis (Port4C_RowStd.install ops) := by
  exact ⟨backend.s3_s4_mul,backend.s3_s4_sub,backend.s3_s4_double,backend.zero,backend.one⟩

/-- Full current native basis/row/terms portion, interpreted from the SAME
accepted accumulation. Basis success, canonicality, row history and phase
are derived rather than supplied as successful child observations. -/
theorem rows (ops : Ops) (backend : Port4C_BasisOuter.SessionABasis ops)
    (old : S8OwnedP6Finish.Weights) (p : verifier.Prepared)
    (a out : verifier.Accumulator) (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights)
    (node : U32) (value : Stage2E) (sum : Sum) (t : Nat)
    (size : a.weights.val.length=64) (nextBound : a.next.val≤22) (termBound : t<22)
    (powerCanonical : S7JoinBackendCarriers.Canonical (toK a.power))
    (history : PushTrace old (toBW b) sum) (phase : Progress t 0 (toBW b))
    (h : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
      p a node value b=ok (out,bout)) :
    ∃ sumOut,
      PushTrace old (toBW bout) sumOut ∧ Progress (t+1) 0 (toBW bout) ∧
      ∀ i, i<64 → ∀ k : Fin 4,
        (sumOut i k : ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P)=(sum i k : ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P)+
          (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb (toK a.power) k).val*
            AspisCircleTensorBinding.naturalLineValue (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode node) i := by
  rw [Port4C_BasisMeaning.factor _ p a node value b size] at h
  obtain ⟨basis,hbasis,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨expected,run,canonical,meaning⟩ := Port4C_BasisMeaning.total
    (Port4C_RowStd.install ops) (backend_std ops backend) node
  have same : basis=expected := Result.ok.inj (hbasis.symm.trans run)
  subst basis
  obtain ⟨mid,hrows,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨after,sumOut,native,trace,progress,sums⟩ := Port4C_RowMeaning.rows ops old a.weights b sum
    expected a.power a.next t size nextBound powerCanonical canonical history phase
  have same : mid=fromBW after := Result.ok.inj (hrows.symm.trans native)
  subst mid
  obtain ⟨terms,hterms,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  have termsValue : terms.val=t+1 := by
    change ok (Usize.wrapping_add after.terms 1#usize)=ok terms at hterms
    have same := Result.ok.inj hterms
    rw [←same,Port3_Wrapping.increment after.terms (by have hp := progress.1; omega),progress.1]
  iterate 5 obtain ⟨x,_,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  cases Result.ok.inj h
  refine ⟨sumOut,.counter trace terms,S7JoinRowsTrace.next_query_progress t after terms termsValue progress,?_⟩
  intro i hi k
  rw [sums i k,if_pos hi,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_mul]
  change (sum i k : ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P)+
    (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb (toK a.power) k).val*
      S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (S7JoinBasisBlock.cell expected i)=_
  rw [meaning ⟨i,hi⟩]

#print axioms backend_std
#print axioms rows
end AspisR1.Port4C_Accumulation

import Port4C_BasisOuter

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_BasisMeaning
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open Port3_PushFrame (bind_success)
abbrev Basis := Array U32 256#usize

def source (ops : Ops) (node : U32) : Result Basis := do
  let zero ← ops.op4
  let one ← ops.op5
  let basis ← Array.update (Array.repeat 256#usize zero) 0#usize one
  verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 ops one node 64#usize basis 1#usize

/-- CURRENT native basis initialization, six outer levels, every inner write,
canonicality and mathematical meaning. No successful basis call is assumed. -/
theorem total (ops : Ops) (backend : Port4C_BasisOuter.SessionABasis ops) (node : U32) :
    ∃ basis, source ops node=ok basis ∧ S7JoinBasisCanonical.Canonical basis ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 64, S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (S7JoinBasisBlock.cell basis i.val)=
        AspisCircleTensorBinding.naturalLineValue (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode node) i.val := by
  obtain ⟨basis,run,canonical,meaning⟩ := S7JoinBasisCanonical.total_exact node
  unfold S7JoinProductionBasis.basis_owned at run
  obtain ⟨initial,hinit,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  rw [S7Kani3BasisOuter.outer_composition initial node 64#usize 1#usize 6
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)] at run
  have native := Port4C_BasisOuter.from_levels ops backend initial basis node 1#usize 6
    (by decide) (by decide) run
  refine ⟨basis,?_,canonical,meaning⟩
  simp only [source,backend.zero,backend.one,hinit,bind_tc_ok]
  exact native

/-- Factor only the native accumulation's basis prefix; the native row/rhs/
power/counter instructions remain verbatim. -/
theorem factor (ops : Ops) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (node : U32) (value : Stage2E) (b : verifier.BatchedWeights)
    (size : a.weights.val.length=64) :
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node ops p a node value b =
      (do let basis ← source ops node
          let b1 ← verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 ops
            {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} a.weights a.power a.next b 64#usize basis
          let terms ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add b1.terms 1#usize)
          let product ← ops.op3 value a.power
          let rhs ← ops.op2 a.rhs product
          ops.op15 11#u16 a.next rhs
          let power ← ops.op9 a.power p.rho
          let next ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add a.next 1#usize)
          ok ({a with rhs,power,next},{b1 with terms})) := by
  have width : alloc.vec.Vec.len a.weights=64#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq size
  unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node source
  rw [width]
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq]

#print axioms total
#print axioms factor
end AspisR1.Port4C_BasisMeaning
end

Port4C_BasisOuter.source:
import Port4C_BasisInner

/-! Native basis scheduling port. Only the primitive field leaves are named
session A dependencies; no native block/outer/basis equality is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_BasisOuter
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open Port3_PushFrame (bind_success)
abbrev Basis := Array U32 256#usize

structure SessionABasis (ops : Ops) : Prop where
  s3_s4_mul : ops.op7=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul
  s3_s4_sub : ops.op6=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub
  s3_s4_double : ops.op8=S7Kani3BasisOuter.double
  zero : ops.op4=ok (0#u32)
  one : ops.op5=ok (1#u32)

theorem checked_mul (x y : Usize) (small : x.val*y.val≤4096) :
    (x*y : Result Usize)=ok (Usize.wrapping_mul x y) := by
  have capacity : 4096≤Usize.max := by scalar_tac
  have spec : WP.spec (x*y : Result Usize) (fun out => out.val=x.val*y.val) := by
    apply UScalar.mul_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using small.trans capacity
  obtain ⟨out,run,value⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists spec
  have same : out=Usize.wrapping_mul x y := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact value.trans (Port3_Wrapping.wrap_mul_value x y small).symm
  exact run.trans (congrArg Result.ok same)

/-- Successful checked field levels lower to the CURRENT wrapping outer
body, including each actual native inner Range traversal. -/
theorem from_levels (ops : Ops) (backend : SessionABasis ops)
    (basis out : Basis) (node : U32) (n : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (positive : 0<n.val) (schedule : n.val*2^fuel=64)
    (h : S7Kani3BasisOuter.levels fuel basis node n=ok out) :
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 ops 1#u32 node 64#usize basis n=ok out := by
  induction fuel generalizing basis node n with
  | zero =>
    have size : n.val=64 := by simpa only [pow_zero,Nat.mul_one] using schedule
    have inactive : ¬n<64#usize := by change ¬n.val<64; omega
    have same : basis=out := Result.ok.inj h
    subst out
    unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body,if_neg inactive]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have powpos : 0<2^fuel := by positivity
    have small : n.val*2≤64 := by
      have np : n.val≤n.val*2^fuel := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ powpos
      have sched : (n.val*2^fuel)*2=64 := by simpa only [pow_succ,Nat.mul_assoc] using schedule
      omega
    have active : n<64#usize := by change n.val<64; omega
    unfold S7Kani3BasisOuter.levels at h
    obtain ⟨basis1,hblock,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    obtain ⟨node1,hnode,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    have mul := checked_mul n 2#usize (by change n.val*2≤4096; omega)
    rw [mul,bind_tc_ok] at h
    have nextValue := Port3_Wrapping.wrap_mul_value n 2#usize (by change n.val*2≤4096; omega)
    have tail := ih basis1 node1 (Usize.wrapping_mul n 2#usize)
      (by rw [nextValue]; change 0<n.val*2; omega)
      (by rw [nextValue]; change n.val*2*2^fuel=64; simpa only [pow_succ,Nat.mul_assoc,Nat.mul_comm,Nat.mul_left_comm] using schedule) h
    rw [S7Kani2BasisLoop.extracted_basis_block_composition _ basis node n 0#usize n.val
      (by omega) (by simp)] at hblock
    have block := Port4C_BasisInner.from_iterate ops node n
      {start:=0#usize,«end»:=n} basis basis1 n.val (by omega) rfl (by simp)
      (by rw [backend.s3_s4_mul]; exact hblock)
    unfold S7Kani3BasisOuter.t2 at hnode
    obtain ⟨square,hsquare,hnode⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ hnode
    obtain ⟨doubled,hdouble,hsub⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ hnode
    have bodyRun : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body ops 1#u32 64#usize node basis n =
        ok (cont (node1,basis1,Usize.wrapping_mul n 2#usize)) := by
      unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body
      simp only [if_pos active,block,bind_tc_ok,backend.s3_s4_mul,backend.s3_s4_double,
        backend.s3_s4_sub,hsquare,hdouble,hsub,lift]
    unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,bodyRun]
    exact tail

#print axioms checked_mul
#print axioms from_levels
end AspisR1.Port4C_BasisOuter
end

Port4C_BasisInner.source:
import Port4C_RowMeaning

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_BasisInner
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open Port3_PushFrame (bind_success)
abbrev Basis := Array U32 256#usize

theorem body (ops : Ops) (node : U32) (n : Usize) (basis : Basis)
    (iter iter1 : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (j : Usize)
    (small : n.val+j.val≤4096)
    (next : core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter=ok (some j,iter1)) :
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body ops node n iter basis =
      (do let basis1 ← S7Kani2BasisLoop.step ops.op7 node n j basis
          ok (cont (iter1,basis1))) := by
  unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body S7Kani2BasisLoop.step
  rw [next,bind_tc_ok,Port3_Wrapping.checked_add n j small]
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl

/-- Full CURRENT native block transport, with arbitrary primitive multiply.
Wrapping index and iterator progress are bounded independently of field laws. -/
theorem from_iterate (ops : Ops) (node : U32) (n : Usize)
    (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (basis out : Basis) (fuel : Nat)
    (bound : n.val≤128) (ending : iter.end=n)
    (span : iter.start.val+fuel=n.val)
    (h : S7Kani2BasisLoop.iterate (S7Kani2BasisLoop.step ops.op7 node n)
      fuel iter.start basis=ok out) :
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0 ops iter node basis n=ok out := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter basis with
  | zero =>
    have same : basis=out := Result.ok.inj h
    subst out
    obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,run,ho,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_none_spec
        (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
        (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro a b; rfl)
        iter (by rw [ending]; omega))
    subst o
    unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body,run,bind_tc_ok]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    unfold S7Kani2BasisLoop.iterate at h
    obtain ⟨basis1,hstep,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    obtain ⟨j1,hinc,hj1⟩ := S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.increment iter.start (by omega)
    rw [hinc,bind_tc_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,run,ho,hs,he⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_some_spec
        (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
        (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x; rfl) (by intro a b; rfl)
        iter (by rw [ending]; omega))
    subst o
    have index : iter1.start=j1 := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by omega)
    have tail := ih iter1 basis1 (he.trans ending) (by omega) (by rw [index]; exact h)
    have step := body ops node n basis iter iter1 iter.start (by omega) run
    rw [hstep,bind_tc_ok] at step
    unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,step]
    exact tail

#print axioms body
#print axioms from_iterate
end AspisR1.Port4C_BasisInner
end

import Port4C_RowLoop

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_RowMeaning
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open Port3_RowsInstall (toK toBW fromBW toWeights)
open S7Kani3CallerTrace (PushTrace Sum)
open S7JoinRowsTrace (Progress)
abbrev K := aspis_core.field.QM31

/-- All64 CURRENT native row writes produce the existing concrete owned
push trace and exact sum update. History/phase are propagated by source
induction; they are not requested independently for each row. -/
theorem rows (ops : Ops) (old : S8OwnedP6Finish.Weights) (v : alloc.vec.Vec K)
    (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (sum : Sum) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
    (power : K) (next : Usize) (t : Nat)
    (size : v.val.length=64) (bound : next.val≤22)
    (canonical : S7JoinBackendCarriers.Canonical (toK power))
    (basisCanonical : S7JoinBasisCanonical.Canonical basis)
    (history : PushTrace old (toBW b) sum) (phase : Progress t 0 (toBW b)) :
    ∃ after sumOut,
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
        {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} v power next b 64#usize basis=ok (fromBW after) ∧
      PushTrace old after sumOut ∧ Progress t 64 after ∧
      ∀ i k, sumOut i k=if i<64 then
        sum i k+(S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb (toK power) k).val*
          (S7JoinBasisBlock.cell basis i).val else sum i k := by
  have mappedSize : (toWeights v).val.length=64 := by simpa only [toWeights,List.length_map] using size
  obtain ⟨after,sumOut,run,trace,progress,sums⟩ := S7JoinRowsTrace.rows_exact old (toWeights v)
    (toBW b) sum basis (toK power) next 0#usize 64 t mappedSize bound (by decide)
    canonical basisCanonical history phase
  rw [S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.extracted_loop_composition S7JoinRowsTrace.backend basis
    (toK power) next 64#usize 0#usize 64 (toWeights v,toBW b) (by decide) (by decide)] at run
  have native := Port4C_RowLoop.from_iterate ops v power next basis
    {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} b (fromBW after) 64 size (by decide) (by decide) run
  refine ⟨after,sumOut,native,trace,progress,?_⟩
  intro i k
  simpa only [show (0#usize).val=0 from rfl,Nat.zero_le,true_and] using sums i k

#print axioms rows
end AspisR1.Port4C_RowMeaning
end

Port4C_RowLoop.source:
import Port4C_RowStd

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_RowLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open Port3_RowsInstall (toK toBW fromBW toWeights)
open Port3_PushFrame (bind_success)
abbrev K := aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev BW := verifier.BatchedWeights
abbrev cell := S7JoinBasisBlock.cell

private theorem basis_read (basis : Array U32 256#usize) (j : Usize) (hj : j.val<64) :
    Array.index_usize basis j=ok (cell basis j.val) := by
  have bound : j.val<basis.val.length := by rw [basis.property]; change j.val<256; omega
  obtain ⟨m,hm,hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec basis j bound)
  have same : m=cell basis j.val := by
    simp only [cell,S7JoinBasisBlock.cell,List.getElem?_eq_getElem bound,Option.getD_some]
    exact hval
  exact hm.trans (congrArg Result.ok same)

private theorem owned_step (v : alloc.vec.Vec K) (power : K) (next j : Usize)
    (basis : Array U32 256#usize) (b : BW) (pair : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.State)
    (hj : j.val<64)
    (h : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.step S7JoinRowsTrace.backend basis (toK power) next
      64#usize j (toWeights v,toBW b)=ok pair) :
    ∃ b1 : BW, pair=(toWeights v,toBW b1) ∧
      Port3_NativeRowFrame.push b j power (cell basis j.val)=ok b1 := by
  unfold S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.step at h
  rw [basis_read basis j hj,bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨b1,hpush,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  iterate 8 obtain ⟨x,_,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  have same := Result.ok.inj h
  refine ⟨fromBW b1,same.symm,?_⟩
  change S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned (toBW b) j (toK power) (cell basis j.val)=ok b1 at hpush
  unfold Port3_NativeRowFrame.push
  change (do let out ← S7Kani2OwnedPush.push_owned (toBW b) j (toK power) (cell basis j.val)
             ok (fromBW out))=ok (fromBW b1)
  rw [hpush,bind_tc_ok]

/-- Lower the COMPLETE successful emitted owned row traversal to the CURRENT
native range iterator. Every row uses the same actual push and physical read. -/
theorem from_iterate (ops : Ops) (v : alloc.vec.Vec K) (power : K) (next : Usize)
    (basis : Array U32 256#usize) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize)
    (b out : BW) (fuel : Nat) (size : v.val.length=64)
    (span : iter.start.val+fuel=64) (ending : iter.end.val=64)
    (h : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.iterate
      (S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.step S7JoinRowsTrace.backend basis (toK power) next 64#usize)
      fuel iter.start (toWeights v,toBW b)=ok (toWeights v,toBW out)) :
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
      iter v power next b 64#usize basis=ok out := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter b with
  | zero =>
    have same : b=out := by
      have pair := Result.ok.inj h
      have raw := congrArg (fun p : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.State => p.2.raw) pair
      have terms := congrArg (fun p : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.State => p.2.terms) pair
      cases b; cases out
      cases raw; cases terms; rfl
    subst out
    unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
    rw [Port3_NativeRowLoop.stopped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hj : iter.start.val<64 := by omega
    unfold S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.iterate at h
    obtain ⟨pair,hstep,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    obtain ⟨b1,same,hpush⟩ := owned_step v power next iter.start basis b pair hj hstep
    subst pair
    obtain ⟨j1,hinc,hj1⟩ := S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.increment iter.start (by omega)
    rw [hinc,bind_tc_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨⟨o,iter1⟩,run,ho,hs,he⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_some_spec
        (ty:=.Usize) (cloneInst:=core.clone.CloneUsize)
        (partialOrdInst:=core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intro x; rfl) (by intro a b; rfl)
        iter (by omega))
    subst o
    have index : iter1.start=j1 := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by omega)
    have tail := ih iter1 b1 (by omega) (by rw [he]; exact ending)
      (by rw [index]; exact h)
    obtain ⟨q,hq,_⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (Slice.index_usize_spec v.deref iter.start (by change iter.start.val<v.val.length; omega))
    have step := Port4C_RowStd.step ops v power next 64#usize basis iter iter1 b b1 iter.start
      (cell basis iter.start.val) q run (basis_read basis iter.start hj) hq hpush
    unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,step]
    exact tail

#print axioms basis_read
#print axioms owned_step
#print axioms from_iterate
end AspisR1.Port4C_RowLoop
end

Port4C_RowStd.source:
import Port4C_QueryStd
import Port3_NativeRowLoop

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4C_RowStd
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
abbrev K := aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev E := aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
abbrev M := aspis_core.field.M31

def zeroK : K := ⟨⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩,⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩⟩
def fromK (q : K) : E := ⟨q,zeroK⟩
def fromM (m : M) : E := fromK ⟨⟨m,0#u32⟩,⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩⟩

def install (ops : Ops) : Ops :=
  {Port3_NativeRowFrame.install (Port4C_QueryStd.install ops) with
    op1 := fun q => ok (fromK q)
    op10 := fun m => ok (fromM m)
    op12 := Slice.index_usize
    op13 := Array.index_usize
    op15 := fun _ _ _ => ok ()}

/-- One current emitted row with concrete std/read/embedding leaves. Trace
offsets still execute their total wrapping operations and cannot reject. -/
theorem step (ops : Ops) (v : alloc.vec.Vec K) (power : K)
    (next width : Usize) (basis : Array M 256#usize)
    (iter iter1 : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights)
    (j : Usize) (m : M) (q : K)
    (hi : core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter=ok (some j,iter1))
    (hm : Array.index_usize basis j=ok m)
    (hq : Slice.index_usize v.deref j=ok q)
    (hp : Port3_NativeRowFrame.push b j power m=ok bout) :
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body (install ops)
      v power next width basis iter b=ok (cont (iter1,bout)) := by
  unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body
  rw [hi,bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [install,Port3_NativeRowFrame.install,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  change (do let m ← Array.index_usize basis j
             let b1 ← Port3_NativeRowFrame.push b j power m
             let _ ← Slice.index_usize v.deref j
             ok (cont (iter1,b1)))=ok (cont (iter1,bout))
  rw [hm,bind_tc_ok,hp,bind_tc_ok,hq,bind_tc_ok]

/-- Both std-array reads are actual physical reads, not arbitrary callbacks. -/
theorem reads (ops : Ops) :
    (install ops).op12=(@Slice.index_usize K) ∧
    (install ops).op13=(@Array.index_usize M 256#usize) ∧

namespace AspisR1.Port4C_QueryState

open CheckpointBytes5Output (ofK ofE)
open S7Kani3CallerTrace (Sum PushTrace)
open S7JoinRowsTrace (Progress)
abbrev FK := OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.K
abbrev FE := OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.E

def state (a : verifier.Accumulator) (sum : Sum) : QueryAccumulator.State FK FE :=
  ⟨fun i => Port4C_SumField.weight sum i.val,ofE a.rhs,ofK a.power,a.next.val⟩

/-- Complete current source query refines the accumulator step at its actual
observed line-fold value and actual T2 node. The delayed physical weights
are interpreted by the source-derived raw sum, and identified at flush. -/
theorem observed_step (ops : Ops) (basisBackend : Port4C_BasisOuter.SessionABasis ops)
    (arithmetic : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.SessionABackends ops)
    (old : S8OwnedP6Finish.Weights) (proof : Slice U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
    (a out : verifier.Accumulator) (g : Array Stage2E 29#usize)
    (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry)
    (b bout : verifier.BatchedWeights) (sum : Sum) (t : Nat)
    (size : a.weights.val.length=64) (termBound : t<22)
    (hp : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical a.power) (hrho : Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical p.rho)
    (hrhs : Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE a.rhs)
    (lineCanonical : ∀ alpha values inverses value,
      ops.op16 alpha values inverses=ok value → Port4C_QueryArithmetic.CanonE value)
    (history : PushTrace old (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b) sum)
    (phase : Progress t 0 (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b))
    (h : verifier.candidate.query_values (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
      proof p a g obs geometry b=ok (.Ok (out,bout))) :
    ∃ (o : Port4C_QueryValues.Observation (Port4C_RowStd.install ops)
      proof p a out g obs geometry b bout) (sumOut : Sum),
      PushTrace old (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW bout) sumOut ∧
      Progress (t+1) 0 (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW bout) ∧
      state out sumOut=QueryAccumulator.step LiteralOpeningView.eK (ofK p.rho)
        (fun _ => ofE o.value)
        (fun _ i => Port4C_SumField.scalar
          (AspisCircleTensorBinding.naturalLineValue (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode o.node) i.val))
        (state a sum) := by
  obtain ⟨o,sumOut,trace,progress,sums,rhs,power,next,_,_,_⟩ := Port4C_QueryMeaning.query
    ops basisBackend arithmetic old proof p a out g obs geometry b bout sum t size termBound
    hp hrho hrhs lineCanonical history phase h
  refine ⟨o,sumOut,trace,progress,?_⟩
  unfold state QueryAccumulator.step
  congr 1
  · funext i
    exact Port4C_SumField.update sum sumOut a.power _ sums i

#print axioms observed_step
end AspisR1.Port4C_QueryState

import CurrentWideMulExactProduct
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof
private theorem bind_ok_inv {α β : Type} {r : Result α} {f : α → Result β}
    {x : β} (h : Bind.bind r f = .ok x) :
    ∃ a, r = .ok a ∧ f a = .ok x := by
  cases r with
  | ok a => exact ⟨a,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp [Bind.bind] at h
  | div => simp [Bind.bind] at h

theorem qm_sub_total_canonical (x y : field.QM31) (hx : CanonicalQM x) (hy : CanonicalQM y) :
    ∃ z, field.QM31.sub x y = .ok z ∧ CanonicalQM z := by
  obtain ⟨out,ho,hc⟩ := AspisR1CurrentWideMul.qm_sub_total (toQM x) (toQM y) hx hy
  have hm : (do let z ← field.QM31.sub x y; ok (toQM z)) = .ok out :=
    (qm_sub_same_minimal x y).trans ho
  cases hr : field.QM31.sub x y with
  | fail e => simp [hr] at hm
  | div => simp [hr] at hm
  | ok z =>
    rw [hr,bind_tc_ok] at hm
    have he : toQM z = out := Result.ok.inj hm
    refine ⟨z,rfl,?_⟩
    change AspisR1CurrentWideMul.CanonicalQM (toQM z)
    rw [he]
    exact hc

theorem qm_add_total_canonical (x y : field.QM31) (hx : CanonicalQM x) (hy : CanonicalQM y) :
    ∃ z, field.QM31.add x y = .ok z ∧ CanonicalQM z := by
  obtain ⟨out,ho,hc,_⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.current_qm_add_mod (toQM x) (toQM y) hx hy
  have hm : (do let z ← field.QM31.add x y; ok (toQM z)) = .ok out :=
    (qm_add_same x y).trans ho
  cases hr : field.QM31.add x y with
  | fail e => simp [hr] at hm
  | div => simp [hr] at hm
  | ok z =>
    rw [hr,bind_tc_ok] at hm
    have he : toQM z = out := Result.ok.inj hm
    refine ⟨z,rfl,?_⟩
    change AspisR1CurrentWideMul.CanonicalQM (toQM z)
    rw [he]
    exact hc

theorem qm_sub_success_canonical (x y z : field.QM31) (hx : CanonicalQM x) (hy : CanonicalQM y)
    (h : field.QM31.sub x y = .ok z) : CanonicalQM z := by
  obtain ⟨out,ho,hc⟩ := qm_sub_total_canonical x y hx hy
  have he : z = out := Result.ok.inj (h.symm.trans ho)
  rw [he]
  exact hc

theorem wide_sub_success_exact (x y z : E) (hx : CanonicalWide x) (hy : CanonicalWide y)
    (h : field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub x y = .ok z) :
    CanonicalWide z ∧ decodeWide z = decodeWide x - decodeWide y := by
  unfold field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub at h
  rcases bind_ok_inv h with ⟨a,ha,h⟩
  rcases bind_ok_inv h with ⟨b,hb,h⟩
  have he : ({c0:=a,c1:=b} : E) = z := Result.ok.inj h
  subst z
  refine ⟨⟨qm_sub_success_canonical x.c0 y.c0 a hx.1 hy.1 ha,
    qm_sub_success_canonical x.c1 y.c1 b hx.2 hy.2 hb⟩, ?_⟩
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · exact qm_sub_exact x.c0 y.c0 a ha
  · exact qm_sub_exact x.c1 y.c1 b hb

theorem wide_sub_total_exact (x y : E) (hx : CanonicalWide x) (hy : CanonicalWide y) :
    ∃ z, field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub x y = .ok z ∧
      CanonicalWide z ∧ decodeWide z = decodeWide x - decodeWide y := by
  obtain ⟨lo,hlo,_⟩ := qm_sub_total_canonical x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨hi,hhi,_⟩ := qm_sub_total_canonical x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  let z : E := ⟨lo,hi⟩
  have hz : field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub x y = .ok z := by
    simp only [field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub,hlo,hhi,bind_tc_ok,z]
  exact ⟨z,hz,wide_sub_success_exact x y z hx hy hz⟩

theorem wide_add_total_exact (x y : E) (hx : CanonicalWide x) (hy : CanonicalWide y) :
    ∃ z, field.wide_exact.WideExact.add x y = .ok z ∧
      CanonicalWide z ∧ decodeWide z = decodeWide x + decodeWide y := by
  obtain ⟨lo,hlo,_⟩ := qm_add_total_canonical x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨hi,hhi,_⟩ := qm_add_total_canonical x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  let z : E := ⟨lo,hi⟩
  have hz : field.wide_exact.WideExact.add x y = .ok z := by
    simp only [field.wide_exact.WideExact.add,hlo,hhi,bind_tc_ok,z]
  exact ⟨z,hz,wide_add_success x y z hx hy hz⟩

#print axioms qm_sub_total_canonical
#print axioms qm_add_total_canonical
#print axioms qm_sub_success_canonical
#print axioms wide_sub_success_exact
#print axioms wide_sub_total_exact
#print axioms wide_add_total_exact
end AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof

import CurrentWideField
import CurrentWideQMMulM31V5
import R17CurrentM31Semantics
import WideTower
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.SAQ_RawScale
open AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof
abbrev MExact := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.M31Exact
private def qmScalarEmbedding (s : field.M31) : ExactQM :=
  ⟨⟨(s.val : MExact), (0 : MExact)⟩, ⟨(0 : MExact), (0 : MExact)⟩⟩
def wideScalarEmbedding (s : field.M31) : AspisWideTower.WideExact :=
  ⟨qmScalarEmbedding s, 0⟩


theorem wideScalarEmbedding_eq_algebraMap (s : field.M31) :
    wideScalarEmbedding s =
      algebraMap MExact AspisWideTower.WideExact
        (R17CurrentM31Semantics.decode s) := by
  simp [wideScalarEmbedding, qmScalarEmbedding,
    R17CurrentM31Semantics.decode, R17CurrentM31Semantics.P,
    AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact,
    AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.CM31Exact,
    AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact]
  rfl

private theorem bind_ok_inv {α β : Type} {r : Result α} {f : α → Result β}
    {x : β} (h : Bind.bind r f = .ok x) :
    ∃ a, r = .ok a ∧ f a = .ok x := by
  cases r with
  | ok a => exact ⟨a,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp [Bind.bind] at h
  | div => simp [Bind.bind] at h

theorem wide_mul_m31_success (x z : E) (s : field.M31)
    (h : field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 x s = .ok z) :
    CanonicalWide z ∧ decodeWide z = decodeWide x * wideScalarEmbedding s := by
  unfold field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 at h
  rcases bind_ok_inv h with ⟨i, hi, h⟩
  rcases bind_ok_inv h with ⟨q, hq, h⟩
  rcases bind_ok_inv h with ⟨q1, hq1, h⟩
  have he : ({c0 := q, c1 := q1} : E) = z := Result.ok.inj h
  subst z
  have hq0 := qm_mul_m31_success x.c0 i q hq
  have hq1' := qm_mul_m31_success x.c1 i q1 hq1
  have hden : field.P.val ≠ 0 := by norm_num [field.P]
  obtain ⟨irem, hrem, hremVal⟩ := Aeneas.Std.WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec s hden)
  have hie : i = irem := Result.ok.inj (hi.symm.trans hrem)
  subst irem
  have hpExact : field.P.val = AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P := by
    norm_num [field.P, AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P]
  have hbase : (i.val : MExact) = (s.val : MExact) := by
    change (i.val : ZMod AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P) =
      (s.val : ZMod AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P)
    rw [hremVal, hpExact, ZMod.natCast_mod]
  have hscalar : wideScalarEmbedding i = wideScalarEmbedding s := by
    ext <;> simp [wideScalarEmbedding, qmScalarEmbedding, hbase]
  refine ⟨⟨hq0.1,hq1'.1⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [← hscalar]
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · have hq0r := hq0.2
    have heq : decodeQM q = decodeQM x.c0 * qmScalarEmbedding i := by
      change decodeQM q = decodeQM x.c0 * qmScalarEmbedding i at hq0r
      exact hq0r
    rw [QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul]
    simpa [decodeWide, wideScalarEmbedding] using heq
  · have hq1r := hq1'.2
    have heq : decodeQM q1 = decodeQM x.c1 * qmScalarEmbedding i := by
      change decodeQM q1 = decodeQM x.c1 * qmScalarEmbedding i at hq1r
      exact hq1r
    rw [QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul]
    simpa [decodeWide, wideScalarEmbedding] using heq

theorem wide_mul_m31_success_algebraMap (x z : E) (s : field.M31)
    (h : field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 x s = .ok z) :
    CanonicalWide z ∧ decodeWide z = decodeWide x *
      algebraMap MExact AspisWideTower.WideExact (R17CurrentM31Semantics.decode s) := by
  obtain ⟨hc,hv⟩ := wide_mul_m31_success x z s h
  refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
  rw [← wideScalarEmbedding_eq_algebraMap]
  exact hv

#print axioms qmScalarEmbedding
#print axioms wideScalarEmbedding
#print axioms wide_mul_m31_success
#print axioms wide_mul_m31_success_algebraMap
end AspisR1.SAQ_RawScale

import CurrentWideQMField
import WideTower
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof
abbrev E := field.wide_exact.WideExact
def CanonicalWide (x : E) : Prop := CanonicalQM x.c0 ∧ CanonicalQM x.c1
def decodeWide (x : E) : AspisWideTower.WideExact := ⟨decodeQM x.c0,decodeQM x.c1⟩
private theorem bind_ok_inv {α β : Type} {r : Result α} {f : α → Result β}
    {x : β} (h : Bind.bind r f = .ok x) :
    ∃ a, r = .ok a ∧ f a = .ok x := by
  cases r with
  | ok a => exact ⟨a,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp [Bind.bind] at h
  | div => simp [Bind.bind] at h

theorem wide_add_success (x y z : E) (hx : CanonicalWide x) (hy : CanonicalWide y)
    (h : field.wide_exact.WideExact.add x y = .ok z) :
    CanonicalWide z ∧ decodeWide z = decodeWide x + decodeWide y := by
  unfold field.wide_exact.WideExact.add at h
  rcases bind_ok_inv h with ⟨q0,h0,h⟩
  rcases bind_ok_inv h with ⟨q1,h1,h⟩
  have he : ({c0:=q0,c1:=q1} : E)=z := Result.ok.inj h
  subst z
  have hc0 := qm_add_success x.c0 y.c0 q0 hx.1 hy.1 h0
  have hc1 := qm_add_success x.c1 y.c1 q1 hx.2 hy.2 h1
  refine ⟨⟨hc0.1,hc1.1⟩,?_⟩
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · exact hc0.2
  · exact hc1.2

#print axioms wide_add_success
end AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof

import CurrentWideQMField
import AspisV8R17.QM31WordTower
import AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof
private abbrev OldQM := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.QM31
private abbrev OldCM := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31
private abbrev OldM31 := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31
private abbrev Exact := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.QM31Exact
private abbrev MExact := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.M31Exact
private abbrev Words := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Mul.wordsQM
private def scalarEmbedding (s : field.M31) : Exact :=
  ⟨⟨(s.val : MExact), (0 : MExact)⟩,
    ⟨(0 : MExact), (0 : MExact)⟩⟩

theorem qm_mul_m31_success (x : field.QM31) (s : field.M31) (z : field.QM31)
    (h : field.QM31.mul_m31 x s = .ok z) :
    CanonicalQM z ∧ decodeQM z = decodeQM x * scalarEmbedding s := by
  let old := toQM x
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hva, hca⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_mul_mod old.c0.a s
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hvb, hcb⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_mul_mod old.c0.b s
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hvc, hcc⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_mul_mod old.c1.a s
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hvd, hcd⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_mul_mod old.c1.b s
  let out : field.QM31 := ⟨⟨a,b⟩,⟨c,d⟩⟩
  have haNew : field.M31.mul x.c0.a s = .ok a := by rw [m31_mul_same]; exact ha
  have hbNew : field.M31.mul x.c0.b s = .ok b := by rw [m31_mul_same]; exact hb
  have hcNew : field.M31.mul x.c1.a s = .ok c := by rw [m31_mul_same]; exact hc
  have hdNew : field.M31.mul x.c1.b s = .ok d := by rw [m31_mul_same]; exact hd
  have hout : field.QM31.mul_m31 x s = .ok out := by
    simp [field.QM31.mul_m31, field.CM31.mul_m31, haNew, hbNew, hcNew, hdNew]
    rfl
  have he : z = out := Result.ok.inj (h.symm.trans hout)
  constructor
  · rw [he]
    change AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM (toQM out)
    have hcan : AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalQM
        (⟨⟨a,b⟩,⟨c,d⟩⟩ : OldQM) := ⟨⟨hca,hcb⟩,⟨hcc,hcd⟩⟩
    simpa [toQM, toCM, out, OldQM] using hcan
  · rw [he]
    ext <;> simp [decodeQM, AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode,
      AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.M31Exact, scalarEmbedding, out, toQM, toCM,
      old, toQM, toCM, hva, hvb, hvc, hvd]

#print axioms qm_mul_m31_success
end AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof

import AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.Funs
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

abbrev GenC := AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.aspis_core.field.CM31
abbrev ProbeC := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31
abbrev GenQ := AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev ProbeQ := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31

def genCToProbe (x : GenC) : ProbeC := ⟨x.a, x.b⟩
def genQToProbe (x : GenQ) : ProbeQ :=
  ⟨genCToProbe x.c0, genCToProbe x.c1⟩
def probeCToGen (x : ProbeC) : GenC := ⟨x.a, x.b⟩

def resultMap {A B : Type} (f : A → B) : Result A → Result B
  | .ok x => .ok (f x)
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

theorem resultMap_cm_ok (a b : Std.U32) :
    resultMap genCToProbe (Result.ok (AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.aspis_core.field.CM31.mk a b)) =
      Result.ok (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31.mk a b) := rfl

theorem resultMap_qm_ok (a b : GenC) :
    resultMap genQToProbe (Result.ok (AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.aspis_core.field.QM31.mk a b)) =
      Result.ok (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.mk (genCToProbe a) (genCToProbe b)) := rfl

theorem resultMap_bind {A B C : Type} (f : B → C) (r : Result A)
    (k : A → Result B) :
    resultMap f (r >>= k) = r >>= (fun a => resultMap f (k a)) := by
  cases r with
  | ok a => cases k a <;> rfl
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl

theorem resultMap_bind_transport {A A' B B' : Type}
    (f : A → A') (g : A' → A) (hfg : ∀ a, g (f a) = a)
    (F : B → B') (r : Result A) (k : A → Result B) :
    resultMap F (r >>= k) =
      (resultMap f r) >>= (fun a' => resultMap F (k (g a'))) := by
  cases r with
  | ok a => cases k a <;> simp [resultMap, hfg]
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl

theorem probeCToGen_genCToProbe (x : GenC) :
    probeCToGen (genCToProbe x) = x := by
  cases x
  rfl

theorem resultMap_genC_bind {B B' : Type} (F : B → B')
    (r : Result GenC) (k : GenC → Result B) :
    resultMap F (r >>= k) =
      (resultMap genCToProbe r) >>= (fun y =>
        resultMap F (k (probeCToGen y))) := by
  exact resultMap_bind_transport genCToProbe probeCToGen
    probeCToGen_genCToProbe F r k

import NBF_BasisInstall
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBF_BasisOuter
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open S7Kani3BasisOuter (levels t2 double)
/-- Direct emitted outer schedule association. Every block is the inherited
S7 recurrence on the same carrier and all counters are proved nonwrapping. -/
theorem levels_eq (ops : Ops) (fuel : Nat) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
 (node : U32) (n width : Usize) (positive : 0<n.val) (bound : width.val≤256)
 (schedule : n.val*2^fuel=width.val) :
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops)
   1#u32 node width basis n=levels fuel basis node n := by
 induction fuel generalizing basis node n with
 | zero =>
   have done : ¬ n<width := by
     change ¬ n.val<width.val
     simp only [pow_zero,Nat.mul_one] at schedule
     omega
   unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0
   rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
   simp only [verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body,if_neg done,levels,bind_tc_ok]
 | succ k ih =>
   have power : 0<2^k := by positivity
   have doubleBound : n.val*2≤width.val := by
     have : 1≤2^k := by omega
     have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (n.val*2) this
     rw [pow_succ] at schedule
     nlinarith
   have hn : n.val≤128 := by omega
   have active : n<width := by
     change n.val<width.val
     have : 2≤2^(k+1) := by rw [pow_succ];omega
     nlinarith
   let n1 := Usize.wrapping_mul n 2#usize
   have value : n1.val=n.val*2 := Port3_Wrapping.wrap_mul_value n 2#usize (by
     change n.val*2≤4096;omega)
   have multiply : (n*2#usize : Result Usize)=ok n1 := NBF_BasisInstall.checked_mul n 2#usize (by
     change n.val*2≤4096;omega)
   have block := NBF_BasisInstall.block ops basis node n hn
   have body : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body
     (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops) 1#u32 width node basis n=
     (do let b1 ← S7Kani2BasisLoop.basis_block_owned
           AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul basis node n 0#usize
         let node1 ← t2 node
         ok (cont (node1,b1,n1))) := by
     unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body
     rw [if_pos active,block]
     simp only [NBF_BasisInstall.install,t2,double,lift,bind_tc_ok,bind_assoc_eq]
     rfl
   unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0
   rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
   dsimp only
   rw [body]
   obtain ⟨b1,hb⟩ := S7Kani3BasisTotal.block_total basis node n 0#usize n.val hn (by simp)
   obtain ⟨node1,ht,hcanon⟩ := S7Kani3BasisOuter.t2_total node
   simp only [levels,multiply,hb,ht,bind_tc_ok]
   exact ih b1 node1 n1 (by rw [value];omega) (by
     rw [value]
     rw [pow_succ] at schedule
     nlinarith)
#print axioms levels_eq
end NBF_BasisOuter

NBF_BasisDomain.source:
import NBF_BasisOuter
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBF_BasisDomain
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
/-- The literal direct native initialization and six-level basis producer. -/
def source (ops : Ops) (node : U32) : Result (Array U32 256#usize) := do
 let b ← Array.update (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32) 0#usize 1#u32
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops)
   1#u32 node 64#usize b 1#usize

theorem association (ops : Ops) (node : U32) :
 source ops node=S7JoinProductionBasis.basis_owned node := by
 unfold source S7JoinProductionBasis.basis_owned
 congr 1
 funext b
 rw [NBF_BasisOuter.levels_eq ops 6 b node 1#usize 64#usize (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)]
 rw [S7Kani3BasisOuter.outer_composition b node 64#usize 1#usize 6 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)]

theorem total (ops : Ops) (node : U32) :
 ∃ basis, source ops node=ok basis ∧ S7JoinBasisCanonical.Canonical basis := by
 rw [association]
 exact S7JoinBasisCanonical.total_canonical node

/-- SAME returned basis supplies every reached row's canonical scalar domain. -/
theorem read_canonical (ops : Ops) (node : U32) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
 (run : source ops node=ok basis) (j : Usize) (bound : j.val<256)
 (m : U32) (read : Array.index_usize basis j=ok m) : m.val<2^31-1 := by
 obtain ⟨actual,ha,hc⟩ := total ops node
 have same := Result.ok.inj (ha.symm.trans run)
 subst actual
 have len : j.val<basis.val.length := by rw [basis.property];exact bound
 obtain ⟨value,hvalue,atIndex⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec basis j len)
 have eq : value=m := Result.ok.inj (hvalue.symm.trans read)
 have canonical := hc j.val bound
 have cell : S7JoinBasisBlock.cell basis j.val=m := by
   simp only [S7JoinBasisBlock.cell,List.getElem?_eq_getElem len,Option.getD_some]
   exact atIndex.symm.trans eq
 rw [cell] at canonical
 exact canonical
#print axioms association
#print axioms total
#print axioms read_canonical
end NBF_BasisDomain

NEV_AccumulateTail.source:
import NEV_AccumulateRaw.Funs
import NBF_Accumulate
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_AccumulateTail
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NEV_AccumulateRaw
/-- Exact newly emitted prefix, not a successful-loop assumption. -/
def rows (a : Accumulator) (node : U32) (weights : BatchedWeights) : Result BatchedWeights := do
 let width := alloc.vec.Vec.len a.weights
 let zero ← aspis_core.field.M31.ZERO
 let one ← aspis_core.field.M31.ONE
 let initialized ← Array.update (Array.repeat 256#usize zero) 0#usize one
 let basis ← accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 one node width initialized 1#usize
 accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 {start:=0#usize,«end»:=width}
   a.weights a.power a.next weights width basis
/-- Exact checked counter updates and concrete lower field callees. -/
def tail (p : Prepared) (a : Accumulator)
    (value : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact) (weights : BatchedWeights) :
    Result (Accumulator × BatchedWeights) := do
 let terms ← weights.terms+1#usize
 let product ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_qm31 value a.power
 let rhs ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add a.rhs product
 trace.value 11#u16 a.next rhs
 let power ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul a.power p.rho
 let next ← a.next+1#usize
 ok ({a with rhs:=rhs,power:=power,next:=next},{weights with terms:=terms})

/-- Full Result decomposition: failed/divergent prefix or field call is kept,
including the original order of both independent counter operations. -/
theorem source_cut (p : Prepared) (a : Accumulator) (node : U32)
    (value : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact) (weights : BatchedWeights) :
    accumulate_batched_with_node p a node value weights =
      (do let middle ← rows a node weights;tail p a value middle) := by
  unfold accumulate_batched_with_node rows tail
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]

/-- The tail returns exactly the SAME vectors. This is a model carrier frame;
the native mutable/physical frame is separately checked by K036/K037. -/
theorem successful_frame (p : Prepared) (a out : Accumulator)
    (value : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact) (middle result : BatchedWeights)
    (run : tail p a value middle=ok (out,result)) :
    out.weights=a.weights ∧ result.raw=middle.raw := by
  unfold tail at run
  iterate 6 obtain ⟨x,hx,run⟩ := AspisR1.Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ run
  cases Result.ok.inj run
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

#print axioms source_cut
#print axioms successful_frame
end NEV_AccumulateTail
end

import NBF_BasisDomain
import NBF_FirstRows
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBF_Accumulate
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
/-- Composition changes only the explicitly named basis/row callbacks. -/
def install (ops : Ops) : Ops := NBF_RowInstall.install (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops)

/-- SAME basis and row results are constructed from the reached accumulator.
The remaining rhs/power callbacks and final counter updates stay in source order. -/
theorem rows (ops : Ops) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
 (node : U32) (value : Stage2E) (b : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (size : a.weights.val.length=64)
 (progress : S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress b.terms.val 0 (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b))
 (hq : ∀ k, (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb (Port3_RowsInstall.toK a.power) k).val<2^31-1) :
 ∃ basis mid,
 NBF_BasisDomain.source ops node=ok basis ∧
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (install ops)
   {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} a.weights a.power a.next b 64#usize basis=ok mid ∧
 mid.terms=b.terms ∧ mid.raw.val.length=64 ∧
 (∀ (j : Nat) (row : NBF_Frame.Row), mid.raw.val[j]?=some row → NBB_Sweep.Bound (b.terms.val+1) row) ∧
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node (install ops) p a node value b=
   (do let term ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add mid.terms 1#usize)
       let product ← ops.op3 value a.power
       let rhs ← ops.op2 a.rhs product
       (install ops).op15 11#u16 a.next rhs
       let power ← ops.op9 a.power p.rho
       let next ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add a.next 1#usize)
       ok ({a with rhs:=rhs,power:=power,next:=next},{mid with terms:=term})) := by
 obtain ⟨basis,hbasis,hcanonical⟩ := NBF_BasisDomain.total ops node
 have hb : ∀ j : Usize, j.val<64 → ∀ m, Array.index_usize basis j=ok m → m.val<2^31-1 := by
   intro j bound m read
   exact NBF_BasisDomain.read_canonical ops node basis hbasis j (by omega) m read
 obtain ⟨mid,run,terms,len,phase⟩ := NBF_RowsTotal.full (NBF_BasisInstall.install ops)
   a.weights a.power a.next basis b size progress hq hb
 refine ⟨basis,mid,hbasis,run,terms,len,phase,?_⟩
 have width : alloc.vec.Vec.len a.weights=64#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq size
 have produced :
   (do let m ← (install ops).op4
       let initial := Array.repeat 256#usize m
       let one ← (install ops).op5
       let initialized ← Array.update initial 0#usize one
       verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 (install ops) one node 64#usize initialized 1#usize)=ok basis := by
   change NBF_BasisDomain.source (NBF_RowInstall.install ops) node=ok basis
   rw [NBF_BasisDomain.association]
   rw [NBF_BasisDomain.association] at hbasis
   exact hbasis
 obtain ⟨initial,hinit,hvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (Array.update_spec (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32) 0#usize 1#u32 (by
     change 0<(List.replicate 256 0#u32).length
     rw [List.length_replicate];omega))
 have outer : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 (install ops)
   1#u32 node 64#usize initial 1#usize=ok basis := by
   change (do let initialized ← Array.update (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32) 0#usize 1#u32
              verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 (install ops)
                1#u32 node 64#usize initialized 1#usize)=ok basis at produced
   simpa only [hinit,bind_tc_ok] using produced
 have zero : (install ops).op4=ok 0#u32 := rfl
 have one : (install ops).op5=ok 1#u32 := rfl
 unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node
 rw [width]
 simp only [zero,one,hinit,outer,bind_tc_ok]
 have run2 : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (install ops)
   {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} a.weights a.power a.next b 64#usize basis=ok mid := run
 rw [run2,bind_tc_ok]
 rfl
#print axioms rows
end NBF_Accumulate

import NBF_RowsTotal
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBF_FirstRows
open AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2
/-- The SAME successful emitted pending constructor supplies initial row
progress. This merely imports the checked constructor/initialization bridge. -/
theorem constructor_progress (reserved : Bool) (old : Slice NBF_RowInstall.Q)
 (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (size : old.val.length=64)
 (run : Port3_NativePendingInstall.source reserved old=ok (.Ok b)) :
 b.terms=0#usize ∧ S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress 0 0 (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b) := by
 have reference := Port3_NativePendingInstall.reference_eq reserved old size
 have accepted : Port3_PendingInstall.pending reserved old=ok (.Ok b) := reference.symm.trans run
 exact ⟨(Port3_PendingInstall.accepted_fields reserved old b accepted).2.2.1,
   Port3_PendingInstall.accepted_progress reserved old b size accepted⟩

/-- First complete emitted row traversal: no input row-phase witness is
assumed. It comes from the actual successful constructor on THAT old vector. -/
theorem first (ops : Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops) (reserved : Bool)
 (old : Slice NBF_RowInstall.Q) (v : alloc.vec.Vec NBF_RowInstall.Q)
 (q : NBF_RowInstall.Q) (next : Usize) (basis : Array U32 256#usize)
 (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (size : old.val.length=64) (v64 : v.val.length=64)
 (constructor : Port3_NativePendingInstall.source reserved old=ok (.Ok b))
 (hq : ∀ k, (S7Kani2OwnedRowRefinement.powerLimb (Port3_RowsInstall.toK q) k).val<2^31-1)
 (hb : ∀ j : Usize, j.val<64 → ∀ m, Array.index_usize basis j=ok m → m.val<2^31-1) :
 ∃ out, Port3_NativeQueryBody.verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1 (NBF_RowInstall.install ops)
   {start:=0#usize,«end»:=64#usize} v q next b 64#usize basis=ok out ∧
 out.terms=0#usize ∧ out.raw.val.length=64 ∧
 ∀ (j : Nat) (row : NBF_Frame.Row), out.raw.val[j]?=some row → NBB_Sweep.Bound 1 row := by
 obtain ⟨terms,progress⟩ := constructor_progress reserved old b size constructor
 have progress1 : S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress b.terms.val 0 (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW b) := by
   simpa only [terms,show (0#usize).val=0 from rfl] using progress
 obtain ⟨out,run,same,len,phase⟩ := NBF_RowsTotal.full ops v q next basis b v64 progress1 hq hb
 exact ⟨out,run,same.trans terms,len,by simpa only [terms,show (0#usize).val=0 from rfl] using phase⟩
#print axioms constructor_progress
#print axioms first
end NBF_FirstRows

import NBO_AccumulateAssociation
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEI_AccumIndependentCounters
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2 Port3_NativeQueryBody
open NBO_AccumulateAssociation
private theorem associate {A B C : Type} (x : Result A) (f : A → Result B)
 (g : B → Result C) : ((x >>= f) >>= g) = (x >>= fun a=>f a >>= g) := by
 cases x <;> rfl
/-- Model shell only: independent global and local counters, including TX2.
This does not discharge the frozen CodeField::from_m31 slice boundary. -/
theorem independent_counters (ops : Ops) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
 (node : U32) (value : Stage2E) (b : verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (size : a.weights.val.length=64) (raw : b.raw.val.length=64)
 (active : a.next.val<22) (localActive : b.terms.val<22) :
 verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node (sourceOps ops) p a node value b =
 AspisR1Stage2.verifier.accumulateWithOps (reference ops) p a node value b := by
 have next := Port3_Wrapping.checked_add a.next 1#usize (by change a.next.val+1≤4096;omega)
 have nativeShell : verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node (sourceOps ops) p a node value b =
   (do let mid ← prefixRun ops a node b
       let term ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add mid.terms 1#usize)
       let product ← (sourceOps ops).op3 value a.power
       let rhs ← (sourceOps ops).op2 a.rhs product
       (sourceOps ops).op15 11#u16 a.next rhs
       let power ← (sourceOps ops).op9 a.power p.rho
       let successor ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add a.next 1#usize)
       ok ({a with rhs:=rhs,power:=power,next:=successor},{mid with terms:=term})) := by
   unfold verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node prefixRun
   simp only [associate,bind_tc_ok]
 have referenceShell : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.accumulateWithOps (reference ops) p a node value b =
   (do let mid ← prefixRun ops a node b
       let term ← mid.terms+1#usize
       let product ← (sourceOps ops).op3 value a.power
       let rhs ← (sourceOps ops).op2 a.rhs product
       (sourceOps ops).op15 11#u16 a.next rhs
       let power ← (sourceOps ops).op9 a.power p.rho
       let successor ← a.next+1#usize
       ok ({a with rhs:=rhs,power:=power,next:=successor},{mid with terms:=term})) := by
   unfold AspisR1Stage2.verifier.accumulateWithOps reference prefixRun
   simp only [associate,bind_tc_ok]
 rw [nativeShell,referenceShell]
 cases hprefix : prefixRun ops a node b with
 | fail e => rfl
 | div => rfl
 | ok mid =>
   have terms := prefix_terms ops a node b mid size raw hprefix
   have term := Port3_Wrapping.checked_add mid.terms 1#usize
     (by rw [terms];change b.terms.val+1≤4096;omega)
   simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok,term,next]
#print axioms independent_counters
end NEI_AccumIndependentCounters
end
