import LPi_NatBase
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPi_CMProduct
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_Total
abbrev NC := FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31

def Canon (x : NC) : Prop := x.a.val<2147483647 ∧ x.b.val<2147483647

def realWord (a b c d : Nat) := ((a*c)%2147483647+2147483647-(b*d)%2147483647)%2147483647
def imagWord (a b c d : Nat) :=
  ((((a+b)*(c+d))%2147483647+2147483647-(a*c)%2147483647)%2147483647+
    2147483647-(b*d)%2147483647)%2147483647

def sum (x : NC) : U64 := U64.wrapping_add
  (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from x.a) (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from x.b)
def cross (x y : NC) : U64 := U64.wrapping_mul (sum x) (sum y)

theorem sum_value (x : NC) : (sum x).val=x.a.val+x.b.val := by
  unfold sum
  rw [U64.wrapping_add_val_eq,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac)]
  rfl

theorem cross_value (x y : NC) (hx : Canon x) (hy : Canon y) :
    (cross x y).val=(x.a.val+x.b.val)*(y.a.val+y.b.val) := by
  unfold cross
  rw [U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq,sum_value,sum_value]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have h0 : x.a.val+x.b.val < 4294967296 := by obtain ⟨_,_⟩ := hx; omega
  have h1 : y.a.val+y.b.val < 4294967296 := by obtain ⟨_,_⟩ := hy; omega
  have h := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt h0 h1
  norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits] at h ⊢
  exact h

theorem source (x y : NC) (hx : Canon x) (hy : Canon y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul x y = ok z ∧ Canon z ∧
      z.a.val = realWord x.a.val x.b.val y.a.val y.b.val ∧
      z.b.val = imagWord x.a.val x.b.val y.a.val y.b.val := by
  obtain ⟨m0,h0,v0,c0⟩ := LPf_BaseMultiply.source x.a y.a
  obtain ⟨m1,h1,v1,c1⟩ := LPf_BaseMultiply.source x.b y.b
  obtain ⟨m2,h2,v2,c2⟩ := LPf_CoreReduction.source (cross x y)
  have hr : FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 (cross x y) = ok m2 := by
    simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64,h2,bind_tc_ok]
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va,ca⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub m0 m1 c0 c1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb,cb⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub m2 m0 c2 c0
  obtain ⟨c,hc,vc,cc⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub b m1 cb c1
  refine ⟨⟨a,c⟩,?_,⟨ca,cc⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul,h0,h1,lift,bind_tc_ok]
    change (do let t ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 (cross x y)
               let a ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub m0 m1
               let b ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub t m0
               let c ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub b m1
               ok (⟨a,c⟩ : NC)) = _
    simp only [hr,ha,hb,hc,bind_tc_ok]
  · simpa only [realWord,v0,v1] using va
  · rw [cross_value x y hx hy] at v2
    simpa only [imagWord,vb,v2,v0,v1] using vc

theorem sub_word (x y : U32) (h : y.val ≤ x.val) :
    (U32.wrapping_sub x y).val = x.val-y.val := by
  rw [U32.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
  have hx := x.hSize
  have hy := y.hSize
  have he : x.val+(UScalar.size .U32-y.val)=(x.val-y.val)+UScalar.size .U32 := by omega
  rw [he,Nat.add_mod,Nat.mod_self,Nat.add_zero,Nat.mod_mod,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]

theorem add (x y : U32) (hx : x.val < 2147483647) (hy : y.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add x y = ok z ∧
    z.val = (x.val+y.val)%2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  let s := U32.wrapping_add x y
  have sv : s.val = x.val+y.val := by
    rw [U32.wrapping_add_val_eq,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac)]
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  change ∃ z, (if s ≥ 2147483647#u32 then
    ok (U32.wrapping_sub s 2147483647#u32) else ok s) = ok z ∧ _
  by_cases h : s ≥ 2147483647#u32
  · rw [if_pos h]
    have hp : 2147483647 ≤ s.val := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨_,rfl,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [sub_word s 2147483647#u32 hp]
      change s.val-2147483647 = (x.val+y.val)%2147483647
      rw [←sv,Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod hp,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    · rw [sub_word s 2147483647#u32 hp]; change s.val-2147483647 < 2147483647; omega
  · rw [if_neg h]
    have hp : s.val < 2147483647 := by scalar_tac
    exact ⟨_,rfl,by rw [←sv,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp],hp⟩

  by_cases h : s ≥ 2147483647#u32

    refine ⟨_,rfl,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [sub_word s 2147483647#u32 hp]

import LPf_BaseMultiply

namespace AspisR1.LPi_Total
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev NC := FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31
abbrev NQ := FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev NE := FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact

def Total {α : Type} (r : Result α) : Prop := ∃ z, r = ok z

theorem bind_total {α β : Type} {r : Result α} {k : α → Result β}
    (hr : Total r) (hk : ∀ x, Total (k x)) : Total (r >>= k) := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hr
  rw [hx,bind_tc_ok]
  exact hk x

theorem m31_mul (x y : U32) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul x y) := by
  obtain ⟨z,h,_,_⟩ := LPf_BaseMultiply.source x y
  exact ⟨z,h⟩

theorem reduce (x : U64) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 x) := by
  obtain ⟨z,h,_,_⟩ := LPf_CoreReduction.source x
  exact ⟨z,by simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64,h,bind_tc_ok]⟩

theorem m31_add (x y : U32) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add x y) := by
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  split <;> exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem m31_sub (x y : U32) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub x y) := by
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  split <;> exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem cm_add (x y : NC) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.add x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.add
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro b
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem cm_sub (x y : NC) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.sub x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.sub
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro b
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem cm_mul (x y : NC) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul
  apply bind_total (m31_mul _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (m31_mul _ _); intro b
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  apply bind_total (reduce _); intro c
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro d
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro e
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro f
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem by_r (x : NC) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.mul_by_r x) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.mul_by_r FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.double
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro b
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro c
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro d
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem qm_add (x y : NQ) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.add x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.add
  apply bind_total (cm_add _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (cm_add _ _); intro b
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem qm_sub (x y : NQ) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.sub x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.sub
  apply bind_total (cm_sub _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (cm_sub _ _); intro b

import LPf_CoreReduction
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPf_BaseMultiply
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- Full u32 operands, without a canonical-input restriction. -/
theorem product_bound (x y : U32) : x.val * y.val < 18446744073709551616 := by
  have hx : x.val ≤ 4294967295 := by scalar_tac
  have hy : y.val ≤ 4294967295 := by scalar_tac
  have bound := Nat.mul_le_mul hx hy
  omega

theorem word_product (x y : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_mul (UScalar.cast .U64 x) (UScalar.cast .U64 y)).val = x.val*y.val := by
  rw [U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq]
  have cx : (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val = x.val := by scalar_tac
  have cy : (UScalar.cast .U64 y).val = y.val := by scalar_tac
  rw [cx, cy]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits]
  exact product_bound x y

/-- The actual extracted frozen M31 multiplication is total and equals
natural multiplication modulo P. This is a Lean source theorem, not a claim
that the timed-out Kani exact contract passed. -/
theorem source (x y : U32) : ∃ z,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul x y = ok z ∧
    z.val = (x.val*y.val) % 2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨z, run, val, canonical⟩ := LPf_CoreReduction.source
    (U64.wrapping_mul (UScalar.cast .U64 x) (UScalar.cast .U64 y))
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_, canonical⟩
  · simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul,lift,bind_tc_ok,run]
  · rw [word_product] at val
    exact val

#print axioms product_bound
#print axioms word_product
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPf_BaseMultiply

import LPf_ReductionWord
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPf_CoreReduction
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- The two frozen source reducers place the u32 cast on opposite sides of
subtraction. Their twice-folded bounds make those placements equivalent. -/
theorem same (x : U64) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.reduce_u64 x =
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce x := by
  let m := FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)
  have small : m.val < 4294967294 := by
    rw [LPf_ReductionWord.twice_value]
    apply LPe_MersenneReduction.fold_twice_lt
    scalar_tac
  have cv : (UScalar.cast .U32 m).val = m.val := by scalar_tac
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.reduce_u64 FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P, FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.P,
    lift, bind_tc_ok]
  change (if UScalar.cast .U32 m ≥ 2147483647#u32
    then ok (U32.wrapping_sub (UScalar.cast .U32 m) 2147483647#u32)
    else ok (UScalar.cast .U32 m)) =
    (if m ≥ 2147483647#u64
    then ok (UScalar.cast .U32 (U64.wrapping_sub m 2147483647#u64))
    else ok (UScalar.cast .U32 m))
  split
  · rename_i h
    have hm : m ≥ 2147483647#u64 := by scalar_tac
    rw [if_pos hm]
    congr 1
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    unfold U32.wrapping_sub U64.wrapping_sub
    rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, UScalar.wrapping_sub_val_eq,
      UScalar.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
    norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits,U32.size,U32.numBits]
    omega
  · rename_i h
    have hm : ¬m ≥ 2147483647#u64 := by scalar_tac
    rw [if_neg hm]

/-- Total exact base-field reduction on every source word. -/
theorem source (x : U64) : ∃ z,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.reduce_u64 x = ok z ∧
    z.val = x.val % 2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  rw [same]
  exact LPf_ReductionWord.native_reduce x

import FIo_ReduceBounds
import FIo_NativeFuns
import LPe_MersenneReduction
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPf_ReductionWord
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- The native word fold has the natural value used in LPe's reduction theorem. -/
theorem fold_value (x : U64) :
    (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x).val = LPe_MersenneReduction.fold x.val :=
by
  unfold FIo_ReduceBounds.fold U64.wrapping_add
  rw [UScalar.wrapping_add_val_eq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (FIo_ReduceBounds.sum_bound x)]
  have low : (x &&& 2147483647#u64).val = x.val % 2147483648 := by
    change (x.bv &&& (2147483647 : BitVec 64)).toNat = x.val % 2147483648
    rw [BitVec.toNat_and]
    exact Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod x.val 31
  rw [low, FIo_ReduceBounds.shr_val]
  rfl

theorem twice_value (x : U64) :
    (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)).val =
      LPe_MersenneReduction.fold (LPe_MersenneReduction.fold x.val) := by
  rw [fold_value, fold_value]

/-- Exact value of the actual extracted private reducer, including word casts
and wrapping subtraction. No successful output observation is a premise. -/
theorem native_reduce (x : U64) : ∃ z,
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce x = ok z ∧
    z.val = x.val % 2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  have hx : x.val < 18446744073709551616 := by scalar_tac
  have small : (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)).val < 4294967294 := by
    rw [twice_value]
    exact LPe_MersenneReduction.fold_twice_lt x.val hx
  have value := twice_value x
  have residue := LPe_MersenneReduction.reduce_eq_mod x.val hx
  unfold FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce
  simp only [FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.P, lift, bind_tc_ok]
  change ∃ z, (if FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x) ≥ 2147483647#u64
    then ok (UScalar.cast .U32 (U64.wrapping_sub
      (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)) 2147483647#u64))
    else ok (UScalar.cast .U32 (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)))) = ok z ∧ _
  split
  · rename_i h
    have lower : 2147483647 ≤ (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)).val := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold U64.wrapping_sub
      rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, UScalar.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
      norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits,U32.size,U32.numBits]
      unfold LPe_MersenneReduction.reduce at residue
      rw [if_pos (by omega)] at residue
      omega
    · unfold U64.wrapping_sub
      rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, UScalar.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
      norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits,U32.size,U32.numBits]
      omega
  · rename_i h
    have lower : (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)).val < 2147483647 := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq]
      norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U32.size,U32.numBits]
      unfold LPe_MersenneReduction.reduce at residue
      rw [if_neg (by omega)] at residue
      omega
    · scalar_tac

#print axioms twice_value
#print axioms native_reduce
end AspisR1.LPf_ReductionWord

import LPi_TowerValues

namespace NBG_WideCarriers
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 LPi_FieldValues

theorem wide_add (x y : NE) (hx : canonE x) (hy : canonE y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add x y = ok z ∧
      canonE z ∧ ew z = (addQ (qw x.c0) (qw y.c0), addQ (qw x.c1) (qw y.c1)) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,va⟩ := LPi_TowerValues.qm_add x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,cb,vb⟩ := LPi_TowerValues.qm_add x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  exact ⟨⟨a,b⟩,by simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add,
    ha,hb,bind_tc_ok],⟨ca,cb⟩,Prod.ext va vb⟩

theorem limbs_result (a b c d e f g h : U32) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs
      (Array.make 8#usize [a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h]) =
      ok (if a < 2147483647#u32 ∧ b < 2147483647#u32 ∧ c < 2147483647#u32 ∧
        d < 2147483647#u32 ∧ e < 2147483647#u32 ∧ f < 2147483647#u32 ∧
        g < 2147483647#u32 ∧ h < 2147483647#u32
        then some (LPf_WideConstruction.value a b c d e f g h) else none) := by
  simp [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs,
    Array.index_usize,Array.make,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P,LPf_WideConstruction.value]
  repeat' split
  all_goals simp_all <;> omega

theorem to_limbs_result (x : NE) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_limbs x =
      ok (Array.make 8#usize [x.c0.c0.a,x.c0.c0.b,x.c0.c1.a,x.c0.c1.b,
        x.c1.c0.a,x.c1.c0.b,x.c1.c1.a,x.c1.c1.b]) := rfl

/-- Wrong lengths reject before any byte index, for arbitrary machine slices. -/
theorem wrong_byte_length (bytes : Slice U8) (h : bytes.val.length ≠ 32) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes bytes = ok none := by
  have hn : Slice.len bytes != 32#usize := by
    simp only [bne_iff_ne]
    intro eq
    have values := congrArg UScalar.val eq
    apply h
    change bytes.val.length = 32 at values
    exact values
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.BYTE_LEN,hn,if_true]

abbrev PQ := AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.QM31
abbrev PE := AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.WideExact
def pw (x : PQ) : Nat × Nat × Nat × Nat :=
  (x.c0.a.val,x.c0.b.val,x.c1.a.val,x.c1.b.val)
def reduced (x : PQ) : Nat × Nat × Nat × Nat :=
  (x.c0.a.val%2147483647,x.c0.b.val%2147483647,
   x.c1.a.val%2147483647,x.c1.b.val%2147483647)

theorem remainder (x : U32) : ∃ z, x % 2147483647#u32 = ok z ∧
    z.val = x.val % 2147483647 :=
  WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec x (y:=2147483647#u32) (by decide))

theorem canonical_qm31 (x : PQ) : ∃ z,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.canonical_qm31 x = ok z ∧ pw z = reduced x := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va⟩ := remainder x.c0.a
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb⟩ := remainder x.c0.b
  obtain ⟨c,hc,vc⟩ := remainder x.c1.a
  obtain ⟨d,hd,vd⟩ := remainder x.c1.b
  refine ⟨⟨⟨a,b⟩,⟨c,d⟩⟩,?_,Prod.ext va (Prod.ext vb (Prod.ext vc vd))⟩
  simp only [AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.canonical_qm31,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.canonical_qm31.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnTupleM31M31.call,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.P,ha,hb,hc,hd,bind_tc_ok]

theorem wide_new (x y : PQ) : ∃ z : PE,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.WideExact.new x y = ok z ∧
      (pw z.c0,pw z.c1) = (reduced x,reduced y) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va⟩ := canonical_qm31 x
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb⟩ := canonical_qm31 y
  exact ⟨⟨a,b⟩,by simp only [AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.WideExact.new,ha,hb,bind_tc_ok],
    Prod.ext va vb⟩

#print axioms wide_add
#print axioms limbs_result
#print axioms to_limbs_result
#print axioms wrong_byte_length
#print axioms remainder
#print axioms canonical_qm31
#print axioms wide_new
end NBG_WideCarriers

import NEV_PrimitiveBindings
import NEI_PushBridge
import NEI_PushRawAssociation
import NBF_Progress
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_PushDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NEV_AccumulateCarriers AspisR1

def bw (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights) : NEI_PushBridge.BW := ⟨b.raw,b.terms⟩
def power (q : RawQ) : NEI_PushBridge.Power :=
 NEI_PushRawAssociation.toPower (NEV_AccumulateRaw.NEV_Bindings.toPushQ q)

theorem canonical_limb (q : RawQ) (canonical : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical (toQ q)) (index : Usize) :
    (S7Kani2OwnedRow.limb (NEG_RowBridge.modelPower (power q)) index).val<2147483647 := by
  have words := (NEV_StageFields.canonical_q (toQ q)).mp canonical
  change (if index=0#usize then q.c0.a else if index=1#usize then q.c0.b
    else if index=2#usize then q.c1.a else q.c1.b).val<2147483647
  split_ifs <;> first | exact words.1.1 | exact words.1.2 | exact words.2.1 | exact words.2.2

/-- The reached same-vector progress witness supplies the CLOSED NEI push
packet's exact overflow domain. No stronger row bound or callee success is
assumed. Existing phase_bound proves the final scalar inequality. -/
theorem reached (b : NEV_AccumulateRaw.BatchedWeights) (index : Usize) (q : RawQ) (basis : U32)
    (progress : S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress b.terms.val index.val
      (Port3_RowsInstall.toBW (toWeights b)))
    (inside : index.val<64) (canonical : NBF_PowerStep.Canonical (toQ q))
    (basisCanonical : basis.val<2147483647) :
    NEI_PushBridge.Domain (bw b) index (power q) basis := by
  have size : b.raw.val.length=64 := progress.2.1
  have inRange : index.val<b.raw.val.length := by omega
  have inv := NBF_Progress.sweep b.terms.val index.val (toWeights b) progress
  refine ⟨inRange,?_⟩
  intro row read
  obtain ⟨actual,actualRun,atIndex⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec b.raw index inRange)
  have given : alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize b.raw index=ok row := read
  have same : actual=row := Result.ok.inj (actualRun.symm.trans given)
  have listed : b.raw.val[index.val]?=some row := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem inRange]
    exact congrArg some (atIndex.symm.trans same)
  have bound : NBB_Sweep.Bound b.terms.val row := by
    have current := inv index.val row listed
    simpa only [Nat.lt_irrefl,if_false] using current
  intro lane word laneInside wordRead
  obtain ⟨selected,selectedRun,selectedAt⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.index_usize_spec row lane (by change lane.val<row.val.length;rw [row.property];exact laneInside))
  have sameWord : selected=word := Result.ok.inj (selectedRun.symm.trans wordRead)
  have member : word∈row.val := by
    have equality : word=row.val[lane.val]'(by rw [row.property];exact laneInside) := sameWord.symm.trans selectedAt
    rw [equality]
    exact List.getElem_mem _
  exact S7OwnedP6ScalarProof.phase_bound word _ basis (b.terms.val%4)
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)) (canonical_limb q canonical lane) basisCanonical (bound word member)
#print axioms canonical_limb
#print axioms reached
end NEV_PushDomains
end

import NEV_BasisOuterStep
import NEI_PrefixProduct
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEV_BasisCallDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1
/-- The SAME square result supplies double's canonical domain; the SAME
returned double supplies sub's. Reuse retained scalar total/value laws. -/
theorem scalar (node : U32) : ∃ square doubled out,
    NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.mul node node=ok square ∧ square.val<2147483647 ∧
    NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.double square=ok doubled ∧ doubled.val<2147483647 ∧
    NEV_AccumulateRaw.aspis_core.field.M31.sub doubled 1#u32=ok out ∧ out.val<2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨square,actual,_,value,canonical⟩ := NEI_PrefixProduct.actual node node
  obtain ⟨doubled,hd,_,cd⟩ := ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_add_mod square square canonical canonical
  obtain ⟨out,ho,_,co⟩ := ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_sub_mod doubled 1#u32 cd (by decide)
  exact ⟨square,doubled,out,actual,canonical,
    (NEV_BasisOuterStep.double square).trans hd,cd,
    (NEV_BasisOuterStep.subtract doubled 1#u32).trans ho,co⟩
/-- Every active width64 level establishes the stricter native window. -/
theorem active_level (n fuel : Nat) (positive : 0<n) (schedule : n*2^(fuel+1)=64) :
    n≤32 ∧ n*2≤64 := by
  have power : 0<2^fuel := by positivity
  have bound := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (n*2) (show 1≤2^fuel by omega)
  rw [pow_succ] at schedule
  constructor <;> nlinarith
#print axioms scalar
#print axioms active_level
end NEV_BasisCallDomains
end

/-- The actual frozen emitted M31 body and prefix's same callee return the
same exact natural value, on every machine-word input. -/
theorem actual (lhs rhs : U32) :
    ∃ reply, NEI_LineFull.aspis_core.field.M31.mul lhs rhs = ok reply ∧
      NEG_PrefixFull.aspis_core.field.M31.mul lhs rhs = ok reply ∧
      reply.val = (lhs.val * rhs.val) % 2147483647 ∧ reply.val < 2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨reply,run,value,canonical⟩ := NEG_PrefixStep.multiply lhs rhs
  have current : AspisR1CurrentWide.field.M31.mul lhs rhs = ok reply := by
    rw [AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof.m31_mul_same]
    exact run
  exact ⟨reply,(NEI_FieldScalar.m_mul lhs rhs).trans current,run,value,canonical⟩

/-- Primitive specialization only; no native loop or append result is assumed. -/
theorem specialize (lhs rhs : U32) (P : U32 → Prop)
    (universal : ∀ reply, reply.val < 2147483647 → P reply) :
    ∃ reply, NEI_LineFull.aspis_core.field.M31.mul lhs rhs = ok reply ∧
      NEG_PrefixFull.aspis_core.field.M31.mul lhs rhs = ok reply ∧ P reply := by
  obtain ⟨reply,actualRun,cohortRun,value,canonical⟩ := actual lhs rhs
  exact ⟨reply,actualRun,cohortRun,universal reply canonical⟩

#print axioms actual
#print axioms specialize
end NEI_PrefixProduct

import NEI_PrefixStep
import KMX_CopyMeaning
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEI_PrefixWindows
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1

/-- One arbitrary value window plus the length determines the entire append. -/
theorem append_from_windows {T : Type} (before after : List T) (value : T)
    (length : after.length = before.length + 1)
    (windows : ∀ (offset : Nat) (valid : offset < after.length),
      after[offset] = if h : offset < before.length then before[offset] else value) :
    after = before ++ [value] := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_append,List.length_singleton]
    exact length
  · intro offset ha hb
    rw [windows offset ha]
    by_cases inside : offset < before.length
    · simp only [dif_pos inside,List.getElem_append_left inside]
    · have atEnd : offset = before.length := by omega
      subst offset
      simp

/-- Exact KMX successful-shrink law on an arbitrary surviving location. -/
theorem surviving_copy {T : Type} (src dst : Nat → T) (oldSize newSize offset : Nat)
    (shrinking : newSize ≤ oldSize) (inside : offset < newSize) :
    KMX_CopyMeaning.loop src dst 0 (min oldSize newSize) offset = src offset := by
  rw [KMX_CopyMeaning.realloc_prefix]
  simp only [Nat.min_eq_right shrinking,if_pos inside]

/-- The field operation's actual reply is admitted by the multiplication-free
oracle. The source law supplies its exact value; Kani assumes only the bound. -/
theorem specialize_field_reply (lhs rhs : U32) (P : U32 → Prop)
    (universal : ∀ reply, reply.val < 2147483647 → P reply) :
    ∃ reply, NEG_PrefixFull.aspis_core.field.M31.mul lhs rhs = ok reply ∧
      reply.val = (lhs.val * rhs.val) % 2147483647 ∧ P reply := by
  obtain ⟨reply,run,value,canonical⟩ := NEG_PrefixStep.multiply lhs rhs
  exact ⟨reply,run,value,universal reply canonical⟩

/-- The native local window facts specialize to the SAME emitted source step.
Only primitive append and field-reply observations enter the premises. -/
theorem source_step (flat : Slice U32) (before after : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (product reply : U32) (index : Usize) (size : flat.val.length ≤ 110)
    (running : index.val < flat.val.length) (length : before.val.length = index.val)
    (afterLength : after.val.length = before.val.length + 1)
    (windows : ∀ (offset : Nat) (valid : offset < after.val.length),
      after.val[offset] = if h : offset < before.val.length then before.val[offset] else product)
    (fieldReply : reply.val = (product.val * (flat.val[index.val]'running).val) % 2147483647) :
    ∃ next : Usize, next.val = index.val + 1 ∧
      NEG_PrefixFull.batch_prefix_products_loop.body flat before product index =
        ok (cont (after,reply,next)) := by
  have pushed : after.val = before.val ++ [product] :=
    append_from_windows before.val after.val product afterLength windows
  obtain ⟨next,nextValue,body⟩ := NCB_PrefixNativeStep.source NEG_PrefixAssociation.ops rfl
    flat before after product reply index size running (by omega) pushed fieldReply
  exact ⟨next,nextValue,(NEG_PrefixAssociation.step flat before product index).trans body⟩

#print axioms append_from_windows
#print axioms surviving_copy
#print axioms specialize_field_reply
#print axioms source_step
end NEI_PrefixWindows
end

import NEG_PrefixStep

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace NEI_PrefixStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1

/-- The same prestate read, appended value, product and index; arbitrary U32 flat. -/
theorem active (flat : Slice U32) (prefixes : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (product : U32) (index : Usize) (size : flat.val.length ≤ 110)
    (length : prefixes.val.length = index.val) (running : index.val < flat.val.length) :
    ∃ ps z next, NEG_PrefixFull.batch_prefix_products_loop.body flat prefixes product index =
      ok (cont (ps,z,next)) ∧ ps.val = prefixes.val ++ [product] ∧
      z.val = (product.val * (flat.val[index.val]'running).val) % 2147483647 ∧
      z.val < 2147483647 ∧ next.val = index.val + 1 := by
  obtain ⟨value,read,hvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Slice.index_usize_spec flat index running)
  change value = flat.val[index.val] at hvalue
  have capacity : prefixes.val.length < Usize.max := by
    have roomy : 110 < Usize.max := by scalar_tac
    omega
  obtain ⟨ps,push,pval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (alloc.vec.Vec.push_spec prefixes product capacity)
  obtain ⟨z,mul,natural,canonical⟩ := NEG_PrefixStep.multiply product value
  have exactProduct : z.val = (product.val * (flat.val[index.val]'running).val) % 2147483647 := by
    simpa only [hvalue] using natural
  obtain ⟨next,nextValue,body⟩ := NCB_PrefixNativeStep.source NEG_PrefixAssociation.ops rfl
    flat prefixes ps product z index size running (by omega) pval exactProduct
  exact ⟨ps,z,next,(NEG_PrefixAssociation.step flat prefixes product index).trans body,
    pval,exactProduct,canonical,nextValue⟩

theorem stopped (flat : Slice U32) (prefixes : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (product : U32) (index : Usize) (done : flat.val.length ≤ index.val) :
    NEG_PrefixFull.batch_prefix_products_loop.body flat prefixes product index =
      ok (ControlFlow.done (prefixes,product)) := by
  exact (NEG_PrefixAssociation.step flat prefixes product index).trans
    (NCB_PrefixNativeStep.stopped NEG_PrefixAssociation.ops flat prefixes product index done)

/-- Reuse the proved finite induction; no native whole-buffer run is assumed. -/
theorem total (flat : Slice U32) (size : flat.val.length ≤ 110) :
    ∃ ps product, NEG_PrefixFull.batch_prefix_products flat = ok (ps,product) ∧
      (ps.val,product) = S7Kani2PrefixLoop.model flat.val [] 1#u32 := by
  obtain ⟨ps,product,run,meaning⟩ := Port4C_PrefixMeaning.total NEG_PrefixAssociation.ops rfl rfl flat size
  exact ⟨ps,product,(NEG_PrefixAssociation.source flat).trans run,meaning⟩

#print axioms active
#print axioms stopped
#print axioms total
end NEI_PrefixStep

def ops : Port4C_NativePrefix.Leaves :=
  ⟨AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul,ok 1#u32⟩

theorem guarded_increment (index len : Usize) (h : index < len) :
    (index + 1#usize : Result Usize) = ok (UScalar.wrapping_add index 1#usize) := by
  have hm : index.val + (1#usize).val ≤ UScalar.max .Usize := by scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨z,run,hz⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.add_spec hm)
  have he := UScalar.add_equiv index 1#usize
  have hop : (index + 1#usize : Result Usize) = UScalar.add index 1#usize := rfl
  simp only [← hop,run] at he
  have eq : z = UScalar.wrapping_add index 1#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    change z.bv.toNat = (index.bv + (1#usize).bv).toNat
    exact congrArg BitVec.toNat he.2.2

  rw [eq] at run
  exact run

theorem step (flat : Slice U32) (prefixes : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (product : U32) (index : Usize) :
    NEG_PrefixFull.batch_prefix_products_loop.body flat prefixes product index =
      Port4C_NativePrefix.verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body ops flat prefixes product index := by
  unfold NEG_PrefixFull.batch_prefix_products_loop.body
    Port4C_NativePrefix.verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body
  by_cases active : index < Slice.len flat
  · simp only [active,if_true,ops]
    rw [guarded_increment index (Slice.len flat) active]
    rfl
  · simp only [active,if_false]

theorem loop (flat : Slice U32) (prefixes : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (product : U32) (index : Usize) :
    NEG_PrefixFull.batch_prefix_products_loop flat prefixes product index =
      Port4C_NativePrefix.verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop ops flat prefixes product index := by
  unfold NEG_PrefixFull.batch_prefix_products_loop
    Port4C_NativePrefix.verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop
  congr 1
  funext state
  rcases state with ⟨p,v,i⟩
  exact step flat p v i

theorem source (flat : Slice U32) :
    NEG_PrefixFull.batch_prefix_products flat =
      Port4C_NativePrefix.verifier.batch_prefix_products ops flat := by
  unfold NEG_PrefixFull.batch_prefix_products
    Port4C_NativePrefix.verifier.batch_prefix_products
  simp only [NEG_PrefixFull.aspis_core.field.M31.ONE,ops,bind_tc_ok]
  exact loop flat _ _ _

#print axioms guarded_increment
#print axioms step
#print axioms loop
#print axioms source
end NEG_PrefixAssociation
end

import NCB_PrefixNativeStep
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NCB_PrefixCutTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open AspisR1.Port4C_NativePrefix
/-- Ordered local observations of one actual buffer carrier. Each edge records
only the append frame and modular field reply, not a whole model loop result.
Existence for a frozen native execution remains a separate bridge obligation. -/
inductive Cuts (flat : Slice U32) : Usize → alloc.vec.Vec U32 → U32 →
    alloc.vec.Vec U32 → U32 → Prop
  | done (index : Usize) (buffer : alloc.vec.Vec U32) (product : U32)
      (stop : flat.val.length=index.val) : Cuts flat index buffer product buffer product
  | step (index : Usize) (buffer next final : alloc.vec.Vec U32) (product nextProduct finalProduct : U32)
      (active : index.val<flat.val.length)
      (pushed : next.val=buffer.val++[product])
      (multiplied : nextProduct.val=(product.val*(flat.val[index.val]'active).val)%2147483647)
      (tail : Cuts flat (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize) next nextProduct final finalProduct) :
      Cuts flat index buffer product final finalProduct

theorem associated (ops : Leaves)
    (multiply : ops.mul=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul)
    (flat : Slice U32) (size : flat.val.length≤110)
    (index : Usize) (buffer final : alloc.vec.Vec U32) (product finalProduct : U32)
    (cuts : Cuts flat index buffer product final finalProduct)
    (length : buffer.val.length=index.val) :
    verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop ops flat buffer product index=ok (final,finalProduct) := by
  induction cuts with
  | done index buffer product stop =>
    have body := NCB_PrefixNativeStep.stopped ops flat buffer product index (by omega)
    unfold verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,body]
  | step index buffer next final product nextProduct finalProduct active pushed multiplied tail ih =>
    have inc := Port3_Wrapping.increment index (by omega)
    have nextLen : next.val.length=(Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize).val := by
      rw [pushed,List.length_append,List.length_singleton,length,inc]
    have tailRun := ih nextLen
    obtain ⟨cursor,cursorVal,body⟩ := NCB_PrefixNativeStep.source ops multiply flat buffer next
      product nextProduct index size active (by omega) pushed multiplied
    have cursorEq : cursor=Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (cursorVal.trans inc.symm)
    rw [cursorEq] at body
    unfold verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,body]
    exact tailRun

/-- Reuse the existing complete buffer meaning theorem after associating the
ordered cuts. This adds no independently chosen native result or product. -/
theorem meaning (ops : Leaves)
    (multiply : ops.mul=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul)
    (one : ops.one=ok (1#u32)) (flat : Slice U32) (size : flat.val.length≤110)
    (final : alloc.vec.Vec U32) (finalProduct : U32)
    (cuts : Cuts flat 0#usize (alloc.vec.Vec.new U32) 1#u32 final finalProduct) :
    (final.val,finalProduct)=S7Kani2PrefixLoop.model flat.val [] 1#u32 := by
  have run := associated ops multiply flat size 0#usize (alloc.vec.Vec.new U32) final
    1#u32 finalProduct cuts rfl
  obtain ⟨out,product,source,value⟩ := Port4C_PrefixMeaning.total ops multiply one flat size
  have entry : verifier.batch_prefix_products ops flat=ok (final,finalProduct) := by
    simp only [verifier.batch_prefix_products,one,bind_tc_ok,alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity]
    exact run
  have same := Prod.mk.inj (Result.ok.inj (source.symm.trans entry))
  rcases same with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  exact value
#print axioms associated
#print axioms meaning
end NCB_PrefixCutTrace
end

import NBS_GeometryDomains
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NCB_PrefixNativeStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open AspisR1.Port4C_NativePrefix S7Kani2PrefixLoop
/-- Three local native cuts compose at ONE arbitrary prefix prestate.
The read, append frame and modular reply are tied to the same flat/index/product.
Ownership and the native whole-loop trace are not assumed or concluded. -/
theorem source (ops : Leaves)
    (multiply : ops.mul=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul)
    (flat : Slice U32) (prefixes after : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (product productAfter : U32) (index : Usize)
    (size : flat.val.length≤110) (active : index.val<flat.val.length)
    (capacity : prefixes.val.length≤110)
    (nativePush : after.val=prefixes.val++[product])
    (nativeMul : productAfter.val=(product.val*(flat.val[index.val]'active).val)%2147483647) :
    ∃ next : Usize, next.val=index.val+1 ∧
      verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body ops flat prefixes product index=
        ok (cont (after,productAfter,next)) := by
  obtain ⟨x,read,word⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Slice.index_usize_spec flat index active)
  obtain ⟨next,push,contents⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (alloc.vec.Vec.push_spec prefixes product (by
      have h : 110<Usize.max := by scalar_tac
      omega))
  have same : next=after := Subtype.ext (contents.trans nativePush.symm)
  subst next
  have value : wordMul product x=productAfter := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    change (product.val*x.val)%2147483647=productAfter.val
    change x=flat.val[index.val] at word
    rw [word]
    exact nativeMul.symm
  let next := Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize
  refine ⟨next,Port3_Wrapping.increment index (by omega),?_⟩
  have running : index<Slice.len flat := active
  simp only [verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body,if_pos running,read,push,
    multiply,multiply_word,value,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl

theorem stopped (ops : Leaves) (flat : Slice U32) (prefixes : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (product : U32) (index : Usize) (stop : flat.val.length ≤ index.val) :
    verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body ops flat prefixes product index=
      ok (done (prefixes,product)) := by
  have inactive : ¬index<Slice.len flat := by change ¬index.val<flat.val.length;omega
  simp only [verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body,if_neg inactive]
#print axioms source
#print axioms stopped
end NCB_PrefixNativeStep
end

theorem sizes (start stop : Nat) (order : start≤stop) (hi : stop≤22) :
    stop-start≤22 ∧ (stop-start)*5≤110 ∧
    (start=10 → stop-start≤12 ∧ (stop-start)*5≤60) := by omega

    u/4*4<262144 ∧ u/4*4+3<262144 ∧
    u/4*4≤u ∧ u≤u/4*4+3 := by omega

/-- A selected record is exactly five consecutive entries in the SAME flat
vector. This also proves the allocation/index arithmetic does not overflow. -/
theorem group (n i j : Nat) (hn : n≤22) (hi : i<n) (hj : j<5) :
    5*i+j<5*n ∧ 5*i+j<110 ∧ 5*i+j<18446744073709551616 := by omega

    index-start<count ∧ start+(index-start)=index := by omega

/-- Accepted zero checks and canonicality imply nonzero natural residues,
so a successful native path never inverts field zero. -/
theorem nonzero (word : Nat) (canonical : word<2147483647) (guard : word≠0) :
    word%2147483647≠0 := by rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt canonical];exact guard

  have same : actual=q := Result.ok.inj (sourceRun.symm.trans run)
  have member : q∈v.val := by

    rw [equality]
    exact List.getElem_mem _

open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20
open AspisR1 AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof

/-- The actual extracted source uses identical fields; inverse is unrestricted. -/
def Domain (alpha : N.E) (a : Array N.E 4#usize) : Prop :=
  NEI_CircleDomains.Domain (toE alpha) (rows a)

theorem returns (alpha : N.E) (a : Array N.E 4#usize) (inverse : Array U32 5#usize)
    (domain : Domain alpha a) :
    ∃ out, NEI_CircleShared.circle_fold_with_inverses alpha a inverse = ok out ∧
      NEG_FoldsTypes.circle_fold_with_inverses (toE alpha) (rows a) inverse = ok (toE out) ∧
      CanonicalWide (toE out) := by
  obtain ⟨value,source,canonical⟩ := NEI_CircleDomains.total (toE alpha) (rows a) inverse domain
  have cohort : NEG_FoldsTypes.circle_fold_with_inverses (toE alpha) (rows a) inverse = ok value :=
    (NEG_FoldAssociation.circle _ _ _).trans source
  have mapped := (NEI_CircleActual.body alpha a inverse).trans source
  cases native : NEI_CircleShared.circle_fold_with_inverses alpha a inverse with
  | fail e => simp only [native,resultMap] at mapped; cases mapped
  | div => simp only [native,resultMap] at mapped; cases mapped
  | ok out =>
    have same : toE out = value := by
      simp only [native,resultMap] at mapped
      exact Result.ok.inj mapped
    exact ⟨out,rfl,by simpa only [same] using cohort,by simpa only [same] using canonical⟩

/-- Full Result and the pure frame are from this same extracted execution. -/
theorem complete {S Event : Type} (state : S) (alpha : N.E)
    (a : Array N.E 4#usize) (inverse : Array U32 5#usize) (domain : Domain alpha a) :
    ∃ out, NEI_CircleShared.circle_fold_with_inverses alpha a inverse = ok out ∧
      CanonicalWide (toE out) ∧
      NEB_PureFrame.run (Event:=Event) state
        (NEI_CircleShared.circle_fold_with_inverses alpha a inverse) = ok (out,state,[]) ∧
      NEG_FoldsTypes.circle_fold_with_inverses (toE alpha) (rows a) inverse = ok (toE out) := by
  obtain ⟨out,native,cohort,canonical⟩ := returns alpha a inverse domain
  exact ⟨out,native,canonical,NEB_PureFrame.successful state _ _ native,cohort⟩

#print axioms returns
#print axioms complete
end NEI_CircleBridge
end

namespace NEI_LineActual
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NEI_FieldCarriers NEI_FieldWide
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20
open AspisR1

def rows (a : Array N.E 4#usize) : Array C.E 4#usize :=
  ⟨a.val.map toE, by simpa only [List.length_map] using a.property⟩

theorem body (alpha : N.E) (a : Array N.E 4#usize) (inverse : Array U32 5#usize) :
    resultMap toE (NEI_LineFull.line_fold_with_inverses alpha a inverse) =
      SAQ_LineSource.line (toE alpha) (rows a) inverse := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,d,rfl⟩ := SAQ_LineArrays.four a
  obtain ⟨ix,iy,lx,ly,lz,rfl⟩ := SAQ_LineArrays.five inverse
  have mapped : rows (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) =
      Array.make 4#usize [toE a,toE b,toE c,toE d] := rfl
  rw [mapped]
  have n0 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 0#usize = ok (a) := rfl
  have n1 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 1#usize = ok (b) := rfl
  have n2 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 2#usize = ok (c) := rfl
  have n3 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 3#usize = ok (d) := rfl
  have c0 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [toE a,toE b,toE c,toE d]) 0#usize = ok (toE a) := rfl
  have c1 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [toE a,toE b,toE c,toE d]) 1#usize = ok (toE b) := rfl
  have c2 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [toE a,toE b,toE c,toE d]) 2#usize = ok (toE c) := rfl
  have c3 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [toE a,toE b,toE c,toE d]) 3#usize = ok (toE d) := rfl
  have i2 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]) 2#usize = ok lx := rfl
  have i3 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]) 3#usize = ok ly := rfl
  have i4 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]) 4#usize = ok lz := rfl
  simp only [NEI_LineFull.line_fold_with_inverses, SAQ_LineSource.line,
    n0,n1,n2,n3,c0,c1,c2,c3,i2,i3,i4,bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [bindE,bindWord,wide_add,wide_sub,wide_mul,wide_mul_m31,
    NEI_FieldScalar.m_mul,tofromE,NEI_LineFull.QUARTER,SAQ_LineSource.quarter] <;> rfl

#print axioms body
end NEI_LineActual
end

NEI_LineCertificate.source:
import NEI_LineDomains
import NEB_PureFrame
import SAQ_LineJoin
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEI_LineCertificate
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof
open SAQ_LineSource

/-- Reconstruct the complete emitted Result from the same ordered call cuts. -/
theorem reconstruct (alpha a b c d out : E) (ix iy lx ly lz : U32)
    (cut : Cuts alpha a b c d lx ly lz out) :
    NEG_FoldsTypes.line_fold_with_inverses alpha
      (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])
      (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]) = ok out := by
  rw [NEG_FoldAssociation.line]
  have ia0 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 0#usize=ok a := rfl
  have ia1 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 1#usize=ok b := rfl
  have ia2 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 2#usize=ok c := rfl
  have ia3 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 3#usize=ok d := rfl
  have ii2 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]) 2#usize=ok lx := rfl
  have ii3 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]) 3#usize=ok ly := rfl
  have ii4 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]) 4#usize=ok lz := rfl
  simp only [SAQ_LineSource.line,ia0,ia1,ia2,ia3,ii2,ii3,ii4,
    cut.Hwe,cut.Hwe1,cut.Hwe2,cut.Hh0,cut.Hwe3,cut.Hwe4,cut.Hm,cut.Hh2,cut.Hwe5,cut.Hm1,cut.Hc0,cut.Hwe6,cut.Hm2,cut.Hc1,cut.Hwe7,cut.Hh1,cut.Hwe8,cut.Hm3,cut.Hh3,cut.Hwe9,cut.Hwe10,cut.Hwe11,cut.Hwe12,cut.Hwe13,cut.Hout,bind_tc_ok]

theorem same_execution {S Event : Type} (state : S)
    (alpha a b c d : E) (ix iy lx ly lz : U32)
    (hAlpha : CanonicalWide alpha) (ha : CanonicalWide a) (hb : CanonicalWide b)
    (hc : CanonicalWide c) (hd : CanonicalWide d) :
    ∃ out, ∃ cut : Cuts alpha a b c d lx ly lz out,
      NEI_LineDomains.Intermediates cut ∧
      NEG_FoldsTypes.line_fold_with_inverses alpha
        (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])
        (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz])=ok out ∧
      NEB_PureFrame.run (Event:=Event) state
        (NEG_FoldsTypes.line_fold_with_inverses alpha
          (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])
          (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]))=ok (out,state,[]) ∧
      CanonicalWide out ∧ decodeWide out =
        R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.sourceLineFold (decodeWide alpha)
          (values4 (decodeWide a) (decodeWide b) (decodeWide c) (decodeWide d))
          (decodeBase lx) (decodeBase ly) (decodeBase lz) := by
  obtain ⟨out,run,canonical⟩ := JFn_LineTotal.source alpha a b c d ix iy lx ly lz
    hAlpha ha hb hc hd
  obtain ⟨cut⟩ := SAQ_LineSource.cuts alpha a b c d out ix iy lx ly lz run
  have emitted := reconstruct alpha a b c d out ix iy lx ly lz cut
  exact ⟨out,cut,NEI_LineDomains.same_site_domains alpha a b c d out lx ly lz
    cut hAlpha ha hb hc hd,emitted,NEB_PureFrame.successful state _ _ emitted,
    canonical,(SAQ_LineJoin.on_cuts alpha a b c d out lx ly lz cut).2⟩

#print axioms reconstruct
#print axioms same_execution
end NEI_LineCertificate
end

NEI_LineDomains.source:
import NEG_FoldAssociation
import JFn_LineTotal
import SAQ_LineArrays
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEI_LineDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof
open SAQ_LineSource

theorem sub_canonical (x y z : E) (hx : CanonicalWide x) (hy : CanonicalWide y)
    (run : field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub x y = ok z) : CanonicalWide z := by
  obtain ⟨out,ho,co,_⟩ := wide_sub_total_exact x y hx hy
  have same : out = z := Result.ok.inj (ho.symm.trans run)
  exact same ▸ co
#print axioms sub_canonical

/-- No inverse canonicality or unused-cell predicate is imposed. -/
def Domain (alpha : E) (rows : Array E 4#usize) : Prop :=
  CanonicalWide alpha ∧ ∀ x ∈ rows.val, CanonicalWide x

def Intermediates {alpha a b c d out : E} {lx ly lz : U32}
    (cut : Cuts alpha a b c d lx ly lz out) : Prop :=
  CanonicalWide cut.we ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we1 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we2 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.h0 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we3 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we4 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.h2 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we5 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.c0 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we6 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.c1 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we7 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.h1 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we8 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.h3 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we9 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we10 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we11 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we12 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we13 ∧
  CanonicalWide out

theorem same_site_domains (alpha a b c d out : E) (lx ly lz : U32)
    (cut : Cuts alpha a b c d lx ly lz out)
    (hAlpha : CanonicalWide alpha) (ha : CanonicalWide a) (hb : CanonicalWide b)
    (hc : CanonicalWide c) (hd : CanonicalWide d) : Intermediates cut := by
  have Cwe : CanonicalWide cut.we := (wide_add_success a b cut.we ha hb cut.Hwe).1
  have Cwe1 : CanonicalWide cut.we1 := (wide_add_success cut.we c cut.we1 Cwe hc cut.Hwe1).1
  have Cwe2 : CanonicalWide cut.we2 := (wide_add_success cut.we1 d cut.we2 Cwe1 hd cut.Hwe2).1
  have Ch0 : CanonicalWide cut.h0 := (SAQ_LineSource.scale cut.we2 cut.h0 quarter cut.Hh0).1
  have Cwe3 : CanonicalWide cut.we3 := sub_canonical cut.we c cut.we3 Cwe hc cut.Hwe3
  have Cwe4 : CanonicalWide cut.we4 := sub_canonical cut.we3 d cut.we4 Cwe3 hd cut.Hwe4
  have Ch2 : CanonicalWide cut.h2 := (SAQ_LineSource.scale cut.we4 cut.h2 cut.m cut.Hh2).1
  have Cwe5 : CanonicalWide cut.we5 := sub_canonical a b cut.we5 ha hb cut.Hwe5
  have Cc0 : CanonicalWide cut.c0 := (SAQ_LineSource.scale cut.we5 cut.c0 cut.m1 cut.Hc0).1
  have Cwe6 : CanonicalWide cut.we6 := sub_canonical d c cut.we6 hd hc cut.Hwe6
  have Cc1 : CanonicalWide cut.c1 := (SAQ_LineSource.scale cut.we6 cut.c1 cut.m2 cut.Hc1).1
  have Cwe7 : CanonicalWide cut.we7 := (wide_add_success cut.c0 cut.c1 cut.we7 Cc0 Cc1 cut.Hwe7).1
  have Ch1 : CanonicalWide cut.h1 := (SAQ_LineSource.scale cut.we7 cut.h1 1073741824#u32 cut.Hh1).1
  have Cwe8 : CanonicalWide cut.we8 := sub_canonical cut.c0 cut.c1 cut.we8 Cc0 Cc1 cut.Hwe8
  have Ch3 : CanonicalWide cut.h3 := (SAQ_LineSource.scale cut.we8 cut.h3 cut.m3 cut.Hh3).1
  have Cwe9 : CanonicalWide cut.we9 := (SAQ_RawWide.mul_exact alpha cut.h3 cut.we9 cut.Hwe9).1
  have Cwe10 : CanonicalWide cut.we10 := (wide_add_success cut.h2 cut.we9 cut.we10 Ch2 Cwe9 cut.Hwe10).1
  have Cwe11 : CanonicalWide cut.we11 := (SAQ_RawWide.mul_exact alpha cut.we10 cut.we11 cut.Hwe11).1
  have Cwe12 : CanonicalWide cut.we12 := (wide_add_success cut.h1 cut.we11 cut.we12 Ch1 Cwe11 cut.Hwe12).1
  have Cwe13 : CanonicalWide cut.we13 := (SAQ_RawWide.mul_exact alpha cut.we12 cut.we13 cut.Hwe13).1
  have Cout : CanonicalWide out := (wide_add_success cut.h0 cut.we13 out Ch0 Cwe13 cut.Hout).1
  exact ⟨Cwe,Cwe1,Cwe2,Ch0,Cwe3,Cwe4,Ch2,Cwe5,Cc0,Cwe6,Cc1,Cwe7,Ch1,Cwe8,Ch3,Cwe9,Cwe10,Cwe11,Cwe12,Cwe13,Cout⟩

theorem total (alpha : E) (rows : Array E 4#usize) (inverse : Array U32 5#usize)
    (domain : Domain alpha rows) :
    ∃ out, NEG_FoldsTypes.line_fold_with_inverses alpha rows inverse = ok out ∧
      CanonicalWide out := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,d,rfl⟩ := SAQ_LineArrays.four rows
  obtain ⟨ix,iy,lx,ly,lz,rfl⟩ := SAQ_LineArrays.five inverse
  have ha := domain.2 a (by simp [Array.make])
  have hb := domain.2 b (by simp [Array.make])
  have hc := domain.2 c (by simp [Array.make])
  have hd := domain.2 d (by simp [Array.make])
  rw [NEG_FoldAssociation.line]
  exact JFn_LineTotal.source alpha a b c d ix iy lx ly lz domain.1 ha hb hc hd

#print axioms same_site_domains
#print axioms total
end NEI_LineDomains
end

JFn_LineTotal.source:
import JFn_ScaleTotal
import SAQ_LineSource
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.JFn_LineTotal
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof

theorem source (alpha a b c d : E) (ix iy lx ly lz : U32)
    (hAlpha : CanonicalWide alpha) (ha : CanonicalWide a) (hb : CanonicalWide b)
    (hc : CanonicalWide c) (hd : CanonicalWide d) :
    ∃ out, SAQ_LineSource.line alpha (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])
      (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz])=ok out ∧ CanonicalWide out := by
  obtain ⟨we,Hwe,Cwe,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact a b ha hb
  obtain ⟨we1,Hwe1,Cwe1,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact we c Cwe hc
  obtain ⟨we2,Hwe2,Cwe2,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact we1 d Cwe1 hd
  obtain ⟨h0,Hh0,Ch0⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.wide we2 SAQ_LineSource.quarter
  obtain ⟨we3,Hwe3,Cwe3,_⟩ := wide_sub_total_exact we c Cwe hc
  obtain ⟨we4,Hwe4,Cwe4,_⟩ := wide_sub_total_exact we3 d Cwe3 hd
  obtain ⟨m,Hm⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.base SAQ_LineSource.quarter lz
  obtain ⟨h2,Hh2,Ch2⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.wide we4 m
  obtain ⟨we5,Hwe5,Cwe5,_⟩ := wide_sub_total_exact a b ha hb
  obtain ⟨m1,Hm1⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.base 1073741824#u32 lx
  obtain ⟨c0,Hc0,Cc0⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.wide we5 m1
  obtain ⟨we6,Hwe6,Cwe6,_⟩ := wide_sub_total_exact d c hd hc
  obtain ⟨m2,Hm2⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.base 1073741824#u32 ly
  obtain ⟨c1,Hc1,Cc1⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.wide we6 m2
  obtain ⟨we7,Hwe7,Cwe7,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact c0 c1 Cc0 Cc1
  obtain ⟨h1,Hh1,Ch1⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.wide we7 1073741824#u32
  obtain ⟨we8,Hwe8,Cwe8,_⟩ := wide_sub_total_exact c0 c1 Cc0 Cc1
  obtain ⟨m3,Hm3⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.base 1073741824#u32 lz
  obtain ⟨h3,Hh3,Ch3⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.wide we8 m3
  obtain ⟨we9,Hwe9,Cwe9,_⟩ := wide_mul_total_exact alpha h3 hAlpha Ch3
  obtain ⟨we10,Hwe10,Cwe10,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact h2 we9 Ch2 Cwe9
  obtain ⟨we11,Hwe11,Cwe11,_⟩ := wide_mul_total_exact alpha we10 hAlpha Cwe10
  obtain ⟨we12,Hwe12,Cwe12,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact h1 we11 Ch1 Cwe11
  obtain ⟨we13,Hwe13,Cwe13,_⟩ := wide_mul_total_exact alpha we12 hAlpha Cwe12
  obtain ⟨out,Hout,Cout,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact h0 we13 Ch0 Cwe13
  refine ⟨out,?_,Cout⟩
  have ia0 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 0#usize=ok a := rfl
  have ia1 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 1#usize=ok b := rfl
  have ia2 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 2#usize=ok c := rfl
  have ia3 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 3#usize=ok d := rfl
  have ii2 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]) 2#usize=ok lx := rfl
  have ii3 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]) 3#usize=ok ly := rfl
  have ii4 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]) 4#usize=ok lz := rfl
  simp only [SAQ_LineSource.line,ia0,ia1,ia2,ia3,ii2,ii3,ii4,Hwe,Hwe1,Hwe2,Hh0,Hwe3,Hwe4,Hm,Hh2,Hwe5,Hm1,Hc0,Hwe6,Hm2,Hc1,Hwe7,Hh1,Hwe8,Hm3,Hh3,Hwe9,Hwe10,Hwe11,Hwe12,Hwe13,Hout,bind_tc_ok]

#print axioms source

import SAQ_RawScale
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.JFn_ScaleTotal
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof

theorem base (x y : U32) : ∃ z, field.M31.mul x y=ok z := by
  obtain ⟨z,run,_,_⟩ := ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_mul_mod x y
  exact ⟨z,by rw [m31_mul_same];exact run⟩

theorem cm (x : field.CM31) (s : U32) : ∃ z, field.CM31.mul_m31 x s=ok z := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩:=base x.a s
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩:=base x.b s
  exact ⟨⟨a,b⟩,by simp only [field.CM31.mul_m31,ha,hb,bind_tc_ok]⟩

theorem qm (x : field.QM31) (s : U32) : ∃ z, field.QM31.mul_m31 x s=ok z := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩:=cm x.c0 s
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩:=cm x.c1 s
  exact ⟨⟨a,b⟩,by simp only [field.QM31.mul_m31,ha,hb,bind_tc_ok]⟩

/-- Forward totality for the actual scalar-multiplication body. Each
component executes the source reducer; no result-success premise is used. -/
theorem wide (x : E) (s : U32) :
    ∃ z, field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 x s=ok z ∧ CanonicalWide z := by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,_⟩:=WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec s (y:=field.P) (by norm_num [field.P]))
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩:=qm x.c0 r
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩:=qm x.c1 r
  have run : field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 x s=ok (⟨a,b⟩ : E) := by
    simp only [field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31,hr,ha,hb,bind_tc_ok]
  exact ⟨_,run,(SAQ_RawScale.wide_mul_m31_success x _ s run).1⟩

#print axioms base
#print axioms cm
#print axioms qm
#print axioms wide
end AspisR1.JFn_ScaleTotal
end

SAQ_LineArrays.source:
import SAQ_LineSource
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SAQ_LineArrays
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev FP := ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P

theorem four {T : Type} (a : Array T 4#usize) :
    ∃ a0 a1 a2 a3, a=Array.make 4#usize [a0,a1,a2,a3] := by
  obtain ⟨a0,a1,a2,a3,h⟩ := List.length_eq_four.mp a.property
  exact ⟨a0,a1,a2,a3,Subtype.ext h⟩

theorem five {T : Type} (a : Array T 5#usize) :
    ∃ a0 a1 a2 a3 a4, a=Array.make 5#usize [a0,a1,a2,a3,a4] := by
  rcases a with ⟨l,hl⟩
  cases l with
  | nil => simp at hl
  | cons a0 tail =>
    have len : tail.length=4 := by
      change tail.length+1=5 at hl
      omega
    obtain ⟨a1,a2,a3,a4,h⟩ := List.length_eq_four.mp len
    subst tail
    exact ⟨a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,rfl⟩

theorem source_eq_inverses {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra FP K]
    (alpha : K) (v : Fin 4 → K) (ix iy iz : FP) :
    R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.sourceLineFold alpha v ix iy iz =
      FoldRuntimeAlgebra.lineWithInverses alpha (algebraMap FP K ix)
        (algebraMap FP K iy) (algebraMap FP K iz) v := by
  have quarter : algebraMap FP K R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustQuarter=(4:K)⁻¹ := by
    apply eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right
    have h := congrArg (algebraMap FP K) R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.four_mul_rustQuarter
    rwa [map_mul,map_one,map_ofNat] at h
  simp only [R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.sourceLineFold,FoldRuntimeAlgebra.lineWithInverses,
    map_mul,quarter,R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.algebraMap_rustHalf]

#print axioms four
#print axioms five
#print axioms source_eq_inverses
end AspisR1.SAQ_LineArrays
end

import Aeneas
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEB_PureFrame
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def run {A S Event : Type} (s : S) (r : Result A) : Result (A × S × List Event) := do
  let z ← r
  ok (z,s,[])

theorem successful {A S Event : Type} (s : S) (r : Result A) (z : A) (h : r=ok z) :
    run (Event:=Event) s r=ok (z,s,[]) := by
  simp only [run,h,bind_tc_ok]

theorem equality {A S Event : Type} (s : S) (r t : Result A) (h : r=t) :
    run (Event:=Event) s r=run s t := by rw [h]

#print axioms successful
#print axioms equality
end NEB_PureFrame

SAQ_LineJoin.source:
import SAQ_LineChannels
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SAQ_LineJoin
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof SAQ_LineSource SAQ_LineChannels
variable (alpha a b c d out : E) (lx ly lz : U32)
theorem on_cuts (cut : Cuts alpha a b c d lx ly lz out) : CanonicalWide out ∧ decodeWide out =
    R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.sourceLineFold (decodeWide alpha)
      (values4 (decodeWide a) (decodeWide b) (decodeWide c) (decodeWide d))
      (decodeBase lx) (decodeBase ly) (decodeBase lz) := by
  refine ⟨SAQ_LineCanonical.on_cuts alpha a b c d out lx ly lz cut,?_⟩
  with_reducible exact (SAQ_LineAlgebra.compose (decodeWide alpha) (decodeWide a) (decodeWide b)
    (decodeWide c) (decodeWide d) (decodeBase lx) (decodeBase ly) (decodeBase lz)
    (decodeWide cut.h0) (decodeWide cut.h1) (decodeWide cut.h2) (decodeWide cut.h3) (decodeWide out)
    (h0 alpha a b c d out lx ly lz cut) (h1 alpha a b c d out lx ly lz cut)
    (h2 alpha a b c d out lx ly lz cut) (h3 alpha a b c d out lx ly lz cut)
    (horner alpha a b c d out lx ly lz cut))

#print axioms on_cuts
end AspisR1.SAQ_LineJoin
end

SAQ_LineChannels.source:
import SAQ_LineAlgebra
import SAQ_LineCanonical
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SAQ_LineChannels
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof SAQ_LineSource

variable (alpha a b c d out : E) (lx ly lz : U32)
variable (cut : Cuts alpha a b c d lx ly lz out)

theorem h0 : decodeWide cut.h0 = (decodeWide a+decodeWide b+decodeWide c+decodeWide d)*
    algebraMap FP AspisWideTower.WideExact R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustQuarter := by
  have e := (scale cut.we2 cut.h0 quarter cut.Hh0).2
  rw [SAQ_RawWide.add_exact cut.we1 d cut.we2 cut.Hwe2,
    SAQ_RawWide.add_exact cut.we c cut.we1 cut.Hwe1,
    SAQ_RawWide.add_exact a b cut.we cut.Hwe] at e
  exact e

theorem h2 : decodeWide cut.h2 = (decodeWide a+decodeWide b-decodeWide c-decodeWide d)*
    algebraMap FP AspisWideTower.WideExact (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustQuarter*decodeBase lz) := by
  have e := (scale cut.we4 cut.h2 cut.m cut.Hh2).2
  have m := (baseMul quarter lz cut.m cut.Hm).2
  rw [m,SAQ_RawWide.sub_exact cut.we3 d cut.we4 cut.Hwe4,
    SAQ_RawWide.sub_exact cut.we c cut.we3 cut.Hwe3,
    SAQ_RawWide.add_exact a b cut.we cut.Hwe] at e
  exact e

theorem c0 : decodeWide cut.c0 = (decodeWide a-decodeWide b)*
    algebraMap FP AspisWideTower.WideExact (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf*decodeBase lx) := by
  have e := (scale cut.we5 cut.c0 cut.m1 cut.Hc0).2
  have m := (baseMul 1073741824#u32 lx cut.m1 cut.Hm1).2
  rw [m,SAQ_RawWide.sub_exact a b cut.we5 cut.Hwe5] at e
  exact e

theorem c1 : decodeWide cut.c1 = (decodeWide d-decodeWide c)*
    algebraMap FP AspisWideTower.WideExact (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf*decodeBase ly) := by
  have e := (scale cut.we6 cut.c1 cut.m2 cut.Hc1).2
  have m := (baseMul 1073741824#u32 ly cut.m2 cut.Hm2).2
  rw [m,SAQ_RawWide.sub_exact d c cut.we6 cut.Hwe6] at e
  exact e

theorem h1 : decodeWide cut.h1 = ((decodeWide a-decodeWide b)*
    algebraMap FP AspisWideTower.WideExact (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf*decodeBase lx)+
    (decodeWide d-decodeWide c)*
    algebraMap FP AspisWideTower.WideExact (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf*decodeBase ly))*
    algebraMap FP AspisWideTower.WideExact R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf := by
  have e := (scale cut.we7 cut.h1 1073741824#u32 cut.Hh1).2
  rw [SAQ_RawWide.add_exact cut.c0 cut.c1 cut.we7 cut.Hwe7,
    c0 alpha a b c d out lx ly lz cut,c1 alpha a b c d out lx ly lz cut] at e
  exact e

theorem h3 : decodeWide cut.h3 = ((decodeWide a-decodeWide b)*
    algebraMap FP AspisWideTower.WideExact (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf*decodeBase lx)-
    (decodeWide d-decodeWide c)*
    algebraMap FP AspisWideTower.WideExact (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf*decodeBase ly))*
    algebraMap FP AspisWideTower.WideExact (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf*decodeBase lz) := by
  have e := (scale cut.we8 cut.h3 cut.m3 cut.Hh3).2
  have m := (baseMul 1073741824#u32 lz cut.m3 cut.Hm3).2
  rw [m,SAQ_RawWide.sub_exact cut.c0 cut.c1 cut.we8 cut.Hwe8,
    c0 alpha a b c d out lx ly lz cut,c1 alpha a b c d out lx ly lz cut] at e
  exact e

theorem horner : decodeWide out=decodeWide cut.h0+decodeWide alpha*
    (decodeWide cut.h1+decodeWide alpha*(decodeWide cut.h2+decodeWide alpha*decodeWide cut.h3)) := by
  have e := SAQ_RawWide.add_exact cut.h0 cut.we13 out cut.Hout
  rw [(SAQ_RawWide.mul_exact alpha cut.we12 cut.we13 cut.Hwe13).2,
    SAQ_RawWide.add_exact cut.h1 cut.we11 cut.we12 cut.Hwe12,
    (SAQ_RawWide.mul_exact alpha cut.we10 cut.we11 cut.Hwe11).2,
    SAQ_RawWide.add_exact cut.h2 cut.we9 cut.we10 cut.Hwe10,
    (SAQ_RawWide.mul_exact alpha cut.h3 cut.we9 cut.Hwe9).2] at e
  exact e


#print axioms h0
#print axioms h2
#print axioms c0
#print axioms c1
#print axioms h1
#print axioms h3
#print axioms horner
end AspisR1.SAQ_LineChannels
end

SAQ_LineAlgebra.source:
import SAQ_LineSource
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SAQ_LineAlgebra
open SAQ_LineSource
abbrev FP := ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P

theorem compose {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra FP K]
    (alpha a b c d : K) (ix iy iz : FP) (h0 h1 h2 h3 out : K)
    (e0 : h0=(a+b+c+d)*algebraMap FP K R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustQuarter)
    (e1 : h1=((a-b)*algebraMap FP K (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf*ix)+
      (d-c)*algebraMap FP K (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf*iy))*
      algebraMap FP K R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf)
    (e2 : h2=(a+b-c-d)*algebraMap FP K (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustQuarter*iz))
    (e3 : h3=((a-b)*algebraMap FP K (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf*ix)-
      (d-c)*algebraMap FP K (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf*iy))*
      algebraMap FP K (R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.rustHalf*iz))
    (horner : out=h0+alpha*(h1+alpha*(h2+alpha*h3))) :
    out=R1ZCircleFoldMathV1.sourceLineFold alpha (values4 a b c d) ix iy iz := by
  rw [horner,e0,e1,e2,e3]
  rfl

#print axioms compose
end AspisR1.SAQ_LineAlgebra
end

SAQ_LineCanonical.source:
import SAQ_LineSource

noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SAQ_LineCanonical
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof SAQ_LineSource

theorem on_cuts (alpha a b c d out : E) (lx ly lz : U32)
    (cut : Cuts alpha a b c d lx ly lz out) : CanonicalWide out := by
  have first := scale cut.we2 cut.h0 quarter cut.Hh0
  have last := SAQ_RawWide.mul_exact alpha cut.we12 cut.we13 cut.Hwe13
  exact (wide_add_success cut.h0 cut.we13 out first.1 last.1 cut.Hout).1

theorem made (alpha a b c d out : E) (ix iy lx ly lz : U32)
    (h : line alpha (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])
      (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz])=ok out) : CanonicalWide out := by
  obtain ⟨cut⟩ := cuts alpha a b c d out ix iy lx ly lz h
  exact on_cuts alpha a b c d out lx ly lz cut

#print axioms on_cuts
#print axioms made
end AspisR1.SAQ_LineCanonical

NEI_CircleDomains.source:
import NEI_LineDomains
import JFr_TX2_CircleTotal
import FIp_CircleCuts
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEI_CircleDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof
open FIp_CircleCuts
abbrev Domain := NEI_LineDomains.Domain

def Intermediates {alpha a b c d out : E} {ix iy : U32}
    (cut : Cuts alpha a b c d ix iy out) : Prop :=
  CanonicalWide cut.we ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we1 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we2 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.h0 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we3 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we4 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we5 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.h1 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we6 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we7 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.h2 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we8 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we9 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.h3 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we10 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we11 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we12 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we13 ∧
  CanonicalWide cut.we14 ∧
  CanonicalWide out

theorem same_site_domains (alpha a b c d out : E) (ix iy : U32)
    (cut : Cuts alpha a b c d ix iy out)
    (ha : CanonicalWide a) (hb : CanonicalWide b)
    (hc : CanonicalWide c) (hd : CanonicalWide d) : Intermediates cut := by
  have Cwe : CanonicalWide cut.we := (wide_add_success a b cut.we ha hb cut.Hwe).1
  have Cwe1 : CanonicalWide cut.we1 := (wide_add_success cut.we c cut.we1 Cwe hc cut.Hwe1).1
  have Cwe2 : CanonicalWide cut.we2 := (wide_add_success cut.we1 d cut.we2 Cwe1 hd cut.Hwe2).1
  have Ch0 : CanonicalWide cut.h0 := (SAQ_LineSource.scale cut.we2 cut.h0 SAQ_LineSource.quarter cut.Hh0).1
  have Cwe3 : CanonicalWide cut.we3 := NEI_LineDomains.sub_canonical a b cut.we3 ha hb cut.Hwe3
  have Cwe4 : CanonicalWide cut.we4 := NEI_LineDomains.sub_canonical cut.we3 c cut.we4 Cwe3 hc cut.Hwe4
  have Cwe5 : CanonicalWide cut.we5 := (wide_add_success cut.we4 d cut.we5 Cwe4 hd cut.Hwe5).1
  have Ch1 : CanonicalWide cut.h1 := (SAQ_LineSource.scale cut.we5 cut.h1 cut.m cut.Hh1).1
  have Cwe6 : CanonicalWide cut.we6 := NEI_LineDomains.sub_canonical cut.we c cut.we6 Cwe hc cut.Hwe6
  have Cwe7 : CanonicalWide cut.we7 := NEI_LineDomains.sub_canonical cut.we6 d cut.we7 Cwe6 hd cut.Hwe7
  have Ch2 : CanonicalWide cut.h2 := (SAQ_LineSource.scale cut.we7 cut.h2 cut.m1 cut.Hh2).1
  have Cwe8 : CanonicalWide cut.we8 := (wide_add_success cut.we3 c cut.we8 Cwe3 hc cut.Hwe8).1
  have Cwe9 : CanonicalWide cut.we9 := NEI_LineDomains.sub_canonical cut.we8 d cut.we9 Cwe8 hd cut.Hwe9
  have Ch3 : CanonicalWide cut.h3 := (SAQ_LineSource.scale cut.we9 cut.h3 cut.m2 cut.Hh3).1
  have Cwe10 : CanonicalWide cut.we10 := (SAQ_RawWide.mul_exact alpha cut.h3 cut.we10 cut.Hwe10).1
  have Cwe11 : CanonicalWide cut.we11 := (wide_add_success cut.h2 cut.we10 cut.we11 Ch2 Cwe10 cut.Hwe11).1
  have Cwe12 : CanonicalWide cut.we12 := (SAQ_RawWide.mul_exact alpha cut.we11 cut.we12 cut.Hwe12).1
  have Cwe13 : CanonicalWide cut.we13 := (wide_add_success cut.h1 cut.we12 cut.we13 Ch1 Cwe12 cut.Hwe13).1
  have Cwe14 : CanonicalWide cut.we14 := (SAQ_RawWide.mul_exact alpha cut.we13 cut.we14 cut.Hwe14).1
  have Cout : CanonicalWide out := (wide_add_success cut.h0 cut.we14 out Ch0 Cwe14 cut.Hout).1
  exact ⟨Cwe,Cwe1,Cwe2,Ch0,Cwe3,Cwe4,Cwe5,Ch1,Cwe6,Cwe7,Ch2,Cwe8,Cwe9,Ch3,Cwe10,Cwe11,Cwe12,Cwe13,Cwe14,Cout⟩

theorem total (alpha : E) (a : Array E 4#usize) (inverse : Array U32 5#usize)
    (domain : Domain alpha a) :
    ∃ out, FIp_CircleSource.circle alpha a inverse = ok out ∧ CanonicalWide out := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,d,rfl⟩ := SAQ_LineArrays.four a
  obtain ⟨ix,iy,lx,ly,lz,rfl⟩ := SAQ_LineArrays.five inverse
  have ha := domain.2 a (by simp [Array.make])
  have hb := domain.2 b (by simp [Array.make])
  have hc := domain.2 c (by simp [Array.make])
  have hd := domain.2 d (by simp [Array.make])
  exact JFr_TX2_CircleTotal.source alpha a b c d ix iy lx ly lz domain.1 ha hb hc hd

#print axioms same_site_domains
#print axioms total
end NEI_CircleDomains
end

JFr_TX2_CircleTotal.source:
import JFn_ScaleTotal
import FIp_CircleSource
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.JFr_TX2_CircleTotal
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1CurrentWide AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof

/-- The actual circle arithmetic returns on canonical operands. This is not
the circle-fold equality gate: that requires the computed dot values. -/
theorem source (alpha a b c d : E) (ix iy lx ly lz : U32)
    (hAlpha : CanonicalWide alpha) (ha : CanonicalWide a) (hb : CanonicalWide b)
    (hc : CanonicalWide c) (hd : CanonicalWide d) :
    ∃ out, FIp_CircleSource.circle alpha (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])
      (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz])=ok out ∧ CanonicalWide out := by
  obtain ⟨we,Hwe,Cwe,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact a b ha hb
  obtain ⟨we1,Hwe1,Cwe1,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact we c Cwe hc
  obtain ⟨we2,Hwe2,Cwe2,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact we1 d Cwe1 hd
  obtain ⟨h0,Hh0,Ch0⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.wide we2 SAQ_LineSource.quarter
  obtain ⟨we3,Hwe3,Cwe3,_⟩ := wide_sub_total_exact a b ha hb
  obtain ⟨we4,Hwe4,Cwe4,_⟩ := wide_sub_total_exact we3 c Cwe3 hc
  obtain ⟨we5,Hwe5,Cwe5,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact we4 d Cwe4 hd
  obtain ⟨m,Hm⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.base SAQ_LineSource.quarter iy
  obtain ⟨h1,Hh1,Ch1⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.wide we5 m
  obtain ⟨we6,Hwe6,Cwe6,_⟩ := wide_sub_total_exact we c Cwe hc
  obtain ⟨we7,Hwe7,Cwe7,_⟩ := wide_sub_total_exact we6 d Cwe6 hd
  obtain ⟨m1,Hm1⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.base SAQ_LineSource.quarter ix
  obtain ⟨h2,Hh2,Ch2⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.wide we7 m1
  obtain ⟨we8,Hwe8,Cwe8,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact we3 c Cwe3 hc
  obtain ⟨we9,Hwe9,Cwe9,_⟩ := wide_sub_total_exact we8 d Cwe8 hd
  obtain ⟨m2,Hm2⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.base m1 iy
  obtain ⟨h3,Hh3,Ch3⟩ := JFn_ScaleTotal.wide we9 m2
  obtain ⟨we10,Hwe10,Cwe10,_⟩ := wide_mul_total_exact alpha h3 hAlpha Ch3
  obtain ⟨we11,Hwe11,Cwe11,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact h2 we10 Ch2 Cwe10
  obtain ⟨we12,Hwe12,Cwe12,_⟩ := wide_mul_total_exact alpha we11 hAlpha Cwe11
  obtain ⟨we13,Hwe13,Cwe13,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact h1 we12 Ch1 Cwe12
  obtain ⟨we14,Hwe14,Cwe14,_⟩ := wide_mul_total_exact alpha we13 hAlpha Cwe13
  obtain ⟨out,Hout,Cout,_⟩ := wide_add_total_exact h0 we14 Ch0 Cwe14
  refine ⟨out,?_,Cout⟩
  have ia0 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 0#usize=ok a := rfl
  have ia1 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 1#usize=ok b := rfl
  have ia2 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 2#usize=ok c := rfl
  have ia3 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 3#usize=ok d := rfl

  have ii1 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]) 1#usize=ok iy := rfl
  simp only [FIp_CircleSource.circle,ia0,ia1,ia2,ia3,ii0,ii1,Hwe,Hwe1,Hwe2,Hh0,Hwe3,
    Hwe4,Hwe5,Hm,Hh1,Hwe6,Hwe7,Hm1,Hh2,Hwe8,Hwe9,Hm2,Hh3,Hwe10,Hwe11,Hwe12,Hwe13,

  have ii1 : Array.index_usize (Array.make 5#usize [ix,iy,lx,ly,lz]) 1#usize=ok iy := rfl
  simp only [FIp_CircleSource.circle,ia0,ia1,ia2,ia3,ii0,ii1,bind_tc_ok] at run
  obtain ⟨we,Hwe,run⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ run

  obtain ⟨we7,Hwe7,run⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨m1,Hm1,run⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨h2,Hh2,run⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ run

  obtain ⟨we9,Hwe9,run⟩ := Port3_PushFrame.bind_success _ _ _ run

  exact ⟨⟨we,we1,we2,h0,we3,we4,we5,m,h1,we6,we7,m1,h2,we8,we9,m2,h3,we10,we11,we12,we13,we14,Hwe,Hwe1,Hwe2,Hh0,Hwe3,Hwe4,Hwe5,Hm,Hh1,Hwe6,Hwe7,Hm1,Hh2,Hwe8,Hwe9,Hm2,Hh3,Hwe10,Hwe11,Hwe12,Hwe13,Hwe14,run⟩⟩

NEI_LineBridge.source:
import NEI_LineActual
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEI_LineBridge
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NEI_FieldCarriers NEI_LineActual
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20
open AspisR1 AspisR1CurrentWide.Proof

/-- The actual extracted source uses identical fields; inverse is unrestricted. -/
def Domain (alpha : N.E) (a : Array N.E 4#usize) : Prop :=
  NEI_LineDomains.Domain (toE alpha) (rows a)

theorem returns (alpha : N.E) (a : Array N.E 4#usize) (inverse : Array U32 5#usize)
    (domain : Domain alpha a) :
    ∃ out, NEI_LineFull.line_fold_with_inverses alpha a inverse = ok out ∧
      NEG_FoldsTypes.line_fold_with_inverses (toE alpha) (rows a) inverse = ok (toE out) ∧
      CanonicalWide (toE out) := by
  obtain ⟨value,cohort,canonical⟩ := NEI_LineDomains.total (toE alpha) (rows a) inverse domain
  have source : SAQ_LineSource.line (toE alpha) (rows a) inverse = ok value :=
    (NEG_FoldAssociation.line _ _ _).symm.trans cohort
  have mapped := (NEI_LineActual.body alpha a inverse).trans source
  cases native : NEI_LineFull.line_fold_with_inverses alpha a inverse with
  | fail e => simp only [native,resultMap] at mapped; cases mapped
  | div => simp only [native,resultMap] at mapped; cases mapped
  | ok out =>
    have same : toE out = value := by
      simp only [native,resultMap] at mapped
      exact Result.ok.inj mapped
    exact ⟨out,rfl,by simpa only [same] using cohort,by simpa only [same] using canonical⟩

/-- Full Result and the pure frame are from this same extracted execution. -/
theorem complete {S Event : Type} (state : S) (alpha : N.E)
    (a : Array N.E 4#usize) (inverse : Array U32 5#usize) (domain : Domain alpha a) :
    ∃ out, NEI_LineFull.line_fold_with_inverses alpha a inverse = ok out ∧
      CanonicalWide (toE out) ∧
      NEB_PureFrame.run (Event:=Event) state
        (NEI_LineFull.line_fold_with_inverses alpha a inverse) = ok (out,state,[]) ∧
      NEG_FoldsTypes.line_fold_with_inverses (toE alpha) (rows a) inverse = ok (toE out) := by
  obtain ⟨out,native,cohort,canonical⟩ := returns alpha a inverse domain
  exact ⟨out,native,canonical,NEB_PureFrame.successful state _ _ native,cohort⟩

#print axioms returns
#print axioms complete
end NEI_LineBridge
end
